Title: Data Analyst
Description:
New Permanent Opportunity for a Security Cleared Data Analyst

Must have active SC Clearance
Mid to Senior levels available
Up to £60k DoE plus package
Hybrid working – bases in Bristol, London, Manchester or Swansea




Who are we?

Our client is a leading technology consultancy delivering complex digital and data transformation programmes across the UK public sector.

Their teams work with clients to make better use of their data, delivering analytical solutions and insights that support better decision-making across a range of critical services.




What will the Data Analyst be doing?

You’ll be responsible for analysing data and turning complex datasets into clear, actionable insights, working closely with clients and technical teams to solve challenging business problems.

The role will involve data analysis, statistical techniques, data visualisation and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




Key responsibilities include:

Analysing and interpreting complex datasets to identify trends, relationships and actionable insights
Applying statistical techniques including hypothesis testing, regression and clustering
Carrying out data mining, profiling and exploratory analysis across varied datasets
Cleaning, standardising and transforming data to improve its quality and usability
Performing data linkage and integrating information from multiple sources
Developing data models and selecting appropriate analytical approaches to answer business questions
Creating clear and effective data visualisations to communicate findings
Translating analytical results into meaningful recommendations for clients and stakeholders
Applying appropriate data governance, security and quality practices throughout analytical work
Working with clients to understand requirements and communicate complex findings to non-technical audiences




Key Skills and Requirements

Commercial experience working in a Data Analysis role
Strong analytical and statistical skills with experience interpreting complex datasets
Experience with statistical techniques such as regression, hypothesis testing and clustering
Strong SQL skills and experience using Python for data analysis would be advantageous
Experience with data cleansing, standardisation, profiling and validation
Understanding of data modelling, data integration and data linkage
Experience creating data visualisations and communicating insights effectively
Understanding of data governance, security and data quality principles
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly with non-technical audiences
Experience contributing to analytical approaches and supporting wider project delivery would be advantageous




To be Considered:

Please either apply online or email me directly at dillon.lewis@searchability.com. For further information, please call 0161 416 6800 or 07842002378. I can make myself available outside normal working hours, from 7am until 10pm. If unavailable, please leave a message and either myself or one of my colleagues will respond.




By applying for this role, you give express consent for us to process and submit (subject to required skills) your application to our client in conjunction with this vacancy only.

Feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn by searching for Dillon Lewis.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
WeDoData is a specialist recruitment company whose focus is non-teaching support in the education sector.




We’re working with an established FE client of ours in West London who are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who enjoys working with complex data and turning it into clear, useful information.




As a Data Analyst, you’ll work with large student datasets across multiple college campuses, using SQL and Power BI to produce reports and dashboards that help managers understand performance and make informed decisions.




The role covers everything from analysing enrolment, attendance and achievement data to developing automated reports, improving existing reporting systems and making sure the information we provide is accurate and reliable.




We’re looking for someone with strong SQL skills, experience of MS SQL Management Studio and data warehousing, and a good working knowledge of Power BI or Tableau. You'll need to be confident working with large datasets, spotting trends and explaining your findings to colleagues who may not have a technical background.




You'll also need excellent attention to detail, good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines. Experience of SSRS or working in Further or Higher Education would be an advantage.




In return my client can offer:




Salary of £34,800 to £37,000
Hybrid working arrangement (2 days WFH)
29 days annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays
Access to local government pension (LGPS)
Free car parking
Subsidised gym membership
Dental insurance
Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
Public Transport Season Ticket Loan scheme




Unfortunately my client are unable to provide sponsorship.




If you enjoy getting into the detail, solving problems and finding better ways to present information, we'd like to hear from you.




If you'd like to discuss this opportunity in more detail please call Jay at WeDoData on 0117 3027500 or apply as soon as possible.




If this role isn't quite right for you please feel free to share with anyone you think might be better

suited.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
🏷️ Title: Senior Data Analyst

👫 Department: Analytics

💰 Salary: £60,000 - £80,000 + equity

🎁 Benefits & Culture: Lottie’s careers page here, Lottie’s tech careers page here

🎥 Meet our CTO: Solving hard problems in care

📈 Equity: A very generous EMI share offering

🌴 Holiday: 26 days + bank holidays

💗 Mission: Elevate later life for everybody and build the care sector of the future

💻 Office Policy: Hybrid with 2 core office days per week

🌍 Office Location: London Bridge, London, UK

🔍 The Opportunity:

Lottie is building the AI operating system for social care. Families find care through our marketplace, and providers run their business on Found, with Eliza, our AI agent, handling their family calls and chats. That's a lot of data, and using it well is how we transform care.

We're hiring a commercially-minded Senior Data Analyst to partner with Commercial, Finance and Product. You'll learn how our marketplace works and use analytics to shape our strategy, from partner acquisition to board reporting.

We're a lean team with big ambitions. You'll help define how Lottie creates value from its data, with AI as a default way of working. If you want your analysis to shape how a business grows and how care works, this is the role for you!

💻 What does this role involve?


Ship the full stack of analytics: pipelines, dashboards, experiments and stakeholder narratives - using AI to move faster at every step.
Build AI into how the team works: prompt workflows, AI-assisted analysis in Hex, faster iteration in Metabase, and automation where it multiplies impact.
Coach colleagues so self-serve isn't just dashboards - it's people using AI and Metabase confidently.


💪 What problems will you be solving?


Backing strategy with data - You'll work with leadership on the big commercial questions, building a deep understanding of how the marketplace works and turning it into analysis that drives the decision.
Driving commercial growth through data - You'll use BigQuery and Hex to spot acquisition opportunities and build analyses that show the value of our platform.
Unlocking product intelligence - You'll uncover how care providers use our platform, using experiments to understand cause and effect, and help communicate Found's value across the business.
Enabling financial excellence and board-level insights - You'll work with Finance to optimise processes, ensure accuracy and support board reporting.
Turning ad hoc into self-serve - You'll scope requests before committing time, push back when something isn't the best use of it, and build self-serve dashboards so the same question doesn't come back twice.


👀 We think you’ll be a great fit if…


You're technically strong and move fast - You have 4+ years in data analytics. You use tools like Claude to draft queries and build dashboards, and you know SQL well enough to review, question and fix what comes back.
You're commercially-minded, not just technically-minded - You have a natural ability to understand business context and identify opportunities that drive action. You don't just answer questions - you probe deeper, challenge assumptions, and deliver insights that genuinely move the needle on commercial outcomes.
You’re AI-fluent in practice - You already use tools like Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude or Hex AI in your day-to-day analytics, and you can show a before/after of how that’s changed your speed or quality. Curiosity alone isn’t enough; you ship with it.
You're an exceptional problem-solver - You have a proactive mindset and strong problem-solving skills (this matters more to us than specific industry experience). You thrive on ambiguity, breaking down abstract requirements into actionable solutions with wide freedom in your approach.
You're a compelling communicator - You have proven experience influencing diverse stakeholders from technical teams to non-technical commercial leaders. You can translate complex analyses into clear narratives, and you’re confident scoping requests and saying no to senior stakeholders when it’s the right call.
You're analytically rigorous - You can demonstrate numerical and statistical aptitude through work, studies, or outside-work projects. You know when to apply different analytical approaches and can explain your methodology clearly.
You pick up how a business works, fast - Marketplace or GTM experience is a plus, but B2B, B2C or consultancy backgrounds all work if you get to grips with the business quickly.
Our stack is BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase and Hex - Experience with these helps, but it isn’t essential if you’ve used comparable tools.


💔 This role isn’t for you if…


Our mission to elevate later life care doesn’t resonate with you.
You prefer working in isolation rather than as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team.
You're uncomfortable with ambiguity or prefer detailed specifications over problem-solving from first principles.
You treat AI as a gimmick, haven’t built it into your workflow, or won’t keep learning as the tools move.
You prioritise perfect work over impact.
You're looking for a role where you can specialise in a specific area.


🔢 Lottie’s Interview Process


First interview with our Talent Lead - 20 mins, remote
Hiring manager interview with our CPTO - 30-45 mins, remote
Technical interviews - 2 x 45 mins, remote
Behavioural interview - 45 mins, remote
Final interview with Will Donnelly, Co-Founder & CEO - in person


🤩 Candidate Experience: All candidates will be informed of their application status.

Our people are forward-thinking team-players who thrive on a collective diversity of skills and backgrounds. We’re on a thrilling journey of growth and innovation, and we need passionate, driven individuals to join us. At Betway, every day is action-packed, and we expect you to bring your A-game. In return, you’ll find a supportive environment where your skills can flourish, and your career can soar.

Ready to become a game-changer? Supercharge your career with us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re on a mission to create extraordinary experiences for our customers, and we believe that your unique skills, passion and superdrive will help us achieve our vision.

Demonstrable SQL skills to query complex data sets for the data analysis.
Demonstrable analytical and report development abilities
Strong communication and presentation skills
Ability to convey concepts, analysis, and insights to technical as well as non-technical audiences.
Ability to develop and sustain relationships with key stakeholders and peers
Ability to analyse large amounts of data quickly and accurately
Ability to manage a challenging workload, whilst working quickly and precisely under pressure.
Passionate about Data

Experience of working in online gaming or casino industry

Knowledge of online casino and sports betting
Proficient in Excel or other data analysis tools
Experience using Databricks
Experience with other BI tools such as Alteryx
Experience of using Google Analytics for reporting and analysis (including BigQuery)

• Advanced SQL skills

Your analysis will directly inform major initiatives spanning the art market’s digital transformation.

What You’ll Do


Own the collection, analysis, and interpretation of data across multiple departments to inform business strategy and operational improvements
Develop and maintain recurring and ad-hoc reports and dashboards using Looker, Salesforce, and other analytics tools
Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Executive teams to identify key metrics, set targets, and track the effectiveness of initiatives
Uncover trends, opportunities, and risks by segmenting and prioritizing data in alignment with company goals
Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences
Support the integration and usage of AI, automation, and business intelligence tools for increased efficiency and decision-making
Ensure the accuracy, reliability, and integrity of data utilized for internal and client-facing reporting
Proactively anticipate business challenges and work cross-functionally to address them with data-backed solutions
Share best practices, train team members on data literacy, and contribute to a collaborative, learning-focused environment


Who You Are

We welcome applications even if you don’t match every requirement below:


5+ years of experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a similar role, with a proven record of translating data insights into business outcomes
Highly proficient in SQL, Excel, and data visualization/reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities paired with excellent attention to detail
Experience working with large and complex datasets from multiple sources
Comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders, translating data into strategic recommendations, and challenging assumptions as needed
Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Familiarity with Salesforce CRM data structures and pipelines
Experience leveraging AI and automation to streamline analytics processes is a strong plus
A collaborative, ego-free teammate who values knowledge sharing and collective success
Based in New York, London, or Berlin, with flexibility for hybrid work arrangements (in-person expectations vary by location)


Nice to Have


Experience in the art market, ecommerce, or another digital marketplace environment
Experience with Python or R for advanced data analysis


What We Offer


Opportunity to reimagine the art industry in a high-impact position
Competitive salary and equity
Flexible paid time off and a culture of trust and empowerment
Comprehensive healthcare and benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, mental health support, parental leave, and more)
Professional development through mentoring, training, conferences, and open feedback

Global hybrid team: primary offices in NYC, London, Berlin (on-site expectations as applicable)

Our values guide how we work, shape our decisions, and bring us together as one team. They keep us aligned and help drive us toward our mission: to expand the art market, support more artists, and bring more art into the world—helping us create a future where everyone is moved by art, every day.

Description:
Music is Universal

From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Murphy deploys AI agents for banks starting with the most straightforward business case: voice AI for debt collection. We’ve built a fully-fledged platform designed to optimize recovery rates while maintaining respectful and personalized communication.

Our AI-powered agents adapt instantly, engaging with debtors across channels like voice, messengers, email and SMS to maximize results while preserving trust.

We’re live with Santander, Revolut, BBVA and dozens others. We’ve proven the product in large-scale pilots with top-tier banks. And now we need to move fast to secure leadership in this $300Bn+ industry.

About The Role

We're looking for a Data Analyst to turn every transaction into the reliable analytics. You'll work directly with the co-founders and will own the metrics, models and dashboards behind every decision we make.

What you'll do


Own the numbers. Define the KPIs every team runs on, and make sure everyone calculates them the same way.
Build the source of truth. Write the data models and dashboards that turn raw call, debt and payment data into answers people trust.
Automate invoicing. Turn billing every bank, in every currency, into a pipeline that runs itself.
Prove what works. Design and read the experiments that tell a real lift in recovery from noise.
Dive deep and problem solve. Get to the root cause of every number that looks off, and fix it at the source.


Who you are


Highly analytical, and precise. You've built metrics and models a business actually ran on.
You're fluent in SQL and Python.
You own outcomes, and you never settle. You don't stop at the chart — you chase the number until it changes a decision.
You have a STEM degree, and you were top of your class. You're technical, you're rigorous with numbers, and you have a strong philosophy of a champion.
AI-native, ruthless on quality. You reach for AI to automate and streamline by default. You know exactly where it gets sloppy. You never let that through, and you control quality rigorously.
You don't need a collections or fintech background. We'd rather teach the domain to a killer than hire a lifer who can't ship — you'll pick up the data, the domain and the regulation cold, fast.


🤝 What we offer

📈 Fair equity with enormous upside potential.

💰 Salary at the top of the benchmark.

🧩 Real ownership — Murphy's numbers are yours to define and defend.

⛳️ Small team, high autonomy, and outsized impact.

👏🏻 The founding team's direct attention, and a category with a $300B+ industry behind it.

🛜 Hybrid & Flexible: Our default setup is hybrid – 3 days a week at our office.

Our Process

We believe that hiring is a two-way street: while we get to know you, you also deserve the chance to understand who we are, how we work, and what makes Murphy AI special. Here’s what you can expect:

1️⃣ First Interview – Getting to Know You

A conversation with a future teammate who’s excited to find a new colleague. We’ll talk about your story, what drives you, and what you’re looking for next—no trick questions, just a genuine exchange.

2️⃣ Second Interview – Deep Dive

You’ll meet the Hiring Manager and potentially another team member. This is a more technical discussion where we explore your skills in detail, walk through real scenarios, and answer any questions you might have about the role.

3️⃣ Tech Assessment or Business Case

A practical exercise to see how you approach challenges similar to those you’d tackle at Murphy. You’ll have time to reflect and showcase your thinking—no rush, no surprises.

4️⃣ Coffee at the Office with the Founders

Finally, you’ll join us in our Barcelona office for a relaxed coffee with the founders and the Hiring Manager. It’s the perfect opportunity to experience our culture firsthand and meet more of the team who could soon be your colleagues.

👉 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone, regardless of background, identity, or experience, feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that different perspectives drive innovation and success, and we actively foster an environment where all voices are heard and respected.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Strategic Finance
Description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM


~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation


The Opportunity

Relay's network is scaling fast. The decisions that shape that growth, where to expand, how to price, where to invest, are made by a finance team that runs on data: driver-level metrics, profitability models, pricing structures, and operational KPIs. This role exists to own the analytics layer that powers those decisions.

As a Senior Data Analyst in the finance squad, you are responsible for how finance sees the business. You own the dashboards and reporting that give visibility into the metrics that matter: cost per parcel, expansion profitability, client and cohort performance, pricing dynamics, and the drivers underneath them. You translate raw operational data into views that finance can use to forecast, model, and act.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the finance squad, but report into the centralised data team. You will work closely with the Senior Data Scientist in the squad, building the reporting and visibility layer on top of their simulation models. You will also work across squads, pulling the metrics they commit to the semantic layer and shaping them into the views finance needs.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?


You take ownership of your domain. You don't wait to be told what finance needs or when something is broken. You're proactive about understanding the questions they're trying to answer and making sure the data is there to answer them.
You're an excellent data analyst who builds clean, reliable reporting that people actually use. You care about data quality, clarity, and making complex metrics understandable.
You're fluent in SQL and experienced with dbt. You can build and maintain well-structured models, not just write queries.
You're comfortable with BI tools and visualisation platforms. You know how to design dashboards that surface the right information without clutter.
You have at least 5 years of experience, ideally with some exposure to finance, FP&A, or commercial analytics. You understand how finance teams think about metrics and drivers.
You communicate clearly with non-technical partners. Finance will rely on your reporting to make decisions. You need to explain what it shows, where the data comes from, and where the limitations are.
You're comfortable working across teams. You'll pull metrics from squads across the business, which means building relationships and understanding how different parts of Relay operate.


Fast and Focused Hiring Process


Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 min
Technical SQL Interview - 1 hours
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 min
Case Study - 1 hour
Values & Impact Interview - 45 min
Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.


Compensation, Benefits & Workplace


Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).


Who Thrives at Relay?


Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.


If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to deliver accurate, timely, and insightful management reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.

In this role, you will gather, validate, and analyse data from various sources to create clear and actionable insights that inform strategic and operational decision-making for our Sipcom business.

Salary & Benefits

The budgeted salary for this role is between £45,000 - £55,000 a year, depending on experience.

Click here for the list of benefits.

Hybrid working

We recognise the benefits that remote and flexible working brings.

We operate a hybrid working policy that allows our employees to balance time in the office and time from home. Each team within our organisation can decide how to implement this policy. If you have any questions after applying, please reach out to our recruitment team.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:


Design and Maintain Reports: Create and manage user-friendly Power BI reports and dashboards to support business decision-making.
Data Analysis: Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights.
Data Validation: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by validating reporting data and investigating discrepancies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and develop practical dashboards and outputs.
Automation of Processes: Enhance efficiency by improving and automating manual reporting processes using tools like Power BI, Excel, and Power Automate.
Reporting and Presentation: Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and support operational performance through meaningful data insights.


What Success Looks Like


Timely Delivery of Reports: Successfully design and deliver a minimum of 5 key Power BI reports and dashboards that meet stakeholder requirements within the designated timelines.
Data Accuracy Improvement: Achieve a data accuracy rate of at least 95% by validating and reconciling discrepancies in reporting data.
Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and feedback on dashboard usability.
Automation of Reporting Processes: Automate at least 3 manual reporting processes, resulting in improved efficiency in data reporting.
Insight Generation: Identify and present significant trends or risk areas through data analysis, leading to actionable insights for operational improvement.
Customer Satisfaction Reporting: Develop and deliver a comprehensive customer satisfaction report, highlighting key metrics and trends to enhance service delivery.


Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate for this role will have:


Proven experience in a Reporting Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar analytical role, with strong problem-solving skills to interpret data and present actionable insights.
Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Power BI, Azure Synapse Analytics, SQL Server Reporting, and related tools, with experience in designing and maintaining accessible dashboards and reports.
Experience and confidence in extracting, cleansing, transforming, and analysing data from various sources, coupled with a solid understanding of data quality, governance, and reporting controls.
Ability to gather and translate reporting requirements from stakeholders into practical dashboards and outputs, ensuring alignment with business needs.
Experience in automating reporting processes using tools like Power Automate, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual effort in data reporting.


This role will require you to undergo the Security Clearance (SC) process once in role, so for that reason we will ask you to confirm if you are a British passport holder with 5 years residency in the UK when you apply for this position.

We are the tech company with people at heart.

At Advania, we believe in empowering people to create sustainable value through the clever use of technology. As one of Microsoft's leading partners in the UK, specialising in Azure, Security, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft 365, we have a proven track record of success in delivering transformational IT services.

Our Selection Process

We are committed to ensuring an equitable experience for all candidates, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Please do let us know if you’ll need any reasonable adjustments as part of the selection process by highlighting these on your application form.

As part of our commitment to our clients we will need to carry out background checks, including a criminal record check, for all offers of employment. If you have any unspent criminal convictions or questions about the screening process, please notify your recruiter once the application has been submitted.

We are the tech company with people at heart.

Tech is created for people. Our services impact every part of life. We are passionate about understanding your issues, your business, your needs. Our business is built around understanding people, and our employees are empowered to act on this understanding every day.

Your Impact

We have an excellent opportunity for a Procurement Data Analyst to join the UK Category Management Organisation within the Procurement & Commercial Function of the Electronics Division. The successful candidate will report to the Head of Direct UK Category Management.

What You Will Do


Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to gather, understand and report forecast data to enable sourcing and contract activities.
Establish and develop Power BI reports.
Develop and maintain inflation reports.
Develop, manage and report Procurement key performance indicators.
Create data dashboards, graphs and visualisations for category strategies and business reviews.
Collate and analyse spend and performance related data. Determine and implement actions accordingly.
Gather, analyse and report supply risk data in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
Act as point of contact for Procurement reporting, supporting data requests from the Procurement team.
Establish strong relationships with stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and with teams to meet requirements and deadlines.
Knowledge of design and build quality datasets that enable stakeholders to make decisions, provide business recommendations and solutions.
Provide supplier and market intelligence information and analysis to enable effective long-term decision-making and manage risk.
Set up and maintain automated data processes.
Identify, evaluate and implement solutions to support large volume data validation and cleansing.
Monitor and audit data quality.
Design and carry out surveys and analyse survey data.
Focus on leading indicators and improving the function through effective analysis and reporting.
Mine and analyse large datasets, draw valid inferences and present them successfully to management.
Active participation in cross business working to support development of data management processes and process policies.


What You Will Bring


Good knowledge in analytics and reporting covering complex range of sub disciplines including – process, performance and supplier risk management.
MS Office proficient, with expert level in MS Excel and Power BI.
Extensive SAP user experience.
Methodical and diligent with good planning abilities.
Excellent interpersonal/communication and presentation skills, including the proven ability to influence at all levels, internally and externally.
Able to work unsupervised and can operate well as part of a team.
An understanding of Supply Chain and Procurement principles, techniques and practices
Self-motivated, able to identify & drive key issues.
Demonstrate collaborative and supportive behaviours. The ability to build strong and trusted relationships to achieve objectives.

Quality Data Analyst

Burgess Hill, UK (Hybrid)
Permanent

£45k per annum

iO Associates has partnered with a global Semiconductor organisation to hire a Quality & Warranty Data Analyst to help transform complex and fragmented quality/warranty data into trusted, accessible, and actionable insight.

This role will focus on building and maintaining data models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide a consistent, standardised view of quality and warranty performance across regional and global stakeholders. A key objective is creating a "single source of truth" to reduce local analysis effort and allow teams to focus on improvement initiatives rather than data preparation.

Key Responsibilities:



Develop, maintain, and continuously improve quality and warranty dashboards used by regional and global stakeholders
Consolidate and connect data from multiple business systems into reliable and consistent reporting datasets
Analyse complex, interconnected data sources to identify trends, anomalies, and performance drivers
Build and maintain data structures, calculations, and reporting logic underpinning the Quality team's reporting foundations
Deliver accurate, timely insights to support decision-making across Quality, Engineering, Service, Operations, and senior leadership
Partner with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate them into practical dashboards and analytical solutions
Improve data quality through validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and ongoing monitoring
Create standardised reporting solutions to reduce duplication across regions/product companies
Support forecasting, performance measurement, and continuous improvement activities through robust analysis
Maintain documentation, definitions, and reporting standards to ensure consistency and transparency



Requirements:



Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering (or similar discipline)
2-5 years' experience in data analysis, reporting, and/or BI roles
Strong analytical capability across large and complex datasets
Hands-on dashboarding/reporting experience (Power BI, Tableau, or similar)
Solid knowledge of data modelling, data transformation, and reporting best practice
Strong SQL and data manipulation skills
Able to communicate insights clearly and present data in a business-friendly format
High attention to detail, strong ownership of data accuracy and integrity
Able to manage multiple priorities and work independently
Experience working with data from multiple systems/sources is beneficial



Why this role:

You'll work with some of the most complex quality and warranty datasets in the organisation and help shape how data is used across a global business. Your work will directly support strategic decision-making and enable teams to be proactive (not reactive) in driving continuous customer quality improvement.

If you're interested, please send your CV to a.kumar@ioassociates.co.uk.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The role:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Data Science & Insight Team as a Data Analyst. We have a wide-ranging client list, working with some of the biggest and most innovative brands in the UK across publishing, retail, financial services, utilities, leisure, gaming, and beyond, helping to support clients with their marketing activities. The team is responsible for the delivery of CACI’s portfolio of data products, which describe people and places in terms of demographics, behaviours, and attitudes.




What you’ll be doing:

Delivering our Data Products: Either through standard off-the-shelf packages or using complex code to ingest and wrangle client data, the core part of your job will be working to ensure that our clients are able to access and use our data in the most effective way.
Interacting with Clients: We work closely with the sales teams and account managers, so you’ll join them in conversations with clients to help them gain deeper insight into their customers.
Innovation: We are always looking to develop new techniques and improve the efficiency of our existing processes. You’ll have the chance to join a “lab”, where we work collaboratively in small groups, focused on areas such as Automation, Image Analysis and Generative AI.
Data Science and Visualisation: Once you’ve built up your knowledge of our data and processes, we’ll provide you with the opportunities to work on a variety of data science and data visualisation projects, which typically use CACI data in conjunction with information held by clients on their customers to deliver insight and recommendations. These would draw on a range of different software and analytical techniques and include the presentation of findings to external stakeholders.




How we’ll help you get started:

You’ll be learning from day one, and we aim to get you delivering projects within a week or so. We’ll train you on the job, so while we expect you to show that you have a great problem-solving mind, we don’t expect you to arrive knowing how to write the code we use day-to-day. The team is fun and close-knit, and you will have as much support as you need from your colleagues, many of whom are also recent graduates.




What we require of you:

You have a 1st or 2:1 degree in a numerate subject
You are personable, adaptable, inquisitive and eager to learn
You have a keen eye for detail and quality
You love solving problems
You enjoy talking to people
You are organised and are comfortable working on several projects at once
You like to work as part of a team

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Moon Commerce

Moon Commerce Limited is a UK-registered technology company building and operating digital ventures across commerce, consulting, property and SaaS. We trade online, advise businesses on digital transformation and data-driven marketing, and are developing an AI-powered automation platform that turns repetitive processes into scalable systems.

We're small and early-stage, which means the person in this role will see the whole business rather than one corner of it.

The role

Our data currently lives in separate places — sales platforms, ad accounts, client reporting, and internal systems. You'll bring it together and turn it into reporting the team actually uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with direct mentoring from the leadership team. You won't be maintaining someone else's dashboards; you'll be building the reporting layer from the ground up.

What you'll do

Build and maintain dashboards covering trading performance, marketing spend and client delivery
Extract, clean and join data from multiple sources
Turn business questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations people can act on
Own weekly and monthly reporting across our ventures
Support pricing, inventory and campaign decisions with evidence
Document your work so it survives you

Your first three months

Month 1: learn the ventures, map where every data source lives, fix the reporting that's most broken
Month 2: ship your first dashboard into weekly use
Month 3: Own the monthly reporting pack end to end

What we're looking for

Minimum 2 years' hands-on SQL experience
Python (pandas) or strong Excel, plus Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio
At least one project you can walk us through end to end and defend the decisions in
Clear written and spoken English; you'll present to non-technical people
Attention to detail and a habit of checking your own numbers
Right to work in the UK — we cannot offer sponsorship
Able to work from our [area] office 2 days a week

Nice to have

eCommerce, marketplace or digital marketing data experience
GA4, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central or similar
Any exposure to Git

What we offer

Salary £35,000–£39,000 depending on experience
25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays
Office closed between Christmas and New Year
Workplace pension with [15 ]% employer contributions]
Hybrid working — 2 days a week at our [area] office, 37.5 hours, permanent
£[3750] annual learning budget for courses and certifications
Direct mentoring from the leadership team and exposure across every venture
Real ownership of your work and a short path to broader responsibility

Hiring process

20-minute introductory call
45-minute technical conversation including a short SQL exercise
30-minute conversation with the founding team

We aim to give a decision within a week of the final stage, and we give feedback either way.

Reporting to: Technology Lead

Visa sponsorship: We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK.

Equal opportunities

Moon Commerce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions on merit. If you need any adjustment to the application or interview process, tell us and we'll arrange it.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Must hold valid SC Clearance




Made Tech wants to positively impact the country's future by using technology to improve society, for everyone. We want to empower the public sector to deliver and continuously improve digital services that are user-centric, data-driven and freed from legacy technology. A key component of this is developing modern data systems and platforms that drive informed decision-making for our clients. You will also work closely with clients to help shape their data strategy.




Key Responsibilities

As a Data Analyst, you may play one or more roles according to our clients' needs. The role is very hands-on and you'll support as contributor for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.

You’ll need to have a drive to deliver outcomes for users. You’ll make sure that the wider context of a delivery is considered and maintain alignment between the operational and analytical aspects of the engineering solution.




Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues.




Data Management

Good understanding of data sources and storage: Familiarity with common data sources and general knowledge of data organisation and storage practices. Willingness to maintain data accuracy and accessibility.
Awareness of data governance: Understanding of data governance standards and a commitment to following data quality practices set by the team.
Continuous improvement: Ability to contribute to improvements in data management practices by supporting documentation, learning from team training, and actively participating in discussions.
Toolset support: Experience with using data management tools, with a willingness to learn more about maintaining efficiency and integration.
Interest in automation: An interest in learning how to automate data management activities to streamline processes and improve accuracy (desirable).
Compliance with data governance policies: Basic understanding of data governance policies, with a focus on following data security and ethical standards.




Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Exposure to data integration tools: Basic experience with ETL tools for data integration and storage, with a focus on learning how to ensure data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Some experience working with other data professionals, with a focus on learning and improving data modelling and integration practices through teamwork.




Data Visualisation

Understanding visualisation requirements: Ability to understand data visualisation needs and create simple, visually appealing representations suited to the audience.
Good working knowledge of visualisation tools: Experience using tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Python libraries (e.g., Matplotlib, Seaborn), with a willingness to learn how to choose the right visualisation type for different data sets.
Awareness of visualisation standards: Understanding of design principles to create clear and accurate visualisations, with an interest in learning about accessibility best practices.
Willingness to learn from peers: Open to feedback and guidance from senior team members to improve the quality of your visualisations.




Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Familiarity with data quality assessment techniques, such as data profiling and cleansing, with a willingness to learn more about improving data accuracy and consistency.
Data validation and linkage: Experience performing basic data validation checks and combining data from different sources, with guidance from senior team members.
Data cleansing and preparation: Experience in data preparation, including handling missing values and duplicates, with a focus on learning more advanced data cleansing techniques.
Communication of data limitations: Ability to discuss data limitations with guidance from others, helping stakeholders understand potential issues and make informed decisions.
Participating in peer reviews: Willingness to participate in peer reviews to improve data accuracy, with the support of more experienced team members.




Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methods: Familiarity with common statistical techniques like hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and basic clustering, with an eagerness to learn how to choose the right methods for different projects.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience using statistical software or programming languages for data analysis, with guidance in generating insights and sharing findings with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Willingness to learn new methodologies: Interest in exploring and applying new statistical techniques, with support from senior team members, to solve real-world problems and stay updated on emerging theories.




Communication

Stakeholder communication: Some experience working with different types of stakeholders, both technical and business-focused, with a focus on learning to manage expectations and contribute to productive discussions.
Willingness to engage in active and reactive communication: Comfortable sharing updates and responding to inquiries, with support from team members, to help maintain a collaborative working environment.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand basic stakeholder requirements and help translate them into technical solutions, with guidance in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical individuals.
Presentation skills: Experience presenting data and insights, with a focus on learning how to simplify complex information for various audiences, including senior team members.




Logical and creative thinking

Problem-solving skills: Ability to apply logical thinking to break down simpler problems and contribute to generating solutions, with support from more experienced team members.
Decision-making and action-taking: Experience in making informed decisions and prioritising tasks, with guidance to take appropriate actions in resolving issues efficiently.
Adaptability and learning orientation: Willingness to adapt to new challenges and a strong desire to learn and improve continuously.




Job Benefits

Support in applying

If you need this job description in another format, or other support in applying, please email talent@madetech.com.




We believe we can use tech to make public services better. We also believe this can happen best when our own team represents the society that actually uses the services we work on. We’re collectively continuing to grow a culture that is happy, healthy, safe and inspiring for people of all backgrounds and experiences, so we encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply for roles with us.

This includes alternative formats for documents, the time allotted for interviews and any other needs. We also welcome any feedback on how we can improve the experience for future candidates.

Data is at the heart of how we run our business, starting from where to open our gyms, through what we offer within them, to how we engage with past, current, and future members. Combining the data from our 2.5+ million members with data about locations, operations, and performance allows us to unlock industry leading insights and drive a better member experience and commercial performance.

As an Insights Analyst you will be at the heart of solving some of the hardest data challenges in the business, turning data into insights and business value through a combination of in-depth analysis and reporting creation. You will be leveraging one of the biggest fitness data assets in the world, and working with state-of-the-art technologies, to help determine what drives member behaviour and commercial outcomes across all our operating geographies.




The Role

As a small, agile team, Insights works closely with its stakeholders, putting data at the heart of decision making across the business. While reporting to the Insights Manager, in this role you get to work closely with stakeholders at all levels across the business. You will also work in close collaboration with the wider Insights & Analytics functions, which provides ample opportunity to learn from a group of talented and experienced Data Scientists and Data Engineers.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

Work on business-critical analytics projects and reporting, identifying outcomes and communicating findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the business - Commercial, Finance, Operational and Marketing teams, in addition to Data Science and Data Engineering.
Build and maintain the central data product serving KPIs and insights to the entire organisation.
Work with Azure Databricks, PowerBI and dbt technology, leveraging modern cloud-native technologies and data lakehouse architecture.
Drive continuous improvement to how we enable data driven decision making in PureGym.




The Person

We would expect some or all of the following:

Experience in data analytics / insights
Proficient with SQL, Power BI, Excel and PowerPoint
Additionally, experience with dbt would be an advantage
A drive to turn insights into compelling stories for stakeholders to understand, for them to make more effective, data-led decisions
Strong commercial awareness with an interest in B2C

Excellent problem-solving: someone who enjoys applying their mind to many and varied business problems and be a driving force behind solving them
Innovative and curious: constantly seek to learn and find new and better ways of doing things; not just solving problems but seeking them out; always interested to find new and better methods and technologies
Biased towards action: take the initiative and get things done under their own steam and in collaboration with others

A great communicator: able to translate complex concepts and analyses into digestible recommendations that can be easily interpreted and acted upon

Title: Senior Data Analyst - SC cleared
Description:
Must hold a valid Security Clearance




As a Senior Data Analyst at Made Tech, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping public sector organisations become truly data-led. You’ll join our data team in its mission to get data knowledge and skills out of silos and embedded into delivery teams. You will provide advanced data modelling, predictive analytics, and data visualisation, allowing us to deliver more sophisticated and customised solutions to our clients.




The role is very hands-on and you'll support as a senior contributor role for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.
Mentoring junior analysts, leading data-focused projects, and setting best practices in data analysis

Key responsibilities

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication and persuasion skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues. Ability to foster collaboration and address concerns to ensure adherence to best practices.
Advisory and critique skills: Capability to advise on the choice and application of analytical techniques and critique colleagues' findings to ensure high standards in data analysis.

Data Management

Understanding of data sources and storage: Knowledge of various data sources, data organisation, and storage practices. Commitment to maintaining data integrity and accessibility.
Advocacy for data governance: Experience in advocating for data governance standards and influencing team adherence to data quality practices.
Continuous improvement: Ability to communicate and implement continuous improvements in data management practices through documentation, training, and regular team engagement.
Toolset management: Proficiency in defining and supporting common toolsets for data management, ensuring efficiency and seamless integration.
Automation of data management: Experience in automating data management activities to streamline processes and increase accuracy. (desirable)
Compliance with data governance policies: Understanding and ensuring compliance with data governance policies, maintaining data security and ethical standards.

Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data modelling expertise: Proficient in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Ability to adhere to data modelling standards and best practices.
Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Use of data integration tools: Skilled in using ETL tools for data integration and storage. Ensures data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Experience collaborating with other data professionals to improve modelling and integration standards and patterns.

Data Visualisation

Interpretation of requirements: Ability to interpret data visualisation requirements and create meaningful, visually appealing representations tailored to the audience.
Proficiency in visualisation tools: Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn. Knowledge of selecting appropriate visualisation types.
Application of visualisation standards: Application of design principles to create clear, accurate, and accessible visualisations. Awareness of accessibility considerations.
Mentorship in visualisation: Experience in reviewing and advising junior members to improve the quality and efficiency of data visualisations.

Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Experience in implementing processes for data quality assessment and improvement, including data profiling, cleansing, and standardisation.
Data validation and linkage: Ability to perform data validation checks and integrate data from various sources to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Data cleansing and preparation: Proficiency in defining data cleansing processes and preparing data for analysis by handling missing values, outliers, and duplicates.
Communication of data limitations: Skilled in articulating data constraints and limitations to stakeholders, providing context for informed decision-making.
Peer review and quality control: Experience in conducting peer reviews to validate data outputs, ensuring high standards of accuracy and reliability.

Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methodologies: Proficient in various statistical methods, such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, and time series analysis. Ability to select appropriate techniques based on project requirements.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience in using statistical software or programming languages to perform data analysis and generate insights. Skilled in communicating findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Application of emerging theory: Willingness to explore and apply new statistical methodologies or practices to solve practical problems and adapt to emerging theories.

Skills, knowledge and expertise

Communication

Stakeholder communication: Experience in effectively engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, including technical and business individuals. Ability to manage expectations and facilitate productive discussions.
Active and reactive communication: Proficiency in handling both proactive communication (updates, insights) and reactive communication (responding to inquiries, addressing concerns) to maintain a collaborative atmosphere.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Logical and creative thinking

Problem-solving approach: Ability to apply logical and creative thinking to resolve complex problems by breaking them down and generating innovative solutions.
Decision-making and action-taking: Skilled in making informed decisions, prioritising tasks, and taking appropriate actions to resolve issues efficiently.
Adaptability and learning orientation: Demonstrates adaptability in strategies and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.
