Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

  • Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
  • Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.

What You'll Bring

  • Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
  • Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
  • Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

  • Engaging development opportunities at all levels.

  • Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.

Title: Senior Data Analyst

We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.



Our Group Functions provide the services that all areas of the business need. This requires a talented and diverse team behind the scenes, who enable everyone at L&G to do what they do best. 



Joining us means helping to improve the lives of our customers and contributing to the success of the business every day.



This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description



We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Global Markets team, where you will play a key role in enabling data-led decision-making across a fast-paced, front-office environment. This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau and exposure to advanced analytics or machine learning is advantageous

Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:



The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance -related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
Generous pension contribution
Life assurance
Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
Competitive family leave
Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


Additional Information



At L&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.



If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.



We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part-time, term-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.



It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Turner & Townsend we're passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people realise their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.



Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 130 countries worldwide.



Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and collaborative culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity, and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people enjoy working on some of the most exciting programmes in the world.





Job Description



Due to growing demand for our services we are seeking to recruit experienced Data Analysts at Consultant, Senior Consultant & Principal Consultant levels to join our team. The role involves supporting a wide range of project commissions and major programmes and we are seeking individuals with a demonstrable track record of delivery in a consultancy environment.



The Opportunity:



The responsibilities of the Data Analyst will include, but are not limited to:



Providing technical expertise and support to non-experts
Developing multi-faceted reports with recommendations to senior management
Development, analysis and maintenance of corporate datasets
Provide guidance and advice on data quality issues to a wide variety of data providers
Develop / use, the mechanisms employed by clients to recharge manpower against projects
Responsible for visibility, accuracy and transparency of the project critical path
Preparing presentation and other materials for client pitches.
Inputting key information into the Turner & Townsend internal database tools.


Qualifications



Required Skills



Minimum 2 years’ experience working as a Data Analyst
Strong analytic and numeracy skills with the ability to understand and present data in different representations
Demonstrable track record in Data Analysis; identifying requirements and documenting these using the appropriate types of tools and documentation
Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes
End to end experience from project launch to ongoing operation of data, analytics and reporting projects
Ability to identify and run different business and model scenarios
Strong communicator, (both written and verbal), to liaise with the client, contractors and designers
Excellent capability in the use of Excel with ability to write macros to create automated dashboards, graphs and tables
A-Level equivalent in mathematics and/or computing

Desirable Skills & Experience



Experience in an Infrastructure or Defence environment
PRINCE2 / Agile Certification or experience gained
Degree educated or equivalent in an analytic subject
Understanding of Business Improvement Techniques
Ability, or desire to learn, to programme in languages such as VBA and SQL


Additional Information



Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.



We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.



Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.



Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

Instagram



LinkedIn

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

Location: Very flexible - we’re happy for folks to work WFH and lots of us do. We only ask that you come into our London office a couple of times a month for team strategy days and socials - but of course, you're more than welcome to come in as much as you like! (+ we're working a 4 day work week - Fridays off!) 🏡

Contract: Permanent

Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 + benefits listed below




About Cuvva

We're on a mission to give everyone affordable access to a car anytime, anywhere 🚙




We offer short-term car insurance through our world-class app, creating truly flexible products that meet people’s real needs. Using lightning-fast technology to unlock better experiences and fairer prices for our customers, Cuvva is building the future of insurance every day.




Cuvva was the first to sell hourly insurance via an app in the UK back in 2016. And we haven’t stopped innovating since. We’ve sold over 16 million policies, and supported over 1.5 million drivers and we’re just getting started. We’re a team of 100 people, passionate about solving our customers’ problems. Join us. 🚀




Our Data & BI Stack:




Data & Analytics: SQL, Python, Sagemaker, Jupyter
Bi & Visualisation: Looker, Power BI
Data & Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform & wider cloud data environment
Product & Collaboration: Notion, Miro, Figma
AI & Data Science: Python based science tooling and emerging AI capabilities




About the role:

We’re looking for a commercially minded, technically strong individual contributor to join our Business Intelligence team at Cuvva. You’ll report to BI Management, working on some of the most interesting data and analytical problems across our insurance business.




We’re deliberately keeping this role broad. You might currently be working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or BI Manager, but what matters most is the depth of your analytical thinking, your understanding of insurance, and your ability to turn data into better commercial decisions.




You’ll work with complex datasets to understand performance, identify trends and opportunities, and help us make smarter decisions about our products and our business. You’ll bring industry knowledge, strong statistical reasoning, hands-on experience with SQL and Python, and the curiosity to dig beyond the obvious answer. You’ll be comfortable moving between detailed analysis and the bigger commercial question: what does this tell us, and what should we do about it?




Insurance experience is important to us, particularly within personal lines. Motor insurance is especially relevant, but we'd also consider strong candidates from other personal lines backgrounds such as home or pet. You’ll bring an understanding of how insurance businesses operate, the role data plays in pricing and performance, and the commercial factors that sit behind the numbers.




You’ll have the opportunity to work across areas including performance monitoring, pricing, product analytics, marketing, data science and AI, partnering with teams across Cuvva to turn analysis into action. We’re looking for someone who can challenge thinking, spot opportunities, explain complex ideas clearly and help us make better decisions through data.




On a day-to-day basis you’ll:




Manipulate, analyse and interpret datasets to provide insights and recommendations that help our business make better decisions
Work directly with our Head of Product to size opportunities before we build them, and to measure the impact of what we've shipped once it's live
Design and interpret A/B tests and feature rollouts, with a clear view on what the result means for the product and wider business
Work day to day with behavioural data, using funnel analysis and event tracking to connect app behaviour with policy, pricing and claims data
Analyse pricing, business and product performance, identifying trends, opportunities and areas where deeper investigation is needed
Follow analysis through to claims and loss ratio, so we understand the risk and commercial impact of what we ship, not just conversion
Own metric definitions and contribute to our semantic layer, helping ensure the business works from a consistent version of each number
Collaborate with BI and Data Engineering colleagues on analytical and data projects
Drive self-serve analytics across the business by coaching stakeholders and building the dashboards, metrics and documentation they need to answer their own questions
Support the Product team as we launch and iterate on new products and features




You’ll do great here if you have:




Experience working with data in the insurance industry, ideally within personal lines and preferably motor
Strong statistical reasoning, and can explain what an analysis does and doesn't support, including the assumptions and limitations behind your conclusions
A strong commercial mindset and can connect analysis to business performance, customer outcomes and commercial decisions
Are highly proficient in SQL and Python, being comfortable using Python for analysis, modelling and problem solving
Can work confidently with complex datasets, joining information from different sources to uncover insights and answer ambiguous questions
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner with senior stakeholders, ask the right questions and challenge thinking when needed
Excellent communication skills and can turn complex analysis into a clear story, recommendation or decision for your audience
Are comfortable working across functions and collaborating with BI, Data Engineering, Product, Pricing and other teams to solve problems
Experience working as a Data Analyst, Pricing Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Analyst or in a similar analytical role
Are curious about new approaches to data, including data science and AI, and are interested in how they can improve the way we make decisions
The ability to take an ambiguous business problem, work out what we need to know, and independently take it from question through analysis and recommendation




It’s a bonus if you have:




Have designed, run or interpreted experiments, A/B tests or feature rollouts
Have worked with a behavioural analytics tool such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4 alongside a data warehouse
Have experience with machine learning models, including understanding how their performance and accuracy are evaluated




The hiring process: (All interviews are held remotely)




Initial chat with hiring manager (60m)
Technical interview & live challenge with peers (90m)
Values interview with People team & stakeholders (45m)
Founders chat with our CEO, Freddy (20m)




Benefits:




As well as a competitive salary (£80,000 - £100,000 depending on experience), benefits of working at Cuvva include:




Very flexible WFH set up, we only ask folks to come in a couple of times a month for team strategy days and socials - but of course, you're more than welcome to come in as much as you like!
A four day work week (Fridays off!)
An office worth visiting - Old Sessions House is a stunning private members club with a rooftop, infinity pool and regular members events. Not your average workplace!
Transparent salary model and bands for all roles (without sharing anyone's individual salary of course!)
20.5 days of holiday a year + public holidays - rising with each year at Cuvva 🌞 (holidays have been prorated based on our 4DWW)
Quarterly team socials and company events
Private medical insurance with Bupa
Professional development budget
Health, WFH and wellbeing budget 🧘 ♂️
Increases to all allowances year on year
Enhanced parental leave and pay
Cycle to work scheme
Mental Health and Coaching Support - We offer free and confidential access to comprehensive mental healthcare and coaching through Oliva. Giving you the space to talk to a coach or therapist about anything you like
Hundreds of perks and discounts with Perkbox
£100 a month towards your Cuvva car insurance
Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join the Cuvva team 💸




Referrals:

Know someone who could be right for this job? We’d love to hear from them, please drop us a note at jobs@cuvva.com to let us know who you'll be referring and for which role. If they get the job, you will receive an Apple Watch! If someone has already applied to the role before we receive your email they will not be considered a referral, so please check with them beforehand to make sure 🙂




Cuvva ways of working:

We’re dedicated to creating a place where people want to work, a place where people believe in what they’re doing, have clear expectations and a bunch of freedom.




Our approach to hybrid working is very flexible: we only ask people to come a couple of times a month for team building or company events. The rest of time it’s up to you where and how you work. You can of course come into the office as much as you like!




Diversity, inclusion and belonging at Cuvva:

At Cuvva, we’re dedicated to building an environment where individuals from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging and have the support they need to thrive. To us, it’s crucial that our differences are embraced and celebrated - and that you’re able to bring your whole self to work everyday.




Research shows that men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, but women and those in traditionally underrepresented groups tend to apply only if they check all the boxes. If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit.

Title: Senior Reporting Analyst
Description:
Why This Role Matters

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing


Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation.
Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions.
Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently.
Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence.
Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth.
Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact.


What You’ll Bring


Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights.
Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel.
A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations.
Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance.
Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences.
Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making.
A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes.


How You Will Make An Impact


Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance.
Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most.
Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes.
Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability.
Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities.
Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness.
Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.


Who We Are

You may not have heard of us, but you’ll know our brands! AS Watson is the world’s largest international health and beauty retailer, with over 17,000 stores across 31 markets serving over 5.3 billion customers each year.

From Superdrug, Kruidvat and Watsons to Marionnaud, The Perfume Shop and many more, our brands are loved by customers around the world. Behind them are passionate people who are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow.

What You’ll Get From Us


Competitive Salary and Bonus Scheme

Holiday entitlement
Hybrid Working Model

Description:
Job Description

Job Title: Senior Data Analyst

Location: Canary Wharf, London

Business Unit: Global Financial Services (GFS)

Vacancy type: Permanent

Working Hours: 9am-5.30pm GMT. Hybrid with 3 days onsite.

The Position

The Senior Data Analyst within CSC Global Financial Services (GFS)'s Insights team will own the delivery of analytics solutions that drive strategic decision-making across the business. This is a hands-on, high-impact role requiring expertise in BI platforms, SQL - combined with the leadership ability to influence stakeholders, and drive data governance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Insights


Lead complex, cross-functional data analyses to uncover strategic insights that inform commercial, operational, and financial decisions across the Capital Markets business unit.
Independently scope, design, and deliver analytics projects from requirements gathering through to executive presentation - with minimal supervision.


Dashboard & Reporting Architecture


Architect, build, and govern a suite of Domo dashboards and reports serving Leadership, Commercial, Product Operations, and Finance - ensuring scalability, performance, and data accuracy.
Define and enforce dashboard standards, naming conventions, and best practices across the Insights team.


Data Quality & Governance


Define and enforce data quality standards, validation frameworks, and reconciliation processes across all analytics outputs.
Document data definitions, lineage, and business logic to support audit readiness and team scalability.


Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership


Serve as a trusted analytics partner to senior stakeholders across Product Operations, Commercial, Finance, and Leadership - translating complex data into clear, executive-ready narratives.
Drive alignment on analytics priorities, manage competing stakeholder requests, and communicate timelines and trade-offs effectively.


Required Skills & Experience:


4-7 years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Demonstrated track record of leading analytics projects end-to-end in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Prior experience in financial services, capital markets, or fund administration is a strong plus.
Proficiency in Domo - including DataFlows, Beast Mode, Domo Everywhere, and connector management. Power BI or Tableau considered in lieu.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, ETL pipelines, and enterprise data integration (SAP, NetSuite, Denodo a plus).
Exceptional ability to present complex data findings to non-technical and executive audiences with clarity and confidence.
Strong project ownership mindset - able to manage multiple workstreams, set priorities, and deliver without heavy oversight.


Why Join Our Team?


Lead analytics strategy for a high-visibility business unit within a globally recognized financial services organization.
Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge BI and Agentic AI capabilities within Domo, shaping how the team uses AI to accelerate insight delivery.
Work on strategic, high-stakes projects with direct influence on Capital Markets revenue and operational decisions.
Join a collaborative, innovation-driven team that invests in professional growth and values data-driven thinking at every level.


If you are a senior analytics professional who thrives on turning complex data into strategic impact, we want to hear from you.

CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®

Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.

CSC is committed to creating a feeling of belonging through a diverse and growth-oriented environment where everyone is valued.

CSC colleagues have global career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers .

CSC only accepts resumes from employment agencies that are part of our approved supplier program. Resumes submitted from other agencies either to talent acquisition, our hiring leaders, employees, or through any other mechanism other than our supplier process, will not be eligible to claim related fees and the submitted resumes will be considered property of CSC.

We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third-party sources.

At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to innovate, challenge the status quo, and anticipate the needs of our clients. We exceed expectations by adapting client ambitions and goals as our own. This Fierce Client Spirit has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 125 years. It’s also the reason we’re the trusted partner of many of the world’s most successful organizations.

CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose values align with ours. We empower our colleagues to bring the right solutions to market to meet client demand. That’s why we are the leading provider of business administration and compliance solutions.


CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
We have won several employer recognition awards, including Top Workplace USA, Great Places to Work India, and Built In’s Best Places to Work.
We offer fulfilling work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

We are seeking a curious and commercially minded Data Analyst to join our growing team at CompassRock. While this role is based in the residential rental sector, we actively welcome applications from professionals with experience in hospitality, airlines, or broader real estate industries—particularly those who bring a passion for elevating customer experience through data-driven decisions.

Our mission is to redefine urban renting—delivering a seamless, service-led living experience. Your analysis will directly inform pricing strategies, marketing performance, resident satisfaction, leasing effectiveness, and broader commercial planning across our portfolio.

Company Overview

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sector. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across England and Europe. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, the company values the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs. As CompassRock continues to expand, there will be abundant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

What You'll Do


Leverage large datasets to generate actionable insights around resident behaviour, leasing trends, retention, and demand drivers.
Support the leasing and revenue teams by identifying opportunities for rent optimization, concession planning, and lead conversion improvement.
Monitor and analyse digital marketing channel performance (e.g. PPC, aggregators, OTAs), particularly for lease-ups and new openings.
Benchmark operational and service KPIs—occupancy, turnaround times, customer service touchpoints—across sites or regions.
Translate data into clear visual dashboards and compelling presentations for senior stakeholders.
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, leasing, revenue management and operations to improve the end-to-end resident experience.


Who We're Looking For


Proven analytical experience in BTR, hospitality, airlines, hotels, or real estate.
Experience in building and structuring datasets or data cubes to support scalable reporting and analytics—ideally with a view to implementing BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Proficient in working with large datasets using tools like SQL and Excel.
A commercial mindset with the ability to link data insights to real business outcomes.
Strong communication skills—you know how to turn complex numbers into actionable recommendations.
Curious, collaborative, and highly adaptable.


Bonus If You Have


Experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, or marketing attribution.
Exposure to customer or guest satisfaction data (e.g. NPS, reviews, feedback tools).
Previous work with leasing systems or property management software.


Renumeration / Bonuses / Benefits


Salary: Competitive
Bonuses: Discretionary Bonus Scheme
Benefits: a) Company Pension Scheme; b) Vitality Private Healthcare Insurance; c) Company Sick Pay; d) Bike to Work Scheme
Working Hours: 40 hour working week
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent, 4x work from the office, 1x WFH
Location: Oxford Street, London (Corporate Head Office)


Equal Opportunities Statement

We are an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We provide equal opportunities for everyone and offer reasonable adjustments to ensure all candidates have a fair chance during the recruitment process.

Title: Quality Data Analyst
Description:
Your role

Bring your curiosity to work as our next Quality Data Analyst. You will join the Quality team supporting the three Semiconductor divisions, reporting to the Global Warranty Specialist. In this role, your mission will focus on transforming complex and fragmented quality and warranty data into trusted, accessible, and actionable information that enables faster and better business decisions.

Your day to day

You will be responsible for developing and maintaining data models, dashboards, reporting solutions, and analytical tools that deliver a consistent view of quality and warranty performance across the Semiconductor business. A key objective is to establish a single source of truth that minimizes the need for local analysis and enables regional teams to concentrate on improvement activities rather than data preparation.

Main Responsibilities Include


Develop and maintain quality and warranty dashboards for regional and global stakeholders.
Consolidate and transform data from multiple systems into reliable, consistent reporting datasets.
Analyse complex data to identify trends, anomalies and key performance drivers.
Build and maintain data models, calculations and reporting logic to support a single source of truth.
Partner with stakeholders across Quality, Engineering, Service and Operations to translate business needs into practical reporting and analytical solutions.
Improve data quality and reporting standards through validation, cleansing, reconciliation, documentation and standardisation.


Your Skills And Experience


Degree in Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
2-5 years' experience working with data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence solutions.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large and complex datasets.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
Knowledge of data modelling, data transformation, and reporting best practices.
Strong SQL and data manipulation skills.
Ability to communicate findings clearly and present data in a meaningful way to business stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
Experience working with data from multiple systems and sources would be advantageous.


We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

Your Compensation And Benefits

At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent.

Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work.

Title: Insights Analyst
Description:
Insights Analyst



£45,000-£50,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits

London - Hybrid

Cedar are partnering with an organisation undergoing a significant business and technology transformation, with data and analytics playing a central role in improving operational performance and driving better decision-making. As part of this investment, an opportunity has arisen for an Insights Analyst to join a growing analytics function and help shape how data is used across the business.

This is not a traditional reporting role. We are looking for someone who enjoys investigating problems, challenging assumptions and turning complex data into meaningful insights that influence business decisions.





The Opportunity



You will work closely with stakeholders across the organisation, supporting transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities for improvement, understanding operational challenges and providing the insight needed to drive change.

Key responsibilities will include:

Analysing operational, commercial and business performance data to identify trends, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
Working with stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into structured analytical questions.
Using SQL to extract, manipulate and interrogate data from multiple sources.
Conducting root-cause analysis to understand performance issues and recommend practical solutions.
Delivering actionable insights that support transformation, process improvement and strategic decision-making.
Developing dashboards and visualisations using Power BI or similar tools where appropriate.
Challenging existing assumptions and proactively identifying areas where data can improve business outcomes.
Supporting improvements in data quality, consistency and analytical capability across the organisation.






About You



We are interested in speaking with analytical, inquisitive individuals who can demonstrate:

Experience in an Insights Analyst, Data Analyst, Commercial Analyst, Operations Analyst or similar role.
Strong SQL skills and confidence working independently with complex datasets.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or another BI platform.
The ability to investigate ambiguous business problems and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Experience using analysis to influence decisions, improve processes or deliver measurable business outcomes.
A proactive mindset, intellectual curiosity and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working.

Applicants must have the existing right to work in the UK, as visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Title: Data Analyst (Tech Insurance Operations)
Description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and technically capable Data Analyst to support the development of a data-driven claims function. This role will report directly to the Head of Claims and will work closely with TPAs, and Vave’s Underwriting, Operations, and Technology teams.

The Data Analyst will be responsible for extracting, analysing, reconciling, and interpreting claims data to support operational oversight, reserving discipline, TPA performance, underwriting feedback, and portfolio profitability. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with SQL, Excel, data validation, reporting and claims analysis

This is a hands-on role for someone who can transform data into insight, and help the business make better claims, underwriting, and financial decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis


Analyse claims data from internal systems, TPAs data feeds, bordereaux reports, and data warehouses.
Use SQL to query claims databases, validate data quality, build recurring extracts, and support ad hoc analysis.
Work within an Azure Databricks environment, utilising SQL, and Python skills to automate claims analysis and oversight reporting.
Operational reporting, severity analysis, reserving reviews, claims feedback for underwriting.
Identify and investigate data quality concerns.
Translate claims data into clear insights, trends, exceptions, and recommended actions.


Claims MI, Reporting & Dashboards


Shape recurring claims management information, dashboards, KPI packs, and executive reporting.
Track and report on key claim metrics.
Support the creation of board, capacity partner, underwriting, and actuarial reporting packs.


Actuarial & Underwriting Support


Support reserve reviews, loss development analysis, large loss monitoring, data reconciliations, and claims trend analysis.
Partner with Underwriting to provide claim insights that inform risk selection, pricing, appetite, policy wording, exclusions, endorsement, and portfolio strategy.
Support development of claims feedback loops that connect loss experience back to underwriting action.


Rules Engine, Scoring & Claims Intelligence


Support the build-out of claims rules, escalation triggers, severity scoring models and exception reporting.
Participate in UAT for claims systems, rules engines, dashboards, portals, data feeds, and workflow tools.
Translate business requirements from Claims into technical data logic, SQL predicates, reporting rules, and test cases.


Required Experience


3+ years of experience in data analytics within the financial/insurance sector
Ability to work with incomplete, inconsistent, or complex data sources.
Strong SQL querying and data manipulation skills.
Advanced Excel and data reconciliation skills.
Preferred knowledge of any of the following: laims analytics, insurance data analysis, claims operations, actuarial support, underwriting analytics, TPA oversight, or related insurance analytics roles.
Experience working within Azure Databricks (preferred), using notebooks to analyse and transform data, and leveraging Azure data services such as Azure SQL, Data Lake Storage, and cloud-based data platforms.
Experience extracting and analysing data from systems or reporting platforms, including Lloyd’s/delegated authority bordereaux.
Demonstrated ability to analyse complex datasets and present findings in a clear, concise, business-relevant manner.


Preferred Experience


Prior experience with a TPA, MGA, MGU, insurance carrier, or reinsurer within a delegated authority business.
Experience working with Actuarial and Underwriting teams.
Familiarity with claims bordereaux, delegated authority reporting, capacity partner reporting, or reinsurance reporting.
Experience with Databricks, Synapse, or similar analytics tools.
Understanding of claims leakage, severity management, reserve adequacy, litigation trends, fraud indicators, subrogation, and vendor performance.

Title: Senior BI Analyst (Collections & Recoveries)
Description:
Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com !

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We are hiring Senior BI Analysts to join our Collections & Recoveries team.

This role is ideal for technically strong, curious analysts who enjoy using data, reporting and automation to solve meaningful business problems. You will improve access to insight, reduce manual processes and build scalable data solutions that support better decisions across the bank.

The opportunity

This role has a strong BI and reporting focus, with a meaningful element of data modelling and collaboration with Analytics Engineering . You will build trusted data pipelines, establish semantic layers with clearly defined metrics and design self-serve reporting. You will enable analysis at scale and help teams monitor performance, identify opportunities and make informed decisions.

Collections & Recoveries

Helping to deliver better outcomes for customers in financial difficulty through high-quality MI, operational performance insight and process efficiency. You will partner closely with Collections, Operations and Credit Strategy stakeholders to understand performance, improve reporting and support data-led decision making.

A day in the life


Design, build and maintain dashboards using Tableau or similar BI tools
Use SQL to explore data, build structured datasets and deliver repeatable analysis
Partner with stakeholders to understand business problems and turn them into practical analytical solutions
Define, document and maintain clear, trusted metrics
Deliver recurring MI and self-serve reporting that supports operational and risk decision making
Work with Analytics Engineering to design and improve core data models, including modernising stored-procedure logic into maintainable transformations
Improve data quality, reporting standards and the usability of analytics products
Support performance monitoring across either operational or risk-focused domains


About You


Experience in a BI, analytics or reporting role, with a track record of creating reliable production datasets, scalable reporting and self-serve insight
Strong SQL skills and confidence working with large, complex datasets
Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI
Experience with data modelling or dbt, including building robust pipelines and maintaining clear documentation
Strong analytical judgement, attention to detail and focus on data accuracy
Ability to take ambiguous business needs, work productively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and turn them into practical data products
Communicate clearly, constructively challenge and explain complex data concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
An organised, curious approach to problem solving and managing priorities
Python experience would be beneficial but is not essential


Helpful Experience


Experience analysing credit, operational or customer performance metrics would be useful


At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.


Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice


Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030 , we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI . These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Locations- Dublin, London (Bishopsgate), Munich

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our dynamic Underwriting Technical Transformation team within the Health Insurance Line of business. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving innovation and data-driven decision-making in underwriting and pricing.

As a Data Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our centralized data analytics function, which supports technical areas such as underwriting, pricing, and commercial. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including Data Science, Data Program, Portfolio Monitoring, Pricing and Underwriting, to design, build and implement robust data pipelines in order to deliver actionable insights that enhance business performance and customer outcomes.

What You Will Do


Support and participate in the build and delivery of a clear roadmap for the creation and modernization of a robust data environment aimed at ensuring commercial and strategic success for the business
Technically support the design, construction and maintenance of data for the business
Understand and implement database and data engineering concepts and terminology, design principles and elements in order to deliver data and analytics
Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines in order to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes
Coordination of data projects with different levels of complexity depending on existing methods, processes and tools
Collaborate and engage with Data Program and Data Science teams to support the creation, maintenance and enhancement of reports, tools, datasets and dashboards to facilitate analysis and ongoing review of KPIs, e.g. leveraging Power BI
Understand the data relationships that exist between the business processes and systems. In turn apply this knowledge when interpreting the information requirements from the business
Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization in pricing & underwriting processes.
Deliver data outputs into a format for presentation to senior management
Gather, interpret, identify gaps and translate business MI and reporting requirements into solutions
Manages and coordinates stakeholders and builds a robust communication structure for data-related projects
Advises stakeholders and actively clarifies their expectations and requirements
Ability to assume responsibility for change, communication, quality and risk management
AI Readiness Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data, analytics and cloud-based tools, using insights responsibly with our standards of data governance, security and ethical use.


What You Will Need


Bachelor or above in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science) from top tier university
Proven relevant experience (min. 3 years) in data analysis, preferably within the insurance or healthcare sector.
Hands-on experience in writing maintainable and testable production-grade Python in a collaborative approach
Strong proficiency with direct exposure to SQL/ SQL optimization, Git version control, CI/CD practices as well as data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). VBA would be useful
Excellent analytical skills (capable of understanding complex data structures, organize and structure data extracts) with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
Works with little guidance and direction and performs majority of tasks independently.
High attention to detail including a commitment to accuracy of work.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complicated processes and concepts to non-experts and to work effectively with diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
A proactive mindset with a passion for driving change and innovation through data.


Why join us

This is more than just a data analytics role – it’s an opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of health insurance underwriting. You’ll be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, all while working in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

If you’re ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role where your expertise in data analytics can truly make a difference, we’d love to hear from you!

Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement

Data modelling

Excel


Advanced Excel skills, including:

This role is 5 days per week on-site. Please consider this prior to applying, as we are unable to offer hybrid working for this specific role.





Job Description

This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability
Acting as the first point of contact for data and analytics issues, diagnosing and resolving problems
Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions
Enhancing data quality, governance, and accessibility across platforms
Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Who we’re looking for:



Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across relational databases
Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs
Solid understanding of data engineering principles and scalable data architecture
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment
Experience within financial services or a trading environment is beneficial

Life assurance

At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday

There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The role:

This is an exciting opportunity to join the Data Science & Insight Team as a Data Analyst. We have a wide-ranging client list, working with some of the biggest and most innovative brands in the UK across publishing, retail, financial services, utilities, leisure, gaming, and beyond, helping to support clients with their marketing activities. The team is responsible for the delivery of CACI’s portfolio of data products, which describe people and places in terms of demographics, behaviours, and attitudes.




What you’ll be doing:

Delivering our Data Products: Either through standard off-the-shelf packages or using complex code to ingest and wrangle client data, the core part of your job will be working to ensure that our clients are able to access and use our data in the most effective way.
Interacting with Clients: We work closely with the sales teams and account managers, so you’ll join them in conversations with clients to help them gain deeper insight into their customers.
Innovation: We are always looking to develop new techniques and improve the efficiency of our existing processes. You’ll have the chance to join a “lab”, where we work collaboratively in small groups, focused on areas such as Automation, Image Analysis and Generative AI.
Data Science and Visualisation: Once you’ve built up your knowledge of our data and processes, we’ll provide you with the opportunities to work on a variety of data science and data visualisation projects, which typically use CACI data in conjunction with information held by clients on their customers to deliver insight and recommendations. These would draw on a range of different software and analytical techniques and include the presentation of findings to external stakeholders.




How we’ll help you get started:

You’ll be learning from day one, and we aim to get you delivering projects within a week or so. We’ll train you on the job, so while we expect you to show that you have a great problem-solving mind, we don’t expect you to arrive knowing how to write the code we use day-to-day. The team is fun and close-knit, and you will have as much support as you need from your colleagues, many of whom are also recent graduates.




What we require of you:

You have a 1st or 2:1 degree in a numerate subject
You are personable, adaptable, inquisitive and eager to learn
You have a keen eye for detail and quality
You love solving problems
You enjoy talking to people
You are organised and are comfortable working on several projects at once
You like to work as part of a team

Title: Senior Data Analyst - CRM Analytics
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

We are seeking an experienced data analyst to join our CRM Analytics team, supporting both Personal and Business customer segments. As a key member of the Marketing Analytics organisation, you will report to the Manager of CRM Analytics and play a critical role in driving our lifecycle marketing capabilities through rigorous data analysis and actionable insights.

This is a high-impact role where you'll collaborate closely with our CRM, Product, Data Science, and Growth teams. You will help define and execute the measurement framework for CRM initiatives, ensure data quality is top-notch, and provide analytical expertise to truly optimise customer engagement strategies. Your work will directly influence how we acquire, engage, and retain customers by building and running data-driven CRM programs.

Key Responsibilities


Translate complex business questions into clear analytical frameworks, delivering insights that directly drive strategic decisions.
Design and execute in-depth analyses to evaluate campaign performance, customer segmentation, and engagement patterns across the customer lifecycle.

Description:
At Turner & Townsend we're passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people realise their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.



Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects in over 130 countries worldwide.



Our team is dynamic, innovative, and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and collaborative culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity, and the quality we deliver. As a result, our people enjoy working on some of the most exciting programmes in the world.





Job Description



Due to growing demand for our services we are seeking to recruit experienced Data Analysts at Consultant, Senior Consultant & Principal Consultant levels to join our team. The role involves supporting a wide range of project commissions and major programmes and we are seeking individuals with a demonstrable track record of delivery in a consultancy environment.



The Opportunity:



The responsibilities of the Data Analyst will include, but are not limited to:



Providing technical expertise and support to non-experts
Developing multi-faceted reports with recommendations to senior management
Development, analysis and maintenance of corporate datasets
Provide guidance and advice on data quality issues to a wide variety of data providers
Develop / use, the mechanisms employed by clients to recharge manpower against projects
Responsible for visibility, accuracy and transparency of the project critical path
Preparing presentation and other materials for client pitches.
Inputting key information into the Turner & Townsend internal database tools.


Qualifications



Required Skills



Minimum 2 years’ experience working as a Data Analyst
Strong analytic and numeracy skills with the ability to understand and present data in different representations
Demonstrable track record in Data Analysis; identifying requirements and documenting these using the appropriate types of tools and documentation
Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes
End to end experience from project launch to ongoing operation of data, analytics and reporting projects
Ability to identify and run different business and model scenarios
Strong communicator, (both written and verbal), to liaise with the client, contractors and designers
Excellent capability in the use of Excel with ability to write macros to create automated dashboards, graphs and tables
A-Level equivalent in mathematics and/or computing

Desirable Skills & Experience



Experience in an Infrastructure or Defence environment
PRINCE2 / Agile Certification or experience gained
Degree educated or equivalent in an analytic subject
Understanding of Business Improvement Techniques
Ability, or desire to learn, to programme in languages such as VBA and SQL


Additional Information



Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.



We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - SC cleared
Description:
Must hold a valid Security Clearance




As a Senior Data Analyst at Made Tech, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping public sector organisations become truly data-led. You’ll join our data team in its mission to get data knowledge and skills out of silos and embedded into delivery teams. You will provide advanced data modelling, predictive analytics, and data visualisation, allowing us to deliver more sophisticated and customised solutions to our clients.




The role is very hands-on and you'll support as a senior contributor role for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.
Mentoring junior analysts, leading data-focused projects, and setting best practices in data analysis

Key responsibilities

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication and persuasion skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues. Ability to foster collaboration and address concerns to ensure adherence to best practices.
Advisory and critique skills: Capability to advise on the choice and application of analytical techniques and critique colleagues' findings to ensure high standards in data analysis.

Data Management

Understanding of data sources and storage: Knowledge of various data sources, data organisation, and storage practices. Commitment to maintaining data integrity and accessibility.
Advocacy for data governance: Experience in advocating for data governance standards and influencing team adherence to data quality practices.
Continuous improvement: Ability to communicate and implement continuous improvements in data management practices through documentation, training, and regular team engagement.
Toolset management: Proficiency in defining and supporting common toolsets for data management, ensuring efficiency and seamless integration.
Automation of data management: Experience in automating data management activities to streamline processes and increase accuracy. (desirable)
Compliance with data governance policies: Understanding and ensuring compliance with data governance policies, maintaining data security and ethical standards.

Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data modelling expertise: Proficient in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Ability to adhere to data modelling standards and best practices.
Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Use of data integration tools: Skilled in using ETL tools for data integration and storage. Ensures data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Experience collaborating with other data professionals to improve modelling and integration standards and patterns.

Data Visualisation

Interpretation of requirements: Ability to interpret data visualisation requirements and create meaningful, visually appealing representations tailored to the audience.
Proficiency in visualisation tools: Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn. Knowledge of selecting appropriate visualisation types.
Application of visualisation standards: Application of design principles to create clear, accurate, and accessible visualisations. Awareness of accessibility considerations.
Mentorship in visualisation: Experience in reviewing and advising junior members to improve the quality and efficiency of data visualisations.

Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Experience in implementing processes for data quality assessment and improvement, including data profiling, cleansing, and standardisation.
Data validation and linkage: Ability to perform data validation checks and integrate data from various sources to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Data cleansing and preparation: Proficiency in defining data cleansing processes and preparing data for analysis by handling missing values, outliers, and duplicates.
Communication of data limitations: Skilled in articulating data constraints and limitations to stakeholders, providing context for informed decision-making.
Peer review and quality control: Experience in conducting peer reviews to validate data outputs, ensuring high standards of accuracy and reliability.

Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methodologies: Proficient in various statistical methods, such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, and time series analysis. Ability to select appropriate techniques based on project requirements.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience in using statistical software or programming languages to perform data analysis and generate insights. Skilled in communicating findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Application of emerging theory: Willingness to explore and apply new statistical methodologies or practices to solve practical problems and adapt to emerging theories.

Skills, knowledge and expertise

Communication

Stakeholder communication: Experience in effectively engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, including technical and business individuals. Ability to manage expectations and facilitate productive discussions.
Active and reactive communication: Proficiency in handling both proactive communication (updates, insights) and reactive communication (responding to inquiries, addressing concerns) to maintain a collaborative atmosphere.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Logical and creative thinking

Problem-solving approach: Ability to apply logical and creative thinking to resolve complex problems by breaking them down and generating innovative solutions.
Decision-making and action-taking: Skilled in making informed decisions, prioritising tasks, and taking appropriate actions to resolve issues efficiently.
Adaptability and learning orientation: Demonstrates adaptability in strategies and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Job benefits
