Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Moon Commerce

Moon Commerce Limited is a UK-registered technology company building and operating digital ventures across commerce, consulting, property and SaaS. We trade online, advise businesses on digital transformation and data-driven marketing, and are developing an AI-powered automation platform that turns repetitive processes into scalable systems.

We're small and early-stage, which means the person in this role will see the whole business rather than one corner of it.

The role

Our data currently lives in separate places — sales platforms, ad accounts, client reporting, and internal systems. You'll bring it together and turn it into reporting the team actually uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with direct mentoring from the leadership team. You won't be maintaining someone else's dashboards; you'll be building the reporting layer from the ground up.

What you'll do

Build and maintain dashboards covering trading performance, marketing spend and client delivery
Extract, clean and join data from multiple sources
Turn business questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations people can act on
Own weekly and monthly reporting across our ventures
Support pricing, inventory and campaign decisions with evidence
Document your work so it survives you

Your first three months

Month 1: learn the ventures, map where every data source lives, fix the reporting that's most broken
Month 2: ship your first dashboard into weekly use
Month 3: Own the monthly reporting pack end to end

What we're looking for

Minimum 2 years' hands-on SQL experience
Python (pandas) or strong Excel, plus Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio
At least one project you can walk us through end to end and defend the decisions in
Clear written and spoken English; you'll present to non-technical people
Attention to detail and a habit of checking your own numbers
Right to work in the UK — we cannot offer sponsorship
Able to work from our [area] office 2 days a week

Nice to have

eCommerce, marketplace or digital marketing data experience
GA4, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central or similar
Any exposure to Git

What we offer

Salary £35,000–£39,000 depending on experience
25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays
Office closed between Christmas and New Year
Workplace pension with [15 ]% employer contributions]
Hybrid working — 2 days a week at our [area] office, 37.5 hours, permanent
£[3750] annual learning budget for courses and certifications
Direct mentoring from the leadership team and exposure across every venture
Real ownership of your work and a short path to broader responsibility

Hiring process

20-minute introductory call
45-minute technical conversation including a short SQL exercise
30-minute conversation with the founding team

We aim to give a decision within a week of the final stage, and we give feedback either way.

Reporting to: Technology Lead

Visa sponsorship: We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK.

Equal opportunities

Moon Commerce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions on merit. If you need any adjustment to the application or interview process, tell us and we'll arrange it.

Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.

A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.
Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.



Nice-to-have Experience

Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.
Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.
Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.



Bonus Points


A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).
Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

We are seeking a curious and commercially minded Data Analyst to join our growing team at CompassRock. While this role is based in the residential rental sector, we actively welcome applications from professionals with experience in hospitality, airlines, or broader real estate industries—particularly those who bring a passion for elevating customer experience through data-driven decisions.

Our mission is to redefine urban renting—delivering a seamless, service-led living experience. Your analysis will directly inform pricing strategies, marketing performance, resident satisfaction, leasing effectiveness, and broader commercial planning across our portfolio.

Company Overview

CompassRock provides asset and property management services to the rental housing sector. Originally founded in the U.S., the company has expanded to the UK and is rapidly growing its portfolio of Build-to-Rent (BTR) assets across England and Europe. Backed by private equity, CompassRock is in an exciting growth phase, actively acquiring and developing new assets at a fast pace. With an entrepreneurial and innovative culture embedded in its DNA, the company values the dynamic, forward-thinking individuals it employs. As CompassRock continues to expand, there will be abundant opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

What You'll Do


Leverage large datasets to generate actionable insights around resident behaviour, leasing trends, retention, and demand drivers.
Support the leasing and revenue teams by identifying opportunities for rent optimization, concession planning, and lead conversion improvement.
Monitor and analyse digital marketing channel performance (e.g. PPC, aggregators, OTAs), particularly for lease-ups and new openings.
Benchmark operational and service KPIs—occupancy, turnaround times, customer service touchpoints—across sites or regions.
Translate data into clear visual dashboards and compelling presentations for senior stakeholders.
Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, leasing, revenue management and operations to improve the end-to-end resident experience.


Who We're Looking For


Proven analytical experience in BTR, hospitality, airlines, hotels, or real estate.
Experience in building and structuring datasets or data cubes to support scalable reporting and analytics—ideally with a view to implementing BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. Proficient in working with large datasets using tools like SQL and Excel.
A commercial mindset with the ability to link data insights to real business outcomes.
Strong communication skills—you know how to turn complex numbers into actionable recommendations.
Curious, collaborative, and highly adaptable.


Bonus If You Have


Experience in revenue management, pricing analytics, or marketing attribution.
Exposure to customer or guest satisfaction data (e.g. NPS, reviews, feedback tools).
Previous work with leasing systems or property management software.


Renumeration / Bonuses / Benefits


Salary: Competitive
Bonuses: Discretionary Bonus Scheme
Benefits: a) Company Pension Scheme; b) Vitality Private Healthcare Insurance; c) Company Sick Pay; d) Bike to Work Scheme
Working Hours: 40 hour working week
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent, 4x work from the office, 1x WFH
Location: Oxford Street, London (Corporate Head Office)


Equal Opportunities Statement

We are an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to creating an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We provide equal opportunities for everyone and offer reasonable adjustments to ensure all candidates have a fair chance during the recruitment process.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About The Role

We are seeking a passionate Senior Business Intelligence Analyst with a strong commercial mindset and a genuine love for data. This role isn't just about surfacing numbers- it's about transforming data into meaningful insights that support strategic decisions. You’ll play a pivotal role in enabling teams across the business to make informed, data-driven decisions.

To thrive in this role, you’ll need a solid technical foundation in analytics, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What You Will Be Doing


KPI & Performance Analysis: Collaborate with teams across Pricing, Claims & Fraud, and senior leadership to identify and evaluate key KPIs influencing conversion and performance.
Data Accessibility & ETL Design: Make data accessible and digestible for internal and external stakeholders. Partner with Data Engineering to design and implement ETL processes where needed. You will be responsible for the ingestion and the monitoring of the quality of our claims data.
Insight Generation & Strategic Input: Monitor business performance, conduct ad-hoc deep dives, and proactively share insights and recommendations with senior leaders to inform decisions, identify growth opportunities, and mitigate risks
Reporting & Dashboard Ownership: Build and maintain robust reports and dashboards (using SQL, Looker, Excel, etc.) to assess and track KPIs over time. Ensure reporting is reliable, timely, and fit for purpose.
Forecasting & Modelling Support: Support forecasting and modelling efforts, building a bridge between our commercial push and insurance performance, and to help teams understand the path to business targets and what levers to pull.


About You


You have experience in the insurance industry and understand how to connect commercial and insurance metrics, with a solid grasp of how claims processes work.
You have worked in analytics teams and have hands-on experience as an analyst, partnering with the business to report, analyse, and draw insights from data.
You know how to build dashboards (we use Looker) and possess advanced skills in Excel and SQL.
You’re a smart, strategic thinker who enjoys solving problems- not just the ones involving numbers and you’re comfortable executing against tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
You’re eager to grow in the world of data analytics, expanding your technical skills, exploring different areas of analytics and platforms, and developing your career within the company.
You have excellent stakeholder management skills and can confidently engage with people across all levels of seniority. You know how to prioritise a long list of requests into a manageable work plan and set expectations accordingly.
You have a team-oriented mindset and see your work as part of the team’s overall success. You’re happy contributing to your own projects or supporting others with theirs.
You’re excited by the potential of AI and automation to enhance how you work- whether it’s learning how to write better queries, streamline analysis, or create smarter workflows.


The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

You and a group of strong analysts will be generating the insights that guide Octopus’ commercial decisions. 
You will be the most senior analyst in our London-based data commercial team, working with our global commercial teams in understanding our customers, setting prices, and being integral to the design of the innovative products we’re famous for.
You will help upskill analysts around the world, and directly partner with some of the most influential people in the business.




What you'll do


UK pricing: Partner with the product teams to set pricing for our 8 million (and growing!) customers in the UK

Global analytics: Work with teams in the seven other countries Octopus is active in to deliver and scale impactful, global projects, such as lifetime value calculations or churn modelling


Metrics: Help people all across the business understand the key drivers of their operations through well-defined KPIs and intuitive dashboards


Global cooperation: Prioritise and coordinate the data teams supporting Octopus’ operations globally, balancing local needs with global opportunities

Passion for hands-on data work


Experience mentoring and upskilling junior analytical colleagues


Hands-on expertise with modern data platforms and analytical tools (especially SQL and python - see our full stack below)


Strong communication skills to influence non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership


Strong commercial acumen, preferably in pricing, margin optimisation, and/or growth analytics

Python, pandas and SQL in Jupyter notebooks for analysis


dbt and Databricks data platform with Delta Lake

Kubernetes for application deployment


CI/CD with GitHub and CircleCI

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
Description:
SumUp | Senior Data Analyst - Consumer Growth | London, United Kingdom

Competitive salary


Office-first


This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

About The Team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates

If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Shape commercial decisions


Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes.
Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth.
Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets.


Drive product decisions


Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value.
Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact.
Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised.


Influence with data


Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere.
Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most.
Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation.


You'll be great for this role if…


You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened.
You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption.
You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics.
You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis.
You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.
You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on.
You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike.
You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once.


Bonus points if you have:


Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services
Growth or marketing analytics experience, including attribution, CAC and channel performance (e.g. AppsFlyer, Google Analytics)
Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics
Experience partnering with fraud, abuse or risk teams
Depth in experimentation design and the statistics behind it
Familiarity with dbt or experience working alongside Analytics Engineers
Python or R for advanced analysis


Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Summary

AvePoint is seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst to support and scale our global partner business. In this role, you will analyze data across our partner ecosystem—including sales performance, customer usage, licensing, and marketing—to provide insights into how our partners drive revenue growth, customer adoption, and long-term retention. Your work will help leadership make decisions on where to invest, which partners to prioritize, and how to grow our channel business effectively.

Key Responsibilities


Partner Performance Analysis Analyze how partners contribute to revenue growth, pipeline creation, and customer expansion across regions, channels, and segments.
Partner Health & Engagement Insights Develop lifecycle metrics and scorecards to assess partner effectiveness based on engagement, product adoption, customer satisfaction, and training participation.
Revenue & Forecasting Support Support reporting on recurring revenue (ARR), renewals, and pipeline, helping leadership understand growth trends and risks within the partner ecosystem.
Customer & Partner Relationship Insights Analyze how customers move between direct sales and partners, and identify opportunities for expansion and retention through partner channels.
Partner Marketing Analytics Measure the impact of partner-driven campaigns and initiatives on new partner acquisition and existing partner growth.
Predictive & Strategic Analysis Build models to identify high-growth partners, at-risk partners, and opportunities to improve partner coverage or investment.
Dashboarding & Executive Reporting Create clear, executive-ready dashboards and insights that help sales, marketing, and partner teams take action.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Sales/Go-To-Market, Partner Programs, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align on metrics, reporting, and business priorities.


Qualifications


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a SaaS or technology environment, with a focus on customer data analytics. Experience in SaaS B2B performance metrics such as Annual Recurring Revenue, Net Recurring Revenue, and Gross Recurring Revenue analysis is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) a must. Experience with customer systems such as CRM systems (e.g., Dynamics CRM, PRMs), Gainsight CS, Everstage Commission, Segment Marketing, DealHub, OutReach, and Zoominfo experience are also a plus.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and persuasively.
Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data handling and analysis.
Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and customer success processes and how data can inform strategy and decision-making.
Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Cambridge Aerospace is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support strategic decision-making through high-quality data analysis, forecasting and reporting. Working closely with the Director, Strategic Analytics & Intelligence, you will analyse commercial, market and operational data to provide clear insights that inform business strategy, investment priorities and growth opportunities.




This is a hands-on analytical role requiring strong technical capability, commercial awareness and the ability to turn complex datasets into meaningful recommendations. You will develop analytical models, dashboards and reporting tools, helping establish a robust, data-driven approach to strategic planning across the business.




Responsibilities

Analyse commercial, market and operational datasets to identify trends, opportunities and risks that inform strategic decisions
Develop market sizing models, including TAM, SAM and SOM, alongside defence spending forecasts and country attractiveness assessments
Build and maintain forecasting models, dashboards and reports covering growth pipelines, win rates, conversion performance and resource allocation
Support competitor analysis, portfolio performance assessments and strategic investment decisions through quantitative research
Develop clear data visualisations, executive reports and decision-support materials for senior stakeholders
Improve data quality, reporting processes and analytical frameworks, supporting the development of Cambridge Aerospace's strategic analytics capability




Requirements

Strong experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics or a comparable analytical role
Advanced skills in data analysis and modelling using Python, SQL, Excel or equivalent tools
Experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau or similar visualisation platforms
Strong statistical and quantitative skills, with experience in forecasting, trend analysis and interpreting complex datasets
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate data into practical commercial or strategic recommendations
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving skills and ability to work independently with senior stakeholders




Preferred Qualifications/Experience

Degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, data science, engineering or a related quantitative discipline
Experience in market intelligence, strategic analytics, commercial forecasting or business strategy
Exposure to defence, aerospace, technology or another data-intensive industry
Experience with market sizing, competitor benchmarking, pipeline analytics or investment modelling
Familiarity with data automation, data integration and building scalable reporting processes
Experience in fast-paced R&D or startup environments, with rapid prototype iteration times




What We Offer

Competitive compensation and stock options
Private medical and dental cover
Cycle to work scheme
Lunchtime catering on site




About Us

The mission of Cambridge Aerospace is to eliminate the risk of existential war in Europe. That risk comes from the air – low-cost drones and cruise missiles now manufactured in colossal volumes by our adversaries, ballistic missiles capable of ending the world as we know it, and a new generation of hypersonic weapons that evade every existing defence.




We're building low-cost interceptors that defeat these threats, and the surveillance systems to detect and target them – at a cost taxpayers can afford, at the pace the threat demands, and with sovereign supply chains that assure delivery.




We have immense backing from the world's best venture funds. We're one of the fastest-growing defence technology companies in history. And we're hiring the best talent to prosecute the mission.




If you are in the top 1%, willing to work harder than you ever have, build technology better than anyone else, and contribute to the defining challenge of our time, now is the time to join us.




Our Commitment to Inclusion

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
Are you ready to shape how data drives decision-making across one of Europe's leading audio and media businesses? We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst to join our Data & Decision Sciences team in London.

Make an impact with data that reaches millions of audiences across Europe.

Job Purpose

As our Lead Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming complex data into actionable insights that influence strategic decisions across our Audio business. Working at the intersection of analytics, business strategy and audience understanding, you will help ensure data is leveraged effectively to improve performance, customer experiences and business outcomes.

You will define analytical frameworks, establish meaningful KPIs, develop scalable reporting solutions and partner closely with stakeholders across multiple European markets. This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making within Bauer Media Audio.

Our Team

You will be joining our collaborative Data and Decision Sciences (DDS) team, which supports Bauer Media Audio across nine European markets. We combine centralised expertise with local market knowledge to deliver trusted insights and innovative data solutions.

We see data as a strategic business partner, working closely with teams across the organisation to unlock opportunities, improve audience engagement and deliver measurable value. You will work alongside passionate analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders who are committed to creating impact through data.

Working Pattern/Location

Hybrid role based in London. Full-time, permanent position.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


Develop and implement analytics strategies aligned with business objectives.
Establish best practices for data analysis, reporting and visualisation.
Define and monitor key performance indicators across the organisation.
Analyse audience behaviour, content consumption and engagement across multiple platforms.
Develop audience segmentation approaches to support growth, retention and engagement strategies.
Lead the development of scalable reporting and analytics solutions across European markets.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau.
Translate complex insights into compelling stories for business stakeholders.
Promote data accessibility and encourage data-informed decision-making.
Evaluate emerging analytics tools, technologies and methodologies.
Support and mentor analysts while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.


What We Are Looking For


Demonstrable experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics roles.
Excellent SQL skills with experience querying large-scale consumer datasets.
Expertise in data visualisation tools, ideally Tableau.
Experience translating data into actionable business recommendations.
Understanding of audience analytics, segmentation and advertising performance metrics.
Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence a range of stakeholders.
Experience leading projects and supporting the development of other analysts.
Experience in digital, product or user analytics.
Media, digital publishing or audio industry experience is desirable but not essential.


About Bauer Media Group

We are a media business focused on creating content that matters to millions of people across Europe. Our offering extends from print and online publishing to audio broadcasting and entertainment, alongside investments in other media related sectors. With more than 500 million copies sold each year, we are one of Europe’s largest Publishers. From women’s and celebrities’ magazines to TV listings to food and special interest, we own some of the most popular publishing brands in Germany, UK, Poland and France – both digital and print. But not only that. Reaching over 61 million listeners weekly, we operate over 150 radio and podcast brands in nine countries, spanning the UK, Ireland, Poland, Slovakia, Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Norway and Portugal. Family-owned in the 5th generation, Bauer Media focuses on the long-term, with a consumer-first mindset that guides us across our diverse portfolio. Our workforce of 12,000 shares a common purpose: to deliver content and services that enrich people‘s everyday lives.

What’s In It For You


You’ll have 28 days holiday, bank holidays & 2 volunteer days to use.
Your development matters, so access to our internal training provider – Bauer Academy, is a huge win.
We have enhanced Maternity/Adoption, Paternity and Shared Parental Leave Pay.
You’ll have the opportunity for flexible working.
And much more! Find the full details of our benefits here

We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to all. Title: Data Analyst – Power BI Microsoft Fabric (35903)
Description:
Data Analyst – Power BI / Microsoft Fabric

Location: Ottawa, ON – On-site

Hours: 40 hours/week (8 hours/day)

Start: ASAP

Compensation: $90,000–$106,740

Benefits: Full benefits

Clearance: Must be eligible to successfully complete the required background/security screening

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Data Analyst to join a highly collaborative technology and data team supporting a complex, operational environment in Ottawa.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior-to-mid-level Data Analyst with strong Power BI, SQL and Microsoft data technologies experience who enjoys turning data into meaningful dashboards, reporting and business insights.

Reporting to a senior technology leader and working closely with a Data Architect, you will design and maintain dashboards, reports, data models and analytical solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and related Azure/cloud analytics technologies.

This is also a stakeholder-facing role. Strong communication, listening skills and the ability to understand business requirements and explain data clearly are equally important to technical capability.

What You'll Do


Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, visualizations and performance metrics for operational and executive audiences.
Develop and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze data from multiple systems.
Build and maintain dimensional and semantic data models supporting reporting and self-service analytics.
Develop data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Warehouse workloads, and related Azure Data Services.
Integrate structured and semi-structured data from APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Use Python/Pandas for data preparation, automation and analysis.
Gather and understand stakeholder requirements and translate them into effective analytical and reporting solutions.
Analyze complex datasets and communicate findings as clear, actionable business insights.
Support data quality, consistency, documentation, governance, privacy and security requirements.
Help evaluate, improve and automate existing reporting processes and systems.
Work closely with technical teams, business stakeholders and external vendors/service providers.


What We're Looking For


Post-secondary degree/diploma in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Business or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting or a related analytical role.
3+ years developing Power BI reports and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills, including querying, transforming and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with dimensional data modelling.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse/Warehouse), Azure Data Services or comparable modern cloud analytics platforms.
Experience with Python/Pandas.
Experience integrating data using APIs, JSON, file-based exchanges and relational databases.
Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources.
Proven ability to translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
Ability to analyze complex information and present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong communication and listening skills, professional presence and a clear, structured approach to problem-solving.
Comfortable working directly with business users, customers and stakeholders.


NICE TO HAVE


Microsoft certifications such as Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate or Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
Tableau experience and exposure to other BI/reporting technologies such as Qlik, Looker, SSRS or advanced Excel.
Experience with Snowflake, AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experience in aviation, transportation or another complex 24/7 operational environment.
Knowledge of data governance, privacy and information security practices.
Experience with operational performance metrics and reporting standards.
Ability to communicate in English and French is an asset.


Who Will Succeed In This Role

You don't need to be the most senior technical person in the room. We're looking for someone who combines solid hands-on data skills with the ability to listen, understand requirements, communicate clearly and work collaboratively.

You should be technically adaptable, comfortable taking direction from senior data/technology professionals, and confident interacting directly with stakeholders to turn their requirements into useful, reliable data solutions.

Description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100787

Position Overview

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. We strengthen connections between education and industry, expand adoption of Autodesk technology, and support workforce readiness in an increasingly AI-enabled world.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the Business Operations and Analytics team. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Strategy, and other teams to understand business needs, scope analytical work, and turn customer and business data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. You will work hands-on with SQL, Python, Snowflake, and business intelligence tools, and use approved AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, coding, synthesis, and communication.

Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team and take on some of the most important and complex questions facing the business. That means understanding how we buy and price vehicles, how customers move through our funnel, how we recondition and deliver cars, and how customers finance their purchases. You'll be the person leaders turn to when they need to know what's really happening and what to do about it.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership. You'll scope ambiguous problems, build the data models and pipelines needed to answer them, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that drive decisions. If you're energized by messy, high-stakes problems and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You'll Do


Own deep-dive analyses on Clutch's highest-priority problems across acquisitions, inventory, retail conversion, operations, and financing.
Build models and frameworks to size opportunities, forecast outcomes, and evaluate trade-offs before decisions are made.
Define and own core business metrics so teams across Clutch work from a single source of truth.
Design and analyze experiments to measure the impact of product, marketing, and operational changes.
Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and data models that stakeholders rely on every day.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake, in partnership with data engineering.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We're Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
A track record of analysis that changed business decisions, not just reporting on them.
Ability to take a vague business question, structure it, and deliver a clear recommendation.
Solid grounding in statistics and experimentation.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, such as Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, automotive, or financial services.
Experience with dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Python or another coding language.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.


Why You'll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership: the opportunity to build your process and influence the company at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by tackling the problems that matter most to the business.
Broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - $125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.

Highspring est une firme de consultation et de services professionnels de nouvelle génération. Nous accompagnons des organisations partout en Amérique du Nord dans leurs initiatives de transformation, de modernisation technologique et d'innovation.

Nous collaborons avec des organisations de premier plan, notamment dans les secteurs bancaire, de l'assurance et des technologies, afin de concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions modernes ayant un impact concret.

Chez Highspring, nous valorisons l'excellence technique, la collaboration, l'apprentissage continu et le développement de nos talents.

L'opportunité

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Data Analyst pour rejoindre une équipe travaillant sur des projets data d'envergure à Montréal.

Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable d'analyser, de transformer et de valoriser les données afin de générer des insights d'affaires concrets et de soutenir la prise de décision. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes techniques et d'affaires afin de comprendre les besoins, développer des analyses pertinentes et contribuer à l'évolution des solutions data.

Une bonne maîtrise de SQL et des services AWS est essentielle pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Localisation : Montréal, QC

Mode de travail : Hybride

Langues : Français et anglais - bilinguisme requis

Ce que vous ferez

Analyser de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, anomalies et opportunités.
Transformer les besoins d'affaires en analyses et solutions data concrètes.
Développer et optimiser des requêtes SQL complexes.
Travailler avec les services AWS afin d'extraire, traiter et analyser les données.
Participer à la conception et à l'évolution des processus de collecte, transformation et consommation des données.
Développer et maintenir des rapports, dashboards et indicateurs de performance.
Transformer les résultats d'analyse en recommandations et insights actionnables pour les équipes d'affaires.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, BI, développement, produit et les parties prenantes d'affaires.
Effectuer la validation, le nettoyage et le contrôle de la qualité des données.
Identifier les problèmes liés aux données et contribuer à leur résolution.
Documenter les analyses, les processus et les indicateurs développés.
Participer à des projets d'amélioration continue et de modernisation des solutions data.
Évoluer dans un environnement Agile et collaboratif.

Ce que vous apportez

3 à 5+ années d'expérience en Data Analytics ou dans un rôle similaire.
Excellente maîtrise de SQL.
Expérience pratique avec AWS, notamment avec certains des services suivants :
Amazon S3
Amazon Athena
Amazon Redshift
AWS Glue
Expérience avec des outils de BI et de visualisation, tels que :
Power BI
Tableau
ou outils similaires.
Expérience dans l'analyse de données et la production de business insights.
Bonne compréhension des bases de données relationnelles et des concepts de data warehousing.
Expérience avec Python est un atout.
Excellentes capacités analytiques et de résolution de problèmes.
Capacité à communiquer des résultats techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques.
Expérience dans un environnement Agile.
Français et anglais professionnels.




Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst, capable d'aller au-delà de la production de rapports et de transformer les données en recommandations concrètes.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec SQL, AWS et les outils de visualisation, vous aimez comprendre les problématiques d'affaires et vous savez communiquer clairement vos conclusions à différents types de parties prenantes.

Vous êtes également curieux(se), analytique et à l'aise dans des environnements où les priorités évoluent rapidement.

Pourquoi joindre Highspring ?

Travailler sur des projets data d'envergure.
Évoluer dans des environnements utilisant des technologies cloud modernes.
Développer votre expertise sur AWS et les plateformes data.
Collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et des experts techniques.
Participer à des initiatives de transformation et de modernisation.
Profiter d'occasions continues d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement.
Faire partie d'une culture collaborative axée sur l'excellence technique et le partage des connaissances.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

At Sonatype, we empower developers with best in class tools to build secure, high-quality software at scale. Our mission is to create a world where software is always secure and developers can innovate without fear. Trusted by thousands of organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we are pioneers in software supply chain management, open source security, and DevSecOps.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team. In this role, you will transform complex product datasets into actionable insights, build scalable analytics infrastructure, mentor associate-level analysts, and drive data-informed product decisions.

What You’ll Do


Product Analytics & Telemetry: Analyze product usage, feature adoption, and telemetry data alongside financial metrics to optimize user experience and support product strategy.
Analytics & Data Modeling: Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle, including data modeling, dashboard creation, and KPI development. Deliver high-accuracy analyses independently across various product initiatives.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, managing requirements and delivering precise insights on tight turnarounds.
Mentorship: Serve as a technical guide to coach and mentor the team’s cohort of associate-level analysts.
Execution Metrics: Maintain high standards for ticket throughput, speed of delivery, and on-time completion rates for analytics tasks.


What You'll Bring


Experience: 5+ years in data analysis, BI, or product analytics—specifically within a SaaS or tech company. Experience working with product telemetry/usage data is strictly required.
Location: Must be based in Canada (excluding Quebec; Ontario or Eastern time zone preferred).
Technical Stack:
Advanced SQL and Python skills.
Strong expertise in Databricks (PySpark, notebooks, data lakehouses/medallion architecture, AWS S3).
Hands-on experience with visualization tools—Looker is heavily preferred (or ability to quickly adapt from Power BI/Tableau).
Familiarity with APIs, structured data formats (JSON, DataFrames), and version control via GitHub.
Qualitative Traits: Strong curiosity, meticulous attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and clear communication skills.
Nice to Have: Knowledge of business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Amplitude, Gainsight).

What We're Proud Of


2025 Best DevSecOps Solution by DevOps Dozen
Visionary in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Application Security Testing
2025 DEVIES Award to our SBOM Manager new product for its innovation and impact in developer technology
2024 Industry Leader in Forrester-Wave for Software Composition Analysis (2024 Q4 report)
2023 Fast Company Best Places for Innovators
2023 Gartner's Magic Quadrant
2023 Software Report's Top 100 Software Companies
2023 BuiltIn Best Places to Work
2022 Frost & Sullivan Technology Innovation Leader Award
2022 PeerSpot Silver Peer Award in Software Composition Analysis
2022 Tech Ascension Best DevOps Security Solution Award
2022 NVCT Cyber Company of the Year
Company Wellness days - We shut down company operations during some days of the year (5 in total) to enable all employees to pursue personal growth and enjoy much-needed and deserved additional rest.
Paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO)


At Sonatype, we value diversity and inclusivity. We offer perks such as parental leave, diversity and inclusion working groups, and flexible working practices to allow our employees to show up as their whole selves. We are an equal-opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.

Title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Operations
Description:
7shifts is an HR platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As the Senior Data Analyst at 7shifts, you’ll be the analytical partner to our Go-to-Market and Finance teams. Reporting to our Manager, Data & Analytics, you’ll work alongside analysts, data engineers, and analytics engineers, partnering closely with GTM Operations and Finance. Your role is to ensure the teams driving revenue and managing our finances have data they can trust and the insight to act on it. Most of your time will go toward strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate - reducing manual work, creating clearer definitions, and making it faster to get answers. You’ll also build and maintain the data assets these teams rely on and help them self-serve, so simple questions don’t become tickets. You’re a consultant to the business, not a request queue: you bring the context, recommend the approach, and drive cross-functional work forward.

What You'll Do


Own GTM and Finance analytics end-to-end, from scoping the question to pulling data from Snowflake, Stripe, Salesforce, and FinQore, and landing on a recommendation leaders can act on
Lead strategic projects that improve how GTM and Finance operate, coordinating across analysts, engineers, and business partners
Build and maintain the dashboards, reports, and metric definitions teams rely on as a source of truth, ensuring data stays consistent across the company
Enable self-serve by making data and tooling easier for GTM and Finance to use independently
Use AI as part of your daily workflow to accelerate analysis, leverage the semantic layer for faster insights, and find new ways to make the team more efficient
Mentor teammates and contribute to shared standards for how the team scopes, builds, and validates its work
Help shape the analytics roadmap by bringing GTM and Finance needs back to the Data team


What You Bring


5+ years in data analytics or business intelligence, with strong experience in financial or go-to-market reporting
Experience owning complex, ambiguous analysis end to end and translating it into business decisions
Strong SQL in a modern warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent) and comfort with a BI tool (ThoughtSpot or equivalent); able to work across multiple systems and learn new ones quickly
Experience working with the systems behind the numbers, such as Stripe, Salesforce, FinQore, or equivalent platforms
Fluency in SaaS metrics like ARR, retention, and pipeline, with the judgment to connect analysis to revenue, cost, and operating outcomes
Active use of AI in analytical work, with a clear understanding of where it adds value and where its output needs to be checked
Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to influence decisions without owning them; people come to you for the recommendation, not just the query
Experience mentoring other analysts on analytical methods, SQL, or AI, formally or informally


It'd be even cooler if you had


Experience building AI agents or enabling AI adoption at a previous company
Experience in the restaurant or hospitality industry
An interest in growing into people leadership


Our Commitment To Our Shifties


Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.


We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!

Our privacy policy can be found here.

Compensation Range: CA$100K - CA$150K

Experience partnering with business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights.

Experience with Python, Jupyter Notebook, Snowflake, dbt, reporting automation tools, or statistical analysis.

We are TRADER, a Canadian leader in digital automotive solutions. Our flagship brands - AutoTrader.ca, AutoSync, Dealertrack Canada and CMS - help Canadians buy, sell, and finance vehicles with confidence.

Learn more at tradercorporation.com.

As part of AutoScout24 group, Europe’s largest online car marketplace, we’re shaping the future of automotive retail in Canada and beyond.

As (Senior) Data Analyst, you will establish and scale the analytical data foundations for our Fintech ecosystem across Dealertrack and CMS. You will work closely with product, engineering, and business teams to enable reliable, data-driven decision-making. Your work will support product strategy, fraud prevention, customer trust initiatives, and the modernization of our Fintech platforms.

What you’ll do:


Design, build, and own core analytical data models supporting consistent measurement across fintech products, including fraud prevention, transaction flows, and customer journeys
Define and document KPI logic, metric definitions, and analytical standards to ensure a shared and trusted view of performance across fintech analytics
Act as an analytical partner to Fintech product teams supporting Dealertrack and CMS, generating insights that enable data-informed product development, optimization, and prioritization
Ensure product and business decisions are grounded in robust and reliable analysis across financial workflows
Serve as a technical mentor within the analytics team, establishing best practices for analytical methodologies, data quality, and metric definitions in a regulated fintech environment
Guide junior analysts on complex analytical problems and collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen data literacy and promote data-informed decision making


What you’ll need


5+ years of experience in data analytics with strong hands-on experience in analytical data modelling, ideally supporting financial, saas or platform-based products
Strong proficiency in SQL and BI tools such as power bi, tableau or quicksight
Demonstrated regular use of GenAI tools to accelerate sql development, analytical modelling, documentation and problem-solving with measurable impact on efficiency or quality
Experience working with financial, transactional or operational datasets
Ability to work autonomously and partner closely with fintech product and engineering teams to identify analytical needs and translate them into actionable insights
Strong communication skills and ability to present complex data and financial concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Proven ability to gather, analyze and synthesize data from multiple systems while ensuring accuracy, consistency and trust in reported metrics


What’s in it for you

We understand that there is life at work and life outside of work. Here are a few benefits that support us to be our creative best.


Gym discounts
Employee and Family Assistance program
Virtual wellness events
Conferences & training budget
Regular internal training programs
Financial planning with 3% matching Pension
Competitive salary
Annual bonus structure

Title: Analyste principal de données / Senior Data Analyst - CX
Description:
Aperçu du poste :

Genetec recherche actuellement un analyste principal de données pour son organisation dédiée à l'expérience client (CX). Nous recherchons une personne dynamique et réactive, capable de s'épanouir dans un environnement dynamique et animé, et de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables.

À ce poste, le candidat apportera son soutien à l'équipe CX Shared Services (CXSS) en jouant un rôle clé dans l'ensemble du cycle de vie des activités de reporting et d'analyse, depuis la collecte des besoins et l'extraction des données jusqu'à la création et la diffusion de rapports automatisés. Ce poste permettra à l'organisation CX de Genetec de se démarquer en fournissant à ses collaborateurs des indicateurs détaillés, des analyses et des calculs approfondis et précis, ainsi que des présentations claires facilitant la prise de décision. Ces rapports, analyses et présentations seront étroitement liés aux performances de nos opérations CX, les données provenant de bases de données issues de différents systèmes (CRM, ERP, portail Web, IVR, chat, etc.). Ce poste exige de solides compétences en matière d'intégration, de validation et d'interprétation des données.



Votre journée en un coup d'oeil :

Recueillir les besoins en matière d'analyses, de rapports et de présentations auprès des différentes parties prenantes au sein de l'organisation CX et les traduire en spécifications techniques
Concevoir et fournir des rapports, des indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et des visualisations, en garantissant l'intégrité des données provenant de multiples sources
Extraire, compiler et agréger des données issues de multiples sources afin de les présenter sous un format simple et intuitif, qui sera utilisé dans les rapports et les présentations
Compiler les exigences relatives aux rapports récurrents en vue de leur automatisation dans Power BI et participer à leur test une fois développés
Élaborer et exécuter des plans de test, résoudre les problèmes et améliorer en continu les rapports et tableaux de bord BI
Collaborer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes techniques internes (par exemple, Digital Information) pour garantir la livraison en temps voulu des modèles de données, une communication claire et la résolution des obstacles
Contribuer à la production de rapports ponctuels et ad hoc basés sur des données provenant de différentes sources
Travailler en collaboration avec différents services pour garantir l'exactitude des rapports
Travailler simultanément sur plusieurs initiatives et hiérarchiser les tâches en fonction des livrables à venir

Ce poste exige un grand souci du détail, la capacité à synthétiser des informations et à les présenter sous une forme simple et claire, tant au niveau de la mise en page que de la présentation, tout en sachant les communiquer de manière claire et concise.



Ce qui fait de vous un excellent candidat :

Baccalauréat en informatique, génie logiciel, finance ou gestion d'entreprise avec une formation en analyse opérationnelle, ou expérience équivalente
Au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente
Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans le domaine du reporting ou de l'analyse
Excellentes compétences analytiques et de présentation
Solides compétences organisationnelles
Bonnes compétences en gestion du temps et en hiérarchisation des priorités
Orientation client
Capacité à travailler sous pression et à respecter des délais stricts
Motivation à travailler dans un environnement dynamique
Capacité à travailler aussi bien en équipe qu'en autonomie
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (ce poste nécessite des interactions avec nos collaborateurs et clients internationaux)



Votre expertise technique :

Connaissances avancées de Power BI Desktop et intermédiaires de Power BI Service
Maîtrise approfondie du langage DAX (Data Analytics Expressions)
Expérience en extraction et manipulation de données à l'aide de requêtes SQL, de la fonction « Recherche avancée » de CRM et des rapports Power BI existants
Bonne maîtrise des concepts liés aux bases de données et au stockage de données
Connaissances avancées de la suite Microsoft (Word, Excel et PowerPoint)
La connaissance des systèmes CRM et Finance & Operations (MS Dynamics 365) est un atout



Voilà ce que nous offrons !

Régime de rémunération attrayant
Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
Équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à un horaire de travail flexible
Repas subventionnés à notre incroyable Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Café et fruits gratuits à volonté
Espace de stationnement gratuit pour tous les employés
Centre de conditionnement physique sur place avec entraîneur personnel, ainsi que plusieurs ateliers de santé et de bien-être

Nous savons que la diversité des parcours et des expériences apporte une grande valeur à nos équipes. Même si vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases nous vous encourageons à postuler - votre profil pourrait nous surprendre!



Merci pour votre candidature, mais veuillez noter que seul(e)s les candidat(e)s sélectionné(e)s seront contacté(e)s. Les chasseurs de têtes et les agences de recrutement ne sont pas autorisés à soumettre des CV par l'intermédiaire de ce site web ou directement aux gestionnaires.
