Job Overview:

Genetec is currently seeking a Senior Data Analyst for its Customer Experience (CX) organization. We are seeking a dynamic and responsive individual who can thrive in a fast-paced and lively environment and transform complex data into actionable insights. 

In this role, the candidate will support the CX Shared Services (CXSS) team as a key contributor to the entire lifecycle of reporting and analytics efforts—from gathering requirements and extracting data to creating and delivering automated reports. This role will help Genetec's CX organization distinguish itself by providing its team members with detailed metrics, in-depth and accurate data analysis and calculations, and clear presentations that drive decision-making. These reports, analyses, and presentations will be closely related to the performance of our CX operations, with data sourced from databases across different systems (CRM, ERP, Web Portal, IVR, Chat, etc.). This role requires strong skills in data integration, validation, and interpretation. 



Your day at a glance:

Gather requirements for analysis, reports, and presentations from various stakeholders within the CX organization and translate them into technical specifications
Design and deliver reports, KPIs, and visualizations, ensuring data integrity across multiple sources
Extract, compile, and aggregate data from multiple data sources to be presented in an easy and intuitive format, which will be displayed in reports and presentations
Compile the requirements of recurring reports for their automation in Power BI and assist with their testing once developed
Develop and execute test plans, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve BI reports and dashboards
Collaborate with stakeholders and internal technical teams (e.g., Digital Information) to ensure timely delivery of data models, clear communication, and resolution of blockers
Support the generation of timely and ad-hoc reports based on data from different sources
Work in collaboration with different departments to ensure accuracy of the reports
Work on multiple initiatives at once and prioritize tasks according to the upcoming deliverables

This position requires great attention to detail, the ability to harmonize information and transform it into a simple and easy-to-understand format in terms of both layout and presentation, while also being able to communicate it clearly and concisely. 



What makes you a great fit:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Finance, or Business with an operational analysis background, or equivalent experience  
5+ years of relevant working experience  
3+ years of experience working in reporting or analytics  
Excellent analytical and presentation skills 
Strong organizational skills 
Possess good time management and prioritization skills 
Customer-oriented  
Be able to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines  
Motivated to work in a fast-paced environment  
Be able to work in a team environment as well as independently  
Fluent in French and English, both verbal and written



Your technical expertise:

 Advanced Power BI Desktop and intermediate Power BI Service knowledge 
Strong proficiency in DAX (Data Analytics Expressions) 
Experience with data extraction and manipulation with the use of SQL queries, CRM Advanced Find, and existing Power BI reports 
Familiar with database and data warehousing concepts 
Advanced knowledge of the Microsoft suite (Word, Excel & PowerPoint) 
Knowledge of CRM and Finance & Operations systems (MS Dynamics 365) is an asset 



Let's talk perks!

Attractive compensation package
Training Tuition Reimbursement Program
Work-life balance with a flexible working schedule
Subsidized meals in our amazing Bistro (Les Cordons Bleus)
Free, unlimited coffee and fruits
Private, free parking for all employees
Onsite fitness facility with personal trainer, and multiple wellness and health workshops

We know that diverse backgrounds and experiences bring great value to our teams. Even if you don't think you tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply - your profile may surprise us!



Thank you for your application, but please note that only selected candidates will be contacted. Head-hunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumés/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers.

Title: Business Data Analyst
Description:
What the Role Does

Turn data into better product decisions.

As a Business Data Analyst, you will partner with Product Owners to design experiments, analyze customer behaviour, and turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Your work will influence product roadmaps across key customer journeys, including conversion, engagement, and renewals.

You will go beyond reporting results. You will apply statistical rigour, investigate unexpected findings, challenge assumptions constructively, and uncover opportunities that improve the customer experience and business performance. This role is for a curious, proactive analyst who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership of analytical initiatives, and turns insights into meaningful action to uncover opportunities and strengthen how we measure, report, and make decisions across the business.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.




What You’ll Do

Collaborate with Product Owners to design and plan experiments, define requirements, assumptions, and limitations
Explore and analyze experiment data to understand customer behaviour, usage patterns, and performance drivers
Lead multiple analytical initiatives, using findings to recommend clear next steps and inform priorities
Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover customer behaviour trends, friction points, and growth opportunities
Use AI tools to research internal documentation and tools, support SQL and code development, and review analytical work efficiently
Build dashboards and automated reports to improve accessibility and insight quality
Translate business questions into measurable metrics
Deliver data based recommendations and clearly identify actionable next steps
Improve tracking plans, event quality, and attribution logic to ensure accurate and reliable measurement
Write and optimize SQL queries and notebooks to support analysis
Communicate data analysis results, insights, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
Collaborate with fellow analysts to review results, refine methodologies, and strengthen analytical approaches

What You Bring

Post-secondary education in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or other related programs
3+ years of experience in data analysis, product analytics, or data science
Strong statistical judgment, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power considerations, and the ability to distinguish meaningful findings from noise
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex analysis clearly
Solid understanding of statistics and experiment analysis
Proficiency in SQL, including writing efficient queries with joins, aggregations, and filtering logic
Knowledge of data mining and segmentation techniques
Familiarity with Python for data analysis and visualization (ex. pandas, Matplotlib)
Ability to manage multiple experiments and analyses simultaneously
Proficiency using Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Visualizations, Formulas)
Ability to work independently and manage complex projects
Strong interest in data analysis and a natural tendency to dig deeper into unexpected results
Experience using AI-enabled development environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Copilot

What Sets You Apart

Experience analyzing and designing A/B experiments
Ability to structure ambiguous problems into analytical plans
Confidence challenging assumptions while maintaining strong working relationships
Proactive mindset that goes beyond answering questions to identifying new opportunities
Comfortable presenting insights to Product Owners and leadership

Why You Should Join the LawDepot Team

Excellent total compensation package
Comprehensive health and dental benefits, plus an additional Health Care Spending / Personal Spending Account
Great work life balance (37.5 hour work weeks, flexible schedules, ability to bank hours)
Three weeks paid vacation, plus bonus personal days
Continuous learning opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and training budgets
Company share plan
Free catered lunches for the entire office
Monthly social events for team members to enjoy (think axe throwing, rock climbing, board games, food trucks, trivia contests, and charitable activities)
Work alongside talented, driven colleagues in a culture focused on quality, reliability, innovation, and growth
Personal offices for focused work and to have your individual space (plus collaborative workspaces for when you want to meet with the team)
Free and easily accessible parking
Southgate Mall, Whyte Ave, and Calgary Trail restaurants are only minutes away
Hybrid working arrangements for that balance between getting work done at home and engaging with others in the office

Who We Are

Join one of the fastest growing companies in Canada! LawDepot is proud to be a seven-time Growth 500 ranked organization and a major player in the Global legal solutions industry. Our mission is to modernize the legal document creation experience by empowering people with fast, easy-to-use, and professional solutions. With over ten million satisfied customers worldwide, over two million monthly website visitors, and billions of dollars saved on legal fees, you will be joining a team that is truly making a difference. Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. An exciting opportunity exists to join as a Senior Data Analyst in the Wireless Service & Equipment Finance team. This position will be responsible for creating and maintaining Tableau dashboard that including dashboard design, creation, master data file building, data mining and measuring service & equipment revenue /usage KPIs and be able to be as story teller. Candidates will work very closely with various teams to provide value-added analysis on Wireless Revenue.

The Sr. Data Analyst will be based in Toronto and will provide expert data management to Wireless Service & Equipment Finance.

What You'll Do


Design, develop, enhance and maintain Tableau and/or Power BI dashboards supporting Wireless Service & Equipment Finance reporting and performance management.
Develop and maintain master datasets and reporting data layers using Databricks, SQL and Python, including data extraction, transformation, integration and validation from multiple data sources.
Build and automate weekly and monthly financial scorecards, dashboards and management reports, providing clear insights into performance trends and key business drivers.
Analyze large and complex datasets across multiple source systems to evaluate wireless subscriber, revenue, equipment, usage and other financial/business KPIs.
Translate business and Finance requirements into scalable data models, queries, dashboards and reporting solutions.
Write and optimize SQL queries and Databricks workflows to extract, join, cleanse, transform and aggregate large datasets for financial reporting and business analysis.
Use Python and SQL to automate recurring data preparation, validation, reconciliation and reporting processes.
Develop visually effective dashboards that enable users to understand performance, identify trends and investigate key drivers.
Perform detailed data validation and reconciliation between source systems, master datasets, financial results and reporting outputs to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Investigate data discrepancies, data quality issues and potential data corruption; identify root causes and work with appropriate teams to implement solutions.
Support Financial Analysis, Pricing, Commercial Strategy, Marketing and Sales teams by providing reliable datasets, analytical insights and ad-hoc reporting.
Process and analyze data to support business cases, forecasting, performance measurement and ad-hoc analytical requests.
Define data requirements and business rules and ensure data extracts and reporting outputs are complete, accurate and fit for purpose.
Develop and automate financial and statistical analyses using tools such as Databricks, Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau and Power BI.
Partner with Data, Technology and IT teams to identify appropriate source systems, databases and tables and understand upstream/downstream data dependencies.
Present analytical findings to Finance and business stakeholders and translate complex data into clear business stories, key insights and actionable recommendations.


What You'll Bring


3+ years’ experience in data analytics/Business Intelligence, ideally within telecommunications.
Advanced Databricks and SQL skills working with large, complex datasets.
Strong Python and/or PySpark programming and data manipulation experience.
Advanced Tableau dashboard development; Power BI experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, transformation, quality, architecture, and data management.
Experience building master datasets, reusable reporting sources, and automated/scalable reporting solutions.
Strong Excel skills, including large datasets and financial analysis.
Experience with statistical, trend, variance, testing, and performance analysis.
University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
Insights-driven, adaptable, collaborative, and customer-focused, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

We are currently seeking a Data Analyst to join the Data Solutions team in the Wealth Technology group at CI Wealth. The Data Solutions team focuses on developing data-driven solutions, driving innovation, and uncovering key insights to support strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will play a key role in leveraging data to deliver solutions that enhance decision-making, streamline business processes, and support strategic objectives.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both data analysis and business processes.

Responsibilities


Analyze and interpret large datasets to uncover key insights that drive business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders across teams to identify data needs and deliver actionable solutions.
Develop and maintain data processes that enhance efficiency and support data-driven decision-making.
Document and maintain data mapping specifications and business rules to support data governance efforts.
Assist in building reports, dashboards, and analytics tools to monitor key metrics and trends.
Identify inefficiencies in existing processes and recommend data-driven improvements.
Respond to stakeholder inquiries and data requests in a timely and effective manner.
Partner with Data Engineers to support the successful implementation of solutions.


Experience

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:


2+ years of work experience in quantitative analysis.


Education/Training


Post-secondary degree in a quantitative discipline.


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities


Strong problem-solving skills and attention to details.
Solid understanding of data and data modeling.
In-depth knowledge and experience with the following tools:
Visualization e.g., Sigma, AWS Quicksight
Modelling e.g., MS Excel
Database system e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake
Cloud Technology e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure
Strong knowledge and understanding of SQL
Working knowledge and understanding of Python.
A strong analytical mindset and sophisticated written and verbal communication skills.
Experience in the Financial Services Industry is an asset.
Ability to work within an organization based upon continuous improvement.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Required

The mission of the Data Evolution and Analytics department is to support and advise business sectors on data access and use, and to make data available in secure environments according to business sector specifications. As a data valorization analyst, you collect and valorize data that comes through different channels. You extract, describe, analyze and interpret the data needed to make informed business decisions. More specifically, you will be required to:


Occasionally take part in the development of ETL solutions with SAS to load data in the warehouse
Help identify and analyze the sector’s management information needs (data, reports, management indicators, performance measures, publications, etc.)
Develop new indicators, modify existing indicators and respond to ad hoc requests
Help implement data and analytics (DA) solutions in partnership with the business sectors, keeping in mind cross-sector standardization—particularly with respect to test strategies, tests, documentation and integration of reference documents
Define, validate and update procedures and mechanisms for controlling the quality of management information
Help produce training and support materials and document processes
Ensure the quality of publications in accordance with the management information governance policy
Help system, tool and database users in choosing and interpreting requests and publications

Competitive salary and annual bonus
Salary range : $78 582 to $115 255 per year (Downtown Toronto)
4 weeks of flexible vacation starting in the first year
Defined benefit pension plan that provides predictable, stable income throughout retirement
Group insurance including telemedicine
Reimbursement of health and wellness expenses and telework equipment
Benefits apply based on eligibility criteria.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.


The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About STAN

STAN is the largest provider of AI solutions for HOA and Condo Property Managers. We're using cutting-edge, patented AI technology to build solutions that enhance life for residents of more than 2.5 million+ homes across North America — and we're on a mission to build the world's first AI property manager. Want to come along for the ride?

We've been recognized by Rogers, FedEx, George Brown College, StartUp Canada, the Waterloo Accelerator Centre, and more — and we're just getting started. Learn more at www.stan(.)ai 🤖

The Role

We're hiring a Data Analyst / Data Strategist to turn our customer data into decisions. Thousands of HOA and condo communities run on STAN every day — residents asking questions, managers handling requests, our AI answering conversations around the clock. That data tells us what customers love, what they're missing, and where we can help them do more.

You'll dig into how property management companies actually use STAN, find the features and workflows they aren't using yet, and work with Customer Success, Product, and Sales to close those gaps. You'll also own the health of our data itself — making it cleaner, more consistent, and easier for the whole company to trust and use.

Your role and responsibilities

•Understand how customers use STAN

• Analyze product usage across our customer base to see which features each management company and community uses, how often, and how that changes over time

• Build customer health and adoption scores that help Customer Success spot accounts at risk and accounts ready to grow

• Identify features and workflows customers are paying for but not using, and recommend how to drive adoption

Learn from customer conversations

• Analyze resident and manager conversations with STAN's AI to find common questions, trends, gaps in answers, and opportunities to improve

• Turn conversation data into clear insights for Product and Engineering — what to build, fix, or train our AI on next

• Surface patterns by community type, region, and property management software to help us tailor the product

Improve our data

• Audit the quality of customer data across our platform and integrations and fix gaps, duplicates, and inconsistencies

• Define clear metrics, data standards, and documentation so everyone at STAN works from the same numbers

• Partner with Engineering to improve how we collect, structure, and store data

Shape our data strategy

• Build dashboards and reports for leadership, Customer Success, Sales, and Product

• Create customer-facing insights and reports that show property managers the value STAN delivers to their communities

• Help set STAN's long-term data strategy as we grow, including how we use data to improve our AI

What you bring

•3–6 years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, or data strategy, ideally at a B2B SaaS company

• Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with Python or R for analysis

• Experience building dashboards in tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Metabase, or similar

• A track record of analyzing product usage or customer data and turning it into recommendations that changed how a team worked

• Experience cleaning and structuring messy data from multiple sources

• Comfort working with unstructured text data, such as support tickets, chat logs, or conversations

• Clear communication: you can explain findings simply to non-technical teams and leadership

• Self-starter mindset suited to a fast-paced startup where you'll build processes from scratch

Nice to Have

• Experience in PropTech, property management, real estate, or HOA/condo software

• Experience analyzing conversational AI, chatbot, or call center data, or using NLP / LLM tools to classify text

• Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or PostHog

• Familiarity with modern data stacks (e.g., dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery)

• Experience in a customer-facing analytics role or partnering closely with Customer Success

• Experience setting up data governance or data quality programs

Compensation

We offer a salary of CAD 81,000–110,000 per year.

Benefits

Opportunity to sell world-class, patented AI technology.

Comprehensive health, dental, and specialist benefits.

Company Macbook.

Free parking and shuttle service to the office.

Extra PTO during occasional US holidays.

Company events, in-office restaurant, and building-wide perks.

Unlimited ping pong and espresso!




If you're a closer who is passionate about AI and ready to disrupt a massive industry, we want to talk to you!

Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

Making a bold move in a people-first environment
We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

We strive to provide accessibility measures throughout the recruitment process within the limits of our available resources. If you require accommodations, feel free to let us know during our initial conversations. We welcome all candidates! What can you bring to our team?

Join us!

Title: Analyste sénior en intelligence d'affaires
HTML:
Sous la supervision de la Directrice-adjointe analyse, l'analyste en intelligence d'affaires senior jouera un rôle clé dans la conception de tableaux de bord, l'analyse de tendances et la production de prévisions basées sur les données. Il/Elle contribuera à la définition, la mise en place et l'évolution des indicateurs de performance, des mesures, des tableaux de bord et des schémas de données nécessaires au déploiement de l'intelligence d'affaires d'AGA.

L'analyste sera également responsable de promouvoir et d'assurer l'application de bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion et d'utilisation sécuritaire des données. Le développement de relations solides, tant avec les collègues multidisciplinaires de l'équipe qu'avec les clients internes sur le terrain, demeure essentiel pour réussir dans ce rôle.

Le·la titulaire de ce poste sera, entre autres, appelé à :

  • Collecter, transformer, nettoyer et organiser les données provenant de différentes sources internes, en veillant à leur qualité et à leur cohérence;
  • Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer des tableaux de bord et rapports à l'aide d'outils de visualisation comme Power BI ou outils similaires;
  • Accompagner les équipes dans la gestion du changement lors de l'implantation de nouvelles solutions, notamment par la formation et la documentation;
  • Proposer et réaliser des analyses descriptives et exploratoires pour identifier des tendances, infos pertinentes, anomalies ou opportunités;
  • Collaborer avec l'ensemble des équipes métiers AGA (actuariat, finances, opérations, marketing, etc.) afin de comprendre leurs besoins, analyser leurs flux de travail afin de proposer des solutions et identifier des axes d'amélioration basées sur les données;
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de gestion de données et de production de rapports;
  • Documenter les méthodologies, les besoins, les indicateurs de performance, les mesures, les tableaux de bord, les schémas de données, les sources de données, les processus afin d'assurer la traçabilité et la fiabilité des analyses;
  • Déterminer les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI), élaborer les mesures nécessaires à l'évaluation de la performance, analyser l'évolution des résultats et développer des modèles prévisionnels lorsque requis;
  • Effectuer des analyses ad hoc ou extraire des listes de données selon les besoins;
  • Documenter et mettre à jour de façon quotidienne et systématique l'ensemble de ses tâches et projets dans JIRA, afin d'assurer un suivi clair et en temps réel de l'avancement;
  • Créer et maintenir des flux Power Automate;
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche connexe de même nature et en relation directe avec cet emploi ou à la demande de son supérieur.

Le·la candidat·e idéal·e possède ce qui suit:

Formation et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, finances, intelligence d’affaires, informatique / sciences informatiques / informatique de gestion, gestion de l'information ou Baccalauréat d’ingénieur (génie informatique / génie des technologies de l’information) et/ou d’ingénierie et analytique des données (Maîtrise est un atout);
  • 5-7 ans d’expérience en analyse de données, prévisions et création de tableaux de bord;
  • Expérience en assurances collectives est un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • Maîtrise de Power BI;
  • Maîtrise d’Excel, de la suite Office et de SQL;
  • Compétences mathématiques et/ou académiques nécessaires pour recueillir, mesurer, organiser et analyser des données et effectuer des prévisions statistiques;
  • Capacité à transformer des données brutes en informations utiles et compréhensibles;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, pour collaborer efficacement avec nos équipes partout au Canada;
  • Connaissance de Power Automate un atout;
  • Connaissance de Power BI Report Builder un atout;
  • Familiarité avec un langage de programmation analytique (Python ou R) un atout;
  • Connaissance de base de JIRA et de Confluence un atout.

Qualités personnelles et professionnelles

  • Esprit analytique développé et grande rigueur;
  • Forte curiosité analytique et esprit critique pour proposer des axes d’analyse innovants et des visualisations percutantes;
  • Excellent sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités;
  • Aptitude à travailler en équipe et à communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques (vulgarisation des calculs ou des résultats);
  • Discrétion et respect de la confidentialité des données.

Title: Data Analyst – French/English Proficiency Required
Description:
Peek is the operating system powering the experiences industry - from museums and attractions to tours and activities. With over $7B in bookings, Peek’s AI-powered platform has helped thousands of merchants to increase revenues, save time, and deliver seamless guest experiences. Customers include MoMA, Whitney Museum, Seattle Aquarium, Bryant Park & Looping Group. The company has raised over $150 million from institutional investors Westcap, Goldman Sachs, and SpringCoast Partners. Learn more at www.peek.com.

As a remote-first company recognized by Forbes as one of America's Best Startup Employers and by Built In as a 2025 and 2026 Best Place to Work, we are a global team of "Peeksters" who "Obsess Over Our Customers," "Accomplish Big Things," "Collaborate With Purpose," and "Get Better Every Day.




About The Role

Peek is looking for a curious, product-minded, and data-driven Data Analyst – Analytics, AI, and Customer Insights to help turn data into meaningful insights, reporting, and business improvements.

In this role, you’ll work across business intelligence, product analytics, partner-facing analytics, and AI-enabled workflows. You’ll support internal teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership, while also helping deliver insights directly to Peek’s business customers.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


MS/MA + 2 years or BS/BA + 3 years of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
Proficiency in SQL
Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
Strong statistical knowledge
Working knowledge of Python
Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs, MBRs
Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is CA$121,100 - CA$181,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

o Experience supporting acute care hospital analytics and decision support functions

o Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, SPSS, SAS, etc.)

o Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy

o Resilience and ability to persevere in difficult situations, overcome obstacles, and reach high levels of performance when faced with stressful work situations and time pressures

o Five (5) years' experience in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, reporting development, preferably in an acute care hospital environment

o Ability to analyze large datasets

o Ability to write comprehensive reports

o Strong verbal and written communication skills

o An analytical mind and inclination for problem-solving and strong attention to detail

o Familiarity with healthcare information systems, and/or enterprise architecture an asset

o Experience with Microsoft Suite including MS Project and SharePoint

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Power BI)
Description:
Join us at Reesink Canada! If you are looking to join a company of motivated people who make a difference and your skills align with our position description, you've found us! We are looking forward to hearing from you.

The Business Intelligence Analyst is an entry-level role that turns financial and operational data into clear, reliable information to support decision-making. Working under guidance from Operations, Finance and IT, the Data Analyst builds and maintains Power BI reports and dashboards, uses AI tools to support data extraction and presentation, and helps consolidate and analyze data from across the organization's operating companies. The position is a remote and based in AB, SK, or MB.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Dashboard Development (Power BI):


Help build and maintain interactive Power BI reports and dashboards that present financial and operational data in clear, useful views.
Assist in developing data models, relationships, and measures (DAX) under the guidance of senior team members.
Help manage datasets, refresh schedules, and report updates to keep reporting reliable and current.
Support the use of standardized report templates and self-service reporting across the organization.


Data Extraction, Integration & Automation


Assist in extracting, transforming, and consolidating data from multiple financial and operational systems into analysis-ready datasets.
Help build and maintain repeatable data-preparation steps (e.g., Power Query) to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
Use approved AI tools to support data extraction, cleansing, categorization, and the identification of patterns and anomalies.
Share ideas for AI and automation tools that could improve data extraction, analysis, and presentation.


Financial & Operational Analysis


Support the analysis of financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities.
Assist in consolidating data across operating companies and branch locations to provide an accurate view of performance.
Track and report key performance indicators aligned with business objectives.
Contribute timely, accurate data to budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting.


Data Presentation & Decision Support


Work with Finance, Operations, and other colleagues to understand information needs and translate business questions into clear reports and visualizations.
Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis to support day-to-day operational decisions.
Present findings clearly and concisely, using AI tools where appropriate to help summarize insights.


Data Quality & Continuous Improvement


Help ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data used in reports and analysis; investigate discrepancies and escalate as needed.
Follow data definitions, standards, and reporting methodologies, and help keep documentation current.
Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, operational, customer, and employee information, following data governance, security, and privacy practices, including the responsible use of approved AI tools.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and tools.


Qualifications


Post-secondary education (completed or in progress) in Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
Foundational experience with Power BI — through coursework, co-op, personal projects, or early work experience — with a strong interest in developing further.
Exposure to, or a keen interest in learning, AI tools for data extraction, analysis, and presentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel; familiarity with Power Query, SQL, or other data tools is an asset.
Familiarity with data from business systems (e.g., ERP, financial, or operational platforms) is an asset.
An understanding of the agriculture industry — through education, background, or work experience — is a strong asset.


What We Offer


Competitive Salary, comprehensive benefits: including health, dental, vision.
Registered Retirement Saving Plan contributions program
Ongoing professional development and training.
A positive, team-oriented work environment with a focus on employee success.


We value diversity and inclusion, strive for an equitable workplace where employees can be their authentic selves, and support the diverse people and communities we serve. We do not discriminate against applicants on any protected grounds.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

Amazon Canada Fulfillment Services is hiring a Data Analyst to support the Inventory Control / Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. The Data Analyst assigned to ICQA will work closely with the ICQA and operations teams in Inbound and Outbound to provide data and analytical support for ACES initiatives, root cause investigation of defects, and will provide support to ensure compliance to ICQA-related SoX requirements.

The Data Analyst will own the insights, set up analysis, and create automated dashboards and reporting. They will be responsible for identifying data sources (internal / external) to invent and simplify mechanisms and create custom reporting and analytics automation tools.

This role provides real opportunity to develop original ideas, approaches and solutions in an ever-changing and competitive business climate.

Key job responsibilities


Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma
2+ years of professional work experience, or experience in MS Office, with an emphasis on Excel
Experience writing complex Excel VBA macros
Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.
