FOP CONSULTANTS est à la recherche d’Analystes BI motivé à la réalisation de mandats. Les principales missions seraient d’analyser les besoins d’information et de développer les solutions de renseignements d’affaires, de concevoir les modèles de données et les tableaux de bord, d’assurer la qualité et la fiabilité des données, d’automatiser les flux d’alimentation et d’accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’exploitation des données

RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES

  • Analyser les besoins d’information et définir les indicateurs et les règles de calcul.
  • Concevoir et développer les modèles de données, les rapports et les tableaux de bord.
  • Développer et maintenir les flux d’alimentation et de transformation des données (ETL/ELT).
  • Assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité des données et des livrables.
  • Optimiser la performance des modèles, des requêtes et des rapports.
  • Documenter les modèles, les dictionnaires de données et les procédures d’exploitation.
  • Accompagner les utilisateurs d’affaires et soutenir l’autonomie analytique

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Diplôme universitaire en informatique, gestion ou toutes disciplines connexes.
  • Cinq (05) à dix (10) années d’expérience en technologie de l’information.
  • Trois (03) à sept (07) années d’expérience comme analyste BI.
  • Expérience avec l’un des cadre suivants : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, DSDM, SAFe, Nexus.
  • Détenir l’une des certifications suivantes : PL-300, DP-600.
  • Détenir l’une des certifications suivantes (atout) : DP-900, DP-700, AI-900.

  • Langue : Français

MODE DE TRAVAIL

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Legend

At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.

The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, reporting directly into our Head of Data and Insights.

This is a high-impact opportunity for a Senior Data Analyst who wants to do more than answer questions with data. You’ll sit at the heart of our Sports business, partnering with teams across Product, Commercial, Marketing and SEO to uncover opportunities, challenge thinking and influence the decisions that drive performance.

You’ll be joining at an exciting point of transformation. With new products, evolving business models and a growing ambition for how we use data across Sports, you’ll play a key role in shaping the next phase of our analytics capability and how data is used to drive decision-making across the business.

From building smarter forecasting models and transforming how we measure performance, to exploring customer behaviour and laying the foundations for future personalisation, you’ll own complex analytical challenges from problem through to recommendation. This is a hands-on senior role with real visibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make data a genuine driver of commercial and product strategy.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.

Your Impact


Deliver end-to-end analytical projects that help shape commercial, product and marketing decisions across our Sports portfolio.
Build advanced forecasting models that combine financial planning, historical performance, seasonality and sporting events to improve business forecasting.
Redesign and enhance our Tableau dashboard suite, providing stakeholders with faster, more actionable performance insights.
Improve the quality and accessibility of data by identifying gaps, optimising reporting and partnering with Data Engineering to strengthen data pipelines.
Apply statistical analysis, behavioural analytics and experimentation to uncover opportunities that drive revenue, conversion and long-term business growth.
Mentor team members while proactively identifying future analytical opportunities that help mature our Performance & Insights function.


What You'll Bring


Expert-level SQL alongside strong Python (preferred) or R, Tableau and statistical analysis skills.
Proven experience independently delivering end-to-end analytical projects from scoping through to implementation.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Commercial mindset with experience using data to influence business strategy and decision-making.
Experience mentoring or supporting team members while driving high standards across analytical delivery.
Experience within sports betting, iGaming or another digital business with strong web analytics exposure is highly desirable.


The Interview Process

1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom)

2nd: Interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Senior People Partner (1 hour video via Zoom)

3rd: Take home task - you will be given a task to complete and return to us for assessment

4th: Final interview with our team, Hiring Manager and Sports Stakeholder (1 hour video via Zoom)

Why Legend?


Super smart colleagues to work alongside and learn from.
Engaging development opportunities at all levels.
Tailored flexibility for your work-life balance.
Annual discretionary bonus to reward your efforts.
Paid annual leave PLUS a well-deserved break to recharge your batteries during the festive season! Our offices are closed between Christmas and New Year's, allowing you to enjoy downtime without dipping into your annual allowance.
Exciting global Legend events, where we unite in person to ignite our shared passion and unveil the exciting strategies for the year ahead!


Unlock your full potential by joining the Legend team. To support you on this journey, we provide an extensive array of benefits and perks, as outlined in our global offerings above. For country specific benefits please reach out to your talent partner.

Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on  [email protected] , and we'll do all we can to support you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
A career as a Senior Data Analyst in the Financial crime team at National Bank means serving as a Data and Analytics Specialist. This position allows you to have a concrete impact on decision-making and the evolution of the sector's analytical capabilities thanks to your expertise in data analysis, business intelligence and information governance. You will play a key role in transforming data into strategic information, supporting business partners in their decisions and contributing to the evolution of data solutions in a constantly changing environment.




Your job

Understand the needs of business partners and translate them into data requirements and adapted analytical solutions.
Analyze sector data, define business rules and ensure they are documented in order to support rigourous governance.
Prepare and validate reliable data for reports, dashboards, analyses and strategic initiatives.
Work with the it and data engineering teams to develop data platforms and contribute to modernisation projects, particularly on snowflake.
Diagnose data issues, identify their causes and coordinate their resolution to ensure operational continuity.
Produce value-added analyses, make recommendations based on data and communicate the results to the partners concerned.




Your team

The Vice-President, Technology and Data, more specialists work in an agile, proactive and collaborative manner to seize opportunities, stay on the cutting edge of technology and continuously improve processes.

Within the Financial crime and regulatory projects sector, you will be part of the FinCrim Data Warehouse team and report to the Senior Manager – it Delivery – Data and Analytics. Our team stands out for its expertise in data engineering, its culture of collaboration and its commitment to developing reliable, high-performance and scalable solutions that support the Bank's financial crime activities and regulatory initiatives. Our goal is to offer you maximum flexibility to promote your quality of life. This includes a hybrid work environment and a flexible, adaptable schedule.

The Bank values continuous development and internal mobility. Our personalised training programs, based on on on-the-job learning, help you master your profession and develop new fields of expertise. Tools such as the Data Academy, language training, the Harvard Learning Centre and coaching and mentoring support are available to you at any time.




Prerequisites

A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Analytics, Business Intelligence or a related field.
Over two years of significant experience in data analysis, business intelligence or analytics in a complex data environment.
Proficient SQL and be able to analyse complex data sets.
Python experience analyzing, profiling or automating data
Ability to transform business needs into data requirements and analytical solutions
Knowledge of modern data platforms, such as snowflake, as well as data modelling concepts, such as Data Vault or dimensional modelling.

Languages: French, English
Reason to require this language: you will need to discuss frequently with our service providers or partners who speak a language other than French.
Required skills: Business Acumen, Dashboard Creation, Data Cleansing, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data pipeline, Data Validator, Data Vaults, Data Visualization, Exploratory Data Analysis, Microsoft SQL Server, Python, Risk Data and Analytics, Snowflake, Teamwork

Your benefits
In addition to competitive compensation, upon hiring you’ll be eligible for a wide range of flexible benefits to help promote your wellbeing and that of your family such as:

* Health and wellness program, including many options
* Flexible group insurance
* Generous pension plan
* Employee Share Ownership Plan
* Employee and family assistance program
* Preferential banking services
* Involvement in community initiatives
* Telemedicine service
* Virtual sleep clinic

We have an offer that keeps up with trends as well as your needs and those of your family.

Our dynamic work environments and cutting-edge collaboration tools foster a positive employee experience. We value employees’ ideas. Whether through our surveys or programs, regular feedback and ongoing communication are encouraged.

We’re a bank on a human scale that stands out for its courage, entrepreneurial culture, and passion for people. Our mission is to have a positive impact on people’s lives. Our core values of partnership, agility, and empowerment inspire us, and inclusion is central to our commitments. We aim, wherever possible, to provide a barrier-free and accessible environment to all employees.

Join us!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

We are currently hiring a Data Analyst to join our Event Analysis and Insight team. Candidates must have a passion for data manipulation and visualization and the ability to think both independently and collaboratively. They will work on the analysis of post event data, reports and providing insight.

Candidates must be comfortable working within a fast-paced, and at times highly demanding environment. They must possess a keen sense of enthusiasm and attention to detail, as well as a sense of commitment and dedication to both teams.

You’ll Feel Right At Home If You


Have at least 1 year of relevant experience.
Have exceptional attention to detail and data gathering skills
Are great at finding patterns
Are great at presenting findings
Love digging through data in search of clues
Strong desire to leverage the use of AI
Are able to balance several time sensitive requests
Have effective communication skills (oral and written)
Are extremely organized
Are willing to learn and adapt to a quickly-changing environment
Have completed a Bachelor’s degree in a related field - economics, finance, commerce, Information Technology or computer science
Have a good knowledge of Python for data manipulation and visualization
Thrive in environments where multitasking is routine and can prioritize tasks effectively.
Thrive in a fast-paced working environment
Ability to work off hours when necessary


What You’ll Be Working On


Analyzing non-financial post event data in order to gain insight and discover potential issues.
Creating reports and visualizations to help bring forward relevant information to the stake holders.
Collaborating with the development team to improve and/or create the necessary analysis tools.
Creating issue tickets and following up with the appropriate teams.
Participating in the research effort revolving around the trade strategies.
Developing necessary scripts for data gathering and manipulation.


For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.


A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***


At Roofr, building a powerful user experience starts with data. As a Senior Data Analyst at an early-stage, high-growth company, you’ll play a critical role in turning raw data into insights that shape product decisions, drive strategy, and improve the customer experience. You’ll have a direct impact on how we use data to grow, and help influence the roadmap for how analytics evolves at Roofr.

This role sits at the intersection of data analytics and business, ideal for someone comfortable moving between modeling data, building dashboards, and advising senior leadership on growth opportunities.

What You'll Get to Do:


Partner directly with business and product owners to shape roadmaps, prioritize features, and measure success
Build an AI-first business intelligence platform to supercharge self-serve analysis
Deliver actionable insights on user behavior, market trends, and business performance to marketing, revenue and product teams.
Lead sales and marketing analytics by defining KPIs and optimizing our acquisition funnels.
Tell compelling data stories to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences
Transform, clean, and model raw data using DBT to create reliable, analytics-ready datasets
Take ownership of our analytics foundation, inheriting existing models (DBT) and data warehouse structure (Snowflake) to clean, improve, and scale them alongside a Senior Analytics Engineer.


What You'll Bring to the Role:


7+ years of experience in data analysis and/or data science, ideally on sales, marketing, and growth analytics at a SaaS company
Expertise hacking AI/ML and automation tools for growth purposes, on top of using Claude, Cortex and other AI tools to streamline analytics workflow
Proficient in BI tools like Metabase, Sigma, Tableau, Omni, or Looker
Strong SQL skills and experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, PostgreSQL)
Hands-on experience with DBT for managing the Transform layer of ELT pipelines
Ability to work cross-functionally to define metrics, create dashboards, and ensure data quality
A strong analytical mindset with a keen eye for detail and accuracy


Who You Are:


Loves transforming messy data into clean models and insights
Thrives at bringing structure to chaos and able to find focus while juggling multiple projects
Lead with intent and proactively bring ideas to our partners and stakeholders
Eager to elevate your team and organization to new heights
A strong communicator with great presentation skills
Analytical with a demonstrated ability to utilize data to make informed decisions
A critical thinker who doesn’t settle for the status quo


Compensation Band: $130,000.00 - $140,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:


1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
Flexible time off
80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
RRSP/401k match
Generous Parental Leave policy


🤝 Perks:


We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
Home office setup stipend
Internet and phone allowance
Remote first culture
Weekly Friday paydays!


🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The RA&S Analytics team partners with business, marketing, distribution, product, and technology teams to turn complex data into actionable insights that improve marketing performance, advisor engagement, sales outcomes, and the client experience. The team is evolving from primarily delivering reporting and analytical support to building scalable data products, automated measurement solutions, and decision-ready insights that enable faster and more informed business decisions.

Reporting to the Manager of RA&S Marketing Analytics, the Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in this transformation. You will lead analytics from business-question definition through data integration, analysis, visualization, and recommendation. By connecting marketing, digital, prospect, client, advisor, and sales data, you will help stakeholders understand end-to-end journeys, identify performance opportunities, and translate analytical findings into measurable business actions.

Working collaboratively across RA&S and the broader Data and Analytics community, you will develop trusted reporting and analytical solutions, automate recurring processes, and communicate clear insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders. This role is well suited to someone who combines strong technical capability with curiosity, business acumen, stakeholder partnership, and a passion for solving complex problems.

Sun Life views success in this role related to 4 key characteristics:

Fierce curiosity. You are drawn to discovering and leveraging new data and taking on challenging business puzzles.

Understanding business. We’ve got a lot of data, but it’s not going to turn itself into insights, and you can’t help with that unless you understand what the numbers mean.

A passion for solving problems. The most successful data analysts don’t just spin data and give numbers; they solve the problem.

Technical skills. How to wrangle structured data is a must (i.e., SQL) with strong Python/PySpark skills needed as we migrate from on-prem computing using SAS to cloud based computing using Python. This role will also have a digital analysis component (Adobe Analytics).

What will you do?


Support analytical work from requirements specification, data gathering, analysis to presentations to solve business problems. Be the analytical resource for the RA&S marketing teams
Develop decision-ready reporting and dashboards that highlight performance drivers, emerging trends, and recommended actions.
Merge campaign and digital analytics data with back-end source data to highlight our client journeys from beginning to end
Draw out business insights from analytical output and work with team leads to put together business recommendations
Put together effective presentations of findings and desire to present to multiple levels of stakeholders
scalability, and team capacity.
Leverage internal training, peers and other sources to continue to grow capabilities


What will you need to succeed?


5+ years working with data (i.e., quantitative analysis experience, including handling, manipulating and analyzing data and creating analytical reports)
Comfortable writing complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple database sources
Expert using Python/PySpark to work with data, with the flexibility to use both languages as we transition from one to the other
Experience working with AWS stack – SageMaker, Glue, Lambda
Experience with Adobe analytics, data visualization tools like Tableau, Quick Sight or the ability to self-learn these tools in role
An effective and concise oral and written storytelling and communication skills
Ability to work as a team to help deliver multiple projects with courage in managing expectations of team leaders
Ability to document work
BSc in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)


What will be nice to have?


Experience in life insurance/wealth management, or other financial services industry (e.g., retail banking, credit card, re-insurance and casualty insurance)
Understanding of predictive and prescriptive techniques (i.e., regression, decision trees, deep learning etc.)
MSc preferably in a statistical, mathematical, or technical field (i.e., computer science)
Experience working with unstructured data


Unique Requirements:


This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.
Must be able to satisfactorily complete applicable background checks prior to the start date and during employment, in accordance with Sun Life’s policies and practices.

In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Title: Data Analyst, Go-To-Market Sales Insights
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Data is at the heart of Lyft Business's products and decision-making. We're looking to hire a Data Analyst to build the tools and analytics that drive revenue for the sales organization behind Lyft's B2B portfolio — a multi-billion-dollar book of business spanning healthcare, business travel, corporate commute, automotive, and transit. This team has real say in what gets built.

You will be the analytical partner to our Sales and account teams — someone who can translate findings into a clear narrative for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities:


Build the tools and analytics sales leaders use to grow their accounts — pacing views, account-health signals, territory and segment views that change what a rep or manager does next
Field requests from Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, leadership, and external stakeholders, and decide what's worth building, what's worth a sharp piece of analysis, and what's out of scope
Build and maintain production data pipelines, and automate recurring workflows, with documentation and validation clear enough that a teammate — or an AI agent — can use them without asking you first
Define what the team's core metrics mean and where they live, so every dashboard, report, and tool returns the same answer to the same question
Contribute to the internal tools and semantic layer — prompts, context, and guardrails — that let stakeholders query B2B data in natural language and trust what comes back
Translate insights into a cohesive narrative and present technical findings to senior leadership and non-technical audiences


Experience:


Degree (or related work experience) with a focus in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, or other quantitative fields
3+ years of experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role, ideally supporting a sales, go-to-market, or B2B organization
Proficiency in SQL — able to read, write, and review structured, efficient queries on large data sets, whether you wrote them yourself or an AI coding assistant did; you own the correctness of every query and result before it reaches stakeholders
Experience building production data assets — pipelines, data models, or orchestrated tables (Airflow, dbt, or similar) — not only ad-hoc analysis
Proficiency in a data visualization tool like Tableau, Hex, Mode, or similar
Experience with sales or account analytics — pipeline, bookings, pacing to target, account segmentation — is a strong plus
Experience with Python for data analysis and automation is a strong plus
Commercial instinct paired with a builder's instinct — a track record of turning a recurring request into a durable tool or dataset instead of answering it one more time
A track record of influencing business decisions through analysis, and an ownership mindset toward the metrics and datasets you build
Strong analytical skills with the ability to tackle ambiguous problems, break them down, and deliver clear, actionable insights
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data to a variety of stakeholders clearly and compellingly
A strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and integrity
Ability to collaborate across functions, manage competing priorities, and drive projects to completion


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

What We Offer

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:


Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.


For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

POSITION OBJECTIVE:

Niagara Health is entering a time of great opportunity and transformation. We are looking for exceptional individuals to be part of our extraordinary team and future that includes a focus on leveraging information and technology to transform how we plan and deliver patient care at Niagara Health and across the Niagara region.




Reporting to the Manager, Enterprise Analytics, the Data Analyst is responsible for the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of reporting and analytics solutions within the Oracle-Cerner Millennium environment. Leveraging Cerner Command Language (CCL) and enterprise analytics tools, the incumbent will support Niagara Health's clinical, operational, and strategic reporting requirements by transforming data into actionable information for decision-makers. The role requires strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills, with a focus on ensuring data integrity, report performance, and adherence to reporting standards and best practices.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

o Develop, maintain, and optimize reports, extracts, and data solutions using Cerner Command Language (CCL) within the Millennium EMR environment

o Design and validate data extracts to support quality improvement, operational planning, research, performance measurement, and decision support activities

o Develop and implement report queries from various, data collection systems, and conduct data analytics, and other query/reporting writing strategies

o Develop and support standard, ad hoc, and regulatory reports utilizing Millennium, enterprise data warehouses, and other reporting platforms

o Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets

o Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities to ensure the accuracy and integrity of reporting outputs

o Support data governance initiatives through adherence to enterprise standards, business definitions, metadata management, and reporting best practices

o Monitor and optimize report performance and efficiency within the Millennium environment

o Provide technical expertise and guidance related to Millennium data structures, workflows, and CCL reporting capabilities

o Support organizational reporting requirements related to Ontario Health, Ministry of Health, CIHI, Accreditation, and other mandatory reporting obligations

o Locate and define new process improvement opportunities

o Communicate complex information so that it is easy to understand and influences others to act based on the insightful data analysis




SKILLS:

o Advanced experience developing reports using Cerner Command Language (CCL) within the Millennium EMR environment

o Strong understanding of Cerner Millennium data models, clinical workflows, and healthcare information systems

o Strong knowledge of and experience with reporting packages (Business Objects etc., MS-SQL, PL/SQL, Microsoft Office Outlook, Word, Access, Excel- (Pivot Tables, V-Lookups, Macros, Formulas), databases (SQL etc.)

o Knowledge of healthcare performance indicators, regulatory reporting, and data quality practices

o Demonstrated ability to interpret complex clinical and operational requirements and translate them into effective reporting solutions

o Experience supporting acute care hospital analytics and decision support functions

o Knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets (Excel, SPSS, SAS, etc.)

o Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy

o Resilience and ability to persevere in difficult situations, overcome obstacles, and reach high levels of performance when faced with stressful work situations and time pressures




QUALIFICATIONS:

o Five (5) years' experience in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, reporting development, preferably in an acute care hospital environment

o Bachelor's degree in a related discipline such as Health Informatics, Health Information Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field

o Ability to analyze large datasets

o Ability to write comprehensive reports

o Strong verbal and written communication skills

o An analytical mind and inclination for problem-solving and strong attention to detail

o Familiarity with healthcare information systems, and/or enterprise architecture an asset

o Experience with Microsoft Suite including MS Project and SharePoint

Development of data collection processes and data management systems
Maintenance of data integrity (0% error rate)
Designing of queries, compiling of data, and generation of reports in MS Excel
Charting and graphing of data for reporting purposes
In depth research of defect trends
Data collection and entry as needed
Data mining and problem solving
Back up for Process Assistant duties


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of professional or military experience
Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Are 18 years of age or older
2+ years of business analyst, data analyst or an equivalent role experience
1+ years of using SQL to extract and manipulate data experience
Bachelor's degree, or High school or equivalent diploma

Experience in advanced SQL, Python, Tableau
Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
Experience with modern software development, web development frameworks, APIs
1+ years of project management experience


Preferred Qualifications


3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
Experience programming with at least one software programming language, or experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling
Experience with data scripting languages (e.g., SQL, Python, R, or equivalent) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g., R, SAS, Matlab, or equivalent)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Supply Chain or related field.

Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics
Description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. This isn't a "maintain the dashboard" role. It's a chance to help build something new. You'll be a self-starter who is equally comfortable writing SQL and presenting findings to a VP.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests from across the People organization — scoping needs, setting expectations, and delivering high-quality analytical outputs
Build and maintain ThoughtSpot dashboards and liveboards for a broad stakeholder audience including recruiters, People Team members, HRBPs, managers, and executives
Explore and operationalize ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities — including Spotter and AI Highlights — to surface proactive insights for People stakeholders who may not know what question to ask yet
Build and administer survey programs in Qualtrics — including survey design, distribution logic, and close-out — and translate results into dashboards and ad-hoc analyses that inform People team decisions
Partner with Talent and People team leads to define key metrics and help them tell meaningful stories with their data
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for both People leadership and senior executives
Communicate fluently across technical and non-technical audiences — from SQL-level data discussions to exec-facing summaries
Collaborate with systems and operations partners to improve upstream data quality and enable better downstream analytics
Pull together ad-hoc datasets from disparate sources to answer discrete analytical questions quickly and accurately


Experience:


4+ years of experience in data or business analytics
3+ years of SQL experience, with comfort pulling from complex, multi-source data environments
Experience with ThoughtSpot or a comparable modern BI platform; enthusiasm for AI-assisted analytics and a curiosity about what those tools unlock for people data specifically
Familiarity with Workday or a comparable HCM (understanding the business processes and data model, not just surface-level reporting)
Familiarity with Greenhouse or a comparable ATS preferred
Experience with Qualtrics or a comparable survey platform, including hands-on program administration and the ability to move from raw survey data to a clean, stakeholder-ready analysis
Experience building and maintaining analytical models that others rely on
Understanding of the nuances of people and recruiting data — org structures, headcount definitions, privacy considerations, and the ways these datasets can surprise you


Benefits:


Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
Mental health benefits
Family building benefits
Child care and pet benefits
Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The People Analytics team at Lyft exists to build data trust — turning people data into clear, reliable insights that help our HR Business Partners, talent leaders, and executives make better decisions. We're a small, high-impact team in the middle of a meaningful BI transformation: we recently moved to ThoughtSpot as our primary analytics platform, and we're not just replicating old dashboards — we're rethinking what self-service analytics looks like for a People team. That includes exploring ThoughtSpot's AI capabilities to surface proactive insights, enable natural language querying, and reduce the friction between a business question and a data answer. There's real greenfield work here, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what AI-powered people analytics looks like at Lyft.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our People Analytics team, based in Toronto. You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Analytics and serve as the first point of contact for incoming data requests across the People organization — triaging, scoping, and delivering on analytical needs ranging from quick ad-hoc pulls to fully built ThoughtSpot dashboards.

This role is well-timed: you'll be joining as we complete our migration from Tableau to ThoughtSpot, which means you'll have genuine influence over how we build our reporting layer and push into ThoughtSpot's AI features — think natural language search, AI-generated insights, and proactive anomaly detection applied to people data. Title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Power BI)
Description:
Join us at Reesink Canada! If you are looking to join a company of motivated people who make a difference and your skills align with our position description, you've found us! We are looking forward to hearing from you.

The Business Intelligence Analyst is an entry-level role that turns financial and operational data into clear, reliable information to support decision-making. Working under guidance from Operations, Finance and IT, the Data Analyst builds and maintains Power BI reports and dashboards, uses AI tools to support data extraction and presentation, and helps consolidate and analyze data from across the organization's operating companies. The position is a remote and based in AB, SK, or MB.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Dashboard Development (Power BI):


Help build and maintain interactive Power BI reports and dashboards that present financial and operational data in clear, useful views.
Assist in developing data models, relationships, and measures (DAX) under the guidance of senior team members.
Help manage datasets, refresh schedules, and report updates to keep reporting reliable and current.
Support the use of standardized report templates and self-service reporting across the organization.


Data Extraction, Integration & Automation


Assist in extracting, transforming, and consolidating data from multiple financial and operational systems into analysis-ready datasets.
Help build and maintain repeatable data-preparation steps (e.g., Power Query) to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
Use approved AI tools to support data extraction, cleansing, categorization, and the identification of patterns and anomalies.
Share ideas for AI and automation tools that could improve data extraction, analysis, and presentation.


Financial & Operational Analysis


Support the analysis of financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities.
Assist in consolidating data across operating companies and branch locations to provide an accurate view of performance.
Track and report key performance indicators aligned with business objectives.
Contribute timely, accurate data to budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting.


Data Presentation & Decision Support


Work with Finance, Operations, and other colleagues to understand information needs and translate business questions into clear reports and visualizations.
Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis to support day-to-day operational decisions.
Present findings clearly and concisely, using AI tools where appropriate to help summarize insights.


Data Quality & Continuous Improvement


Help ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data used in reports and analysis; investigate discrepancies and escalate as needed.
Follow data definitions, standards, and reporting methodologies, and help keep documentation current.
Maintain strict confidentiality of financial, operational, customer, and employee information, following data governance, security, and privacy practices, including the responsible use of approved AI tools.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and tools.


Qualifications


Post-secondary education (completed or in progress) in Data Analytics, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
Foundational experience with Power BI — through coursework, co-op, personal projects, or early work experience — with a strong interest in developing further.
Exposure to, or a keen interest in learning, AI tools for data extraction, analysis, and presentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel; familiarity with Power Query, SQL, or other data tools is an asset.
Familiarity with data from business systems (e.g., ERP, financial, or operational platforms) is an asset.
An understanding of the agriculture industry — through education, background, or work experience — is a strong asset.


What We Offer


Competitive Salary, comprehensive benefits: including health, dental, vision.
Registered Retirement Saving Plan contributions program
Ongoing professional development and training.
A positive, team-oriented work environment with a focus on employee success.


We value diversity and inclusion, strive for an equitable workplace where employees can be their authentic selves, and support the diverse people and communities we serve. We do not discriminate against applicants on any protected grounds.

A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

Title: Senior Product Analyst - EA Sports FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note: this is a regular full-time (hybrid) role. Qualified applicants must be available to work in the Vancouver studio 3x per week. Canadian work authorization is required.

Data Analyst - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with production and product management partners to drive data-informed decisions within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data investigator, visualizer, and designer, helping to enhance the core experiences of our global player base.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets.
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners.
Explore user behavioral patterns to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies.
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$92,900 - $129,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada's top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Enterprise Data Solutions team. In this role, you'll help build integrated, reliable, and scalable data solutions that support business decision-making across the organization. Working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Greenhouse, and Dayforce, you'll collaborate with business and technology partners to analyze data, support system integrations, improve data quality, and contribute to impactful enterprise-wide data initiatives. If you're curious, analytical, and enjoy working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, this could be an exciting next step in your career. Our offices operate on a hybrid model with three days per week in-office to support team collaboration.

What You Will Do


Analyze and profile data across enterprise systems to identify trends, issues, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with business and technology stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into data solutions.
Support the design and development of scalable data models and data structures for reporting, analytics, and integrations.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to define and validate data transformation rules.
Test and validate REST APIs, integrations, and data flows between business applications and data platforms.
Perform data quality, reconciliation, and validation activities to ensure accuracy and completeness of information.
Develop and execute test cases for data mappings, APIs, and end-to-end integration processes.
Document data models, mappings, integration requirements, and technical processes.
Participate in Agile delivery activities, including testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
Help identify opportunities to improve data usability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the organization.


What You Bring


3-5 years of experience in data analysis, business systems analysis, data integration, or a related technology role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analyzing relational data.
Experience working with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Dayforce, Greenhouse, or similar CRM, ATS, HRIS, or SaaS platforms.
Knowledge of relational data modelling concepts and data integration principles.
Experience working with and testing REST APIs, including JSON and API testing tools such as Postman.
Strong experience in data validation, reconciliation, and data quality analysis.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
Ability to document requirements, data mappings, testing activities, and technical processes.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.
Familiarity with Agile delivery practices and software development lifecycles.
Experience with Power BI or other reporting and analytics platforms.
Experience with Python or another scripting language.
Exposure to cloud-based data platforms, data warehouses, or modern data technologies.
Experience working with HR, recruiting, CRM, finance, or other enterprise business data.
Financial services or other regulated industry experience.


The starting salary for this position is $110,000 - $130,000. The starting salary provided reflects the base salary for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation of this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

What We Offer

At Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group, we’re "invested in our greatest asset, you". Our shared goals reflect what matters most to our people:


Your community: we foster belonging through collaboration, inclusion and flexibility. Enjoy social events, volunteering and a strong commitment to corporate social responsibility. Our flexible work practices are designed to support work-life balance and provide employees with flexibility in where and how they work
Your growth: we prioritize your development with meaningful work, continuous learning budgets, paid study days and support for professional designations.
Recognizing you: your contributions are rewarded with competitive total compensation, retirement savings support, wellness credits, enhanced parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.


For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.
