Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Overview

Remarcable is purpose-built for trade contractors, helping them manage procurement, tools, and warehouse operations with unmatched visibility and control. As we scale across North America, data is at the core of how we deliver on that promise.

As our Data Scientist, you'll partner closely with Data Engineering to design and build out our data lakehouse, bringing data from across the business into one place to power in-platform and internal reporting, sharpen Remarcable's product intelligence, and surface the trends and next-step recommendations that help contractors and our own teams make better decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who's comfortable wearing multiple hats (analyst, scientist, developer) to shape data architecture and build out reporting, models, and insights that drive action and decision-making.

What You’ll Do


Partner with Data Engineering to design the lakehouse's semantic and analytical layers (on top of AWS S3, Redshift, Athena, Glue)
Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analyses, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholder
Analyze product, operations, and customer usage data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities that inform product and business decisions
Build models and heuristics that power Remarcable Intelligence (e.g. smart search, recommendation engine, forecasting)
Build out AI/ML data infrastructure - feature engineering, training datasets, and model evaluation - supporting SageMaker and Bedrock workflows
Develop and maintain core analytics supporting company metrics (ARR, churn, NRR, product usage, ROI)
Create customer-facing and internal reporting for customers and internal teams
Design and validate product experiments (A/B tests and other measurement methodologies) to drive data-informed decisions that improve user experience and business outcomes


Who You Are


5+ years of experience in a Data Scientist, Analytics, or similar role
Someone who thrives in a startup - adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by impact.
Strong SQL skills: complex queries, window functions, performance tuning
Proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy)
Experience building dashboards/reporting (e.g., QuickSight, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or custom-built reporting)
Experience with modern data transformation tools (e.g., dbt).
Experience building, validating, and deploying practical ML and heuristic models to solve business problems in a production setting (e.g. recommendation, trend analysis, scoring).
Bonus: experience with AWS data/ML stack (Redshift, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock), and/or building recommendation or "next best action" style features


Why join us?

High Impact: Join a builder-led team where your work directly shapes the core product used by thousands.

Culture: Hybrid work environment in our Vancouver office (1 WFH day).

Retirement: RRSP Matching Program (50% match on the first 6% of your contribution).

Care: Health Spending Account (HSA) and Wellness Spending Account (WSA) administered via RBC.

Competitive PTO

Who We Are

Remarcable is a cloud based platform that helps electrical contractors and distributors streamline purchasing processes to save time and money.

Dedicated to the Electrical Contractor Industry, Remarcable provides cloud-based Procurement & Tool Management Software nationwide. With multiple workflows, two applications in one software, and direct contractor accounting integrations, Remarcable significantly, and efficiently, increases communication, streamlines workflows, and provides visibility for all users.

Our team is composed of contractor and distribution experts located coast to coast. Through collaborations with industry leaders, we've gained insight into the struggles they face. Together, we believe in providing a solution that brings efficiency, visibility, and better communication to streamline the relationship between the contractor and distributor partners.

Our Mission

To advance the adoption of technology in the construction industry and bring better efficiency, visibility, and communication to our customers.

Remarcable is not associated with info-remarcable.com. For information about applying for a position with Remarcable, please reference remarcable.com.

Title: Actuarial Analyst
Description:
We’re searching for an Actuarial Analyst. Are you searching for new possibilities?

Westland Insurance Group Ltd is growing and has an exciting opportunity for an Actuarial Analyst to join our growing team. This hybrid role is based out of our Head Office in Surrey, BC.

Expected Compensation: The expected hiring range for this role is $80,000- $105,000 with a 35-hour work week. Your rate of pay will be determined based on your individual qualifications and experience, while considering internal equity.  Westland also offers a competitive annual short-term incentive program that enables employees to share in the rewards of the business and emphasizes the measures that are key to our success.

Discover What’s Possible, With Westland.

The Westland story is all about growth, and that means plenty of possibility for everyone on our team. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of clients, communities, and each other with equal commitment. As we continue to open new doors, we're inviting amazing people like you to join us.

As an Actuarial Analyst, you'll play a key role in supporting pricing strategy and data-driven decision making across Westland's in-house insurance products. Working alongside actuaries, data engineers, and analysts, you'll help shape the future of our pricing capabilities while building expertise in actuarial analysis, predictive modelling, and insurance analytics.

Interested in learning more?

Why You'll Love Westland


An open, flexible and welcoming workplace
Plenty of opportunities to grow and learn
Autonomy to drive your own success
Be part of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
A total rewards program that takes care of your financial, physical, and mental health
Flexible paid Values Days to celebrate days important to you
Paid Volunteer Days for employees as part of Amplifying Communities, a program to support causes that matter most to our employees and clients


Why We’ll Love You


You love working with data and using analytical thinking to uncover trends, solve problems, and support business decisions
You have a bachelor's degree in Actuarial Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, or another quantitative field and are actively pursuing an actuarial designation (CAS or SOA), with actuarial exams considered an asset
You have at least two years of experience in an actuarial, analytical, or data-focused role, with experience using SQL, Python, and/or R for analysis and modelling
You enjoy collaborating with actuaries, analysts, engineers, and business partners to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations
You can communicate complex findings clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences
You have strong attention to detail, sound critical-thinking skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work
Bonus: Experience with insurance pricing, predictive modelling, Power BI, Databricks, or P&C insurance


Once Here, You'll


Be a contributing member of our inclusive culture, alongside an extraordinarily talented community of people with a wide variety of backgrounds
Support actuarial pricing analyses and help monitor rate adequacy across Westland's portfolio of Personal and Commercial Lines insurance products
Partner with underwriting, operations, actuarial, and data teams to implement pricing changes and improve pricing processes
Extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources to support pricing decisions, portfolio insights, and business objectives
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations while identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis and reporting
Contribute to the development, testing, and enhancement of predictive models that support pricing, retention, and conversion strategies
Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders while continuously developing your actuarial, technical, and analytical expertise


Want to get to know each other better? Send your resume our way.

You belong here

We strive to be much more than a great place to work. Here, you join a collective of incredibly vibrant, purpose driven, and open-minded people. Every day, Westland proves that building a great business means taking care of communities, clients, and each other with equal commitment. You will be supported and respected for who you are and for the voice you add to the conversation.

At Westland, you will feel the power of community. Westland Insurance Ltd. is an inclusive organization that values diversity in its workforce. We listen, champion equity and diversity, and create safe welcoming spaces where everyone has a voice and is free to be themselves. Westland Insurance Ltd. encourages applications from all qualified individuals and will accommodate applicants' disability-related needs, up to the point of undue hardship, throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

If you require a disability-related accommodation in order to participate in the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team by email at careers@westlandinsurance.ca

Title: Quantitative Equity Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Quantitative Equity Analyst to join our Quantitative Equity Team! We are a high-performance team embedded in a top-performing quantitative equity fund that manages over $78+ billion USD in financial assets. We are dedicated to the mission-critical operation of our investment engine—a well-tuned machine responsible for generating key decisions that drive trades and investment insights. Leveraging finance skills and cutting-edge technology, we ensure data quality, continuous process improvement, and operational excellence.

As a core member of our team, you'll collaborate with investment experts to tackle challenging analytical problems, be accountable to ensure accurate and timely trade generation, and drive operational innovation. Based in West Coast Vancouver, we value mentorship, collaboration, and growth in a supportive and innovative environment. Join us to make a significant impact on our investment engine and overall success.

What You Will Do

This is an exciting full-time role for individuals who are passionate about learning the quantitative equity investment management business and excited to tackle a broad range of investment, mathematical, and technology challenges.

You will start with a comprehensive training program, learning about various elements of quantitative equity investment management and our investment process.

You will then continue to a specialized role utilizing data science and process engineering skillsets to accelerate the Quantitative Equities Team’s various investment functions. Your specialized role may involve building, scaling, managing and/or analyzing our quantitative model, portfolios, data assets and optimizers.

You will be supported with coaching and mentorship from senior members of the team.

We are creating the conditions for you to grow your career steadily over time.

Investment Process Management

The team you will be joining is our Investment Process Management (IPM) group within our Quantitative Equities Team. IPM plays a central role in building highly scalable, efficient, and robust process management systems. The processes and infrastructure we maintain are critical in the team’s ability to develop systematic investment insights and generate daily trades to capture these insights in portfolios. The opportunity within the IPM group allows ambitious individuals to drive their career growth within IPM, or across the other functions of the Quantitative Equities Team in Research, Portfolio Construction, or Trading.

Skills

While we take the approach of tailoring the career path for the individual, we have found our functions to cover two main overarching technical skillsets:

Data Science


Construct and run algorithms to explore and assess data effectively.
Validate structured and unstructured data sets for data quality.
Design and test data loaders and security matching processes and specifications.
Perform data analysis and provide data expertise to support researcher’s projects.
Facilitate production machine learning operational pipelines with effective and timely auditing and analysis.
Enable accessibility and clarity within our data assets through robust documentation and data scrubbing.
Develop robust methodologies for assessing and analyzing data in time critical production environments.
Respond to and mitigate vendor data issues effectively in a production setting.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate traditional and alternative data into existing analytical frameworks and decision-making processes.
Present findings and recommendations to key stakeholders in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.


Process and Reliability Engineering


Design, implement and test production processes to run the alpha and risk, portfolio optimization and market implementation processes.
Design robust, high performance and effective process orchestration.
Monitor production health and respond to critical issues in a timely manner.
Effectively communicate real-time production issues to portfolio managers, traders and researchers.
Identify computational bottle necks and improve run speeds in production systems.
Collaborate with investment teams to ensure their process needs are being met.
Find and evaluate areas for process improvements.
Assess and evaluate data quality of production processes.
Maintain process repos, clean code and tools within production processes.


What You Bring


Analytical Mindset – You think critically and creatively and are adept at balancing intuition with statistical validation.
Financial Knowledge – You possess a thorough understanding of (or strong desire to learn) key drivers of business success, including financial theory, economic models, and corporate financial statements.
Self-Starter – You are motivated and willing to take personal accountability for quality and timeliness of work.
Collaborative Approach – You thrive in a collaborative environment and value shared success. You proactively solicit and provide input and excel at communicating complex and technical concepts.
Time Management – You have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple ongoing projects and daily responsibilities.
Academic Training – At a minimum, an undergraduate degree in finance, mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or related discipline. Completion of CFA or relevant graduate degree is considered an asset.
Industry Experience – You have a passion for quantitative finance, equity investment, data science or related fields.


We welcome applications from candidates with a range of experience, including new graduates and experienced professionals. The annual base salary range is $155,000 – $350,000. Our compensation and benefits package includes a substantial variable year-end bonus, RRSP contribution matching, health benefits, and family-building benefits.

As a private organization owned by active leaders, our structure provides opportunities for exceptional contributors to participate in profit sharing and, over time, potentially become equity owners of the firm.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume, cover letter, and academic transcript.

Learn more by exploring our website: www.cclimq.com

We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacquisition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.

AI may be used to support certain stages of our screening & recruitment process. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment and decision-making.

Title: HR Reporting & Systems Analyst - Workday
Description:
Aviso:

At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso' culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca.

The Opportunity:

We're looking for a detail-oriented HR Reporting & Systems Analyst to join our People & Culture team.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, HR Systems, the HR Reporting & Systems Analyst will be responsible for design, enhancement, and maintenance of complex employee data reports and dashboards, with a strong focus on leveraging Workday reporting capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a passion for data, a deep understanding of HR metrics, and hands-on experience with Workday reporting tools, security, and HCM domain knowledge.

Who you are:


Service - You put your clients' needs first. You advocate service excellence, and work to deliver client-centric solutions, and proactively develop strategic partnerships that allow Aviso Wealth to become a trusted advisor and partner
Execution - You are committed to achieving your goals and to succeed. This includes focusing on "getting things done", as well as recognizing and taking advantage of opportunities as they arise. You are consistently looking for ways to improve your personal best and see value in continuous improvement. You take accountability for your actions and learn from mistakes
Collaboration - You work collaboratively with others with the common goal of driving positive results. Making meaningful contributions to your team to achieve organizational goals is a priority. You proactively encourage collaboration, build trust and inclusion, and work to establish effective relationships both inside and outside of the organization


What your day looks like:


Design, develop, maintain, and optimize custom employee data reports, calculated fields, dashboards, and discovery boards within Workday and related tools
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate business needs into customized technical reporting solutions and actionable insights
Act as the first point of contact for all HR reporting inquiries and ad-hoc reporting requests, providing data analysis to guide strategic HR decisions
Deliver and maintain enterprise-wide self-service dashboards and scheduled reporting
Monitor and improve reporting processes, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency to elevate data analytics
Support audit activities by conducting data validation to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across all HR systems
Create and utilize EIBs to support mass data updates, ensuring data quality
Support basic configuration activities, including maintaining business processes, validation rules, conditions, and alerts
Maintain documentation of reporting processes, data definitions, and report catalogues
Stay current with Workday updates and industry best practices to continuously improve reporting/analytics knowledge and capabilities
Support HR Systems team with requests and maintenance on a day-to-day basis and for special projects


Requirements

Your experience and skills:


Post-secondary degree/diploma in computer science, human resources, data analytics, information systems management, or related disciplines
Minimum 3 years of progressive experience with HR reporting and data analytics within Workday
Advanced proficiency in Workday reporting (advanced, matrix, trending, and composite reports), calculated fields, dashboards, and discovery boards
Solid foundation in Workday security and configuration, especially as it relates to report design and access
Proficiency in Workday Report Writer, Calculated Fields, Advanced Reports, and Dashboards
Strong understanding of HR strategy and systems across all areas of HR, and experience with HR metrics such as turnover, headcount, DEIB, and workforce planning
Proven experience with creating, maintaining, and launching EIBs to support mass data updates
Advanced knowledge of Excel functions
Advanced attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
Workday Pro HCM Reporting Certification would be an asset
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI) would be an asset
Proven ability to effectively manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, while delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
Strong collaboration and communication skills with a passion for providing exceptional client service and a focus on the end-user experience
Solid analytical and critical thinking skills including the demonstrated ability to navigate and optimize complex systems, workflows, and data-driven processes
Demonstrated ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and handle sensitive information with familiarity with data privacy and compliance standards (e.g. PIPEDA)
Fluent communication skills in English are required and bilingual skills in French would be an asset


Benefits

Why Aviso?

At Aviso, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success.

Title: EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst - FC Quality Verification
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

FC Live Platform Quality Verification is searching for the next game product expert to drive critical activities that support creating an optimal player experience and will be a key point of contact for decision-making from our stakeholders across production and development teams. The EA Sports FC Player Experience Analyst will report to the Development Manager.

This is a hybrid role, working at least 3 days a week in our Burnaby office.

Responsibilities


Create data-driven insights, reports and presentations to showcase trends and players' sentiment
Help promote game and experiential quality across FC by applying “the voice of the player"
Be an advocate of “the voice of the player” by creating a bridge between FC Live Platform Quality Verification and our partners
Promote improvements across functional quality; with a main focus on experiential quality
Monitor internal communication channels, public discussion forums, and social media platforms to help identify player-affecting issues and collect players' feedback
Coordinate with Production to prioritize recurring player feedback effectively


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree or equivalent industry experience in Quality Assurance
4+ years of experience with testing and defect tracking software, preferably Jira
4+ years of experience with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies
Synthesize community feedback and player sentiment into clear, relevant insights that can be discussed with producers and Live Operations partners to improve the player experience
2+ years of experience writing reports and providing updates to stakeholders
Knowledge of gaming consoles and their systems
Experience using collaboration tools, preferably Confluence, Miro, and Slack
Experience working across different time zones and international teams
Understanding of football tactics and in-game strategies.
A genuine love for football as a fan, player, referee, gamer, or coach.
Please include a cover letter to let us know your love/knowledge of the FC game or football (soccer) as a sport.

Title: Compensation Analyst
Description:
We know it is our people who make us great at what we do.




We are looking for a compensation professional to support our growing compensation consulting team on several current and up coming client projects, and other initiatives. We are looking for someone, based in Vancouver or Toronto, with superb analytical and communication skills who is highly motivated, has a fine eye for detail, and can juggle multiple tasks and deliverables.




A typical day-in-the life of a Compensation Analyst involves meeting with clients, performing data analysis, understanding compensation trends to inform clients on compensation-related inquiries, and supporting internal projects. As a team member, you will work in partnership with the project managers to support clients all across Canada and gain exposure to the many areas of compensation practices including salary structure design, market analysis, job documentation and evaluation, executive pay, pay equity, salary surveys and many more!




If you are looking to take your HR and compensation career to the next level, this may be the right role for you!




This posting is for an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill.




Roles and Responsibilities

Utilize Excel and other analysis tools to build compensation-related tools, dashboards, and analysis by adopting advanced techniques to compute and aggregate data, and conduct market comparisons
Interpret data and derive key market insights for clients and other reports
Support consulting team members on client projects by providing high-touch data analysis covering a wide-spread of broad compensation activities, including external market analysis using salary surveys, salary structure design, executive pay, incentive plan design, pay equity, and job evaluation
Conduct market benchmarking by reviewing client data, determining appropriate peer groups, and performing data compilation/aggregation among multiple sources, sectors, and industry databases
Collect, organize, track, and interpret client pay program information and policy material
Support national and custom external market compensation survey activities relating to questionnaire setup, create job capsules, survey tracking, database management, administration, data validation, and client communications
Help clients write job descriptions (JDs) by reviewing existing job documentation, organizational structures, JD templates, and conducting interviews
Support consultants on project management duties, including managing client documentation, coordination, scheduling, meeting note documentation, and general status tracking
Support the job evaluation process by reviewing and creating job descriptions and evaluating roles using a job evaluation methodology
Conduct research and perform financial analyses of industry sectors and client peer groups to understand business strategy, corporate performance, compensation, and rewards practices and trends
Support the team in preparation of client and business development-related presentations and executive reports; translate data into broader total rewards themes and recommendations, utilizing multiple applications including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint




What we offer

Collaborative and engaging atmosphere
Variety in work and ability to evolve and grow your career
Working with colleagues across Canada and across multiple practice areas
Opportunities to help build and evolve our practice
Competitive compensation in terms of salary, bonus and paid vacation time (commensurate with experience)
An entrepreneurial, collegial work environment
Hybrid work style and dress for your day approach

What you offer

0-2 years of relevant experience is preferred but not required. Previous co-op terms, internships, or other related experience will be considered an asset
Bachelor's degree specifically in Business, Commerce, Economics, or a related field (required) with a baseline understanding of the different organization structures
Analytical skills and basic proficiency in MS Excel (comfortable with lookups, pivot tables, and basic formulas) combined with a strong knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and database management
Strong oral and written communication skills including the ability to independently write a strong first draft report or insights presentation for clients
Strong desire to learn and develop through exposure to various projects and clients
Demonstrated ability to follow established standards and procedures
Ability to work in a team environment while managing multiple priorities and projects
Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal and written communication skills
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
Commitment to superior client satisfaction




Strong assets but not required

Prior co-op/ internship experience in data analysis, consulting, and/or compensation
Previous work experience in compensation with knowledge in market matching and benchmarking, job evaluation, job description writing, pay equity, or executive compensation
In the process of completing or willingness to complete the Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation
Bilingual in both English and French (reading, writing, and speaking)




Who we are:

At Eckler, we are driven by our purpose to care and to do right by people so that together we can achieve a brighter, more secure future. It’s just one of the reasons Eckler has been recognized multiple times as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures. Our origins go back to 1927, making us one of Canada’s first actuarial practices. Based in Canada and the Caribbean, we’re a team of committed and highly skilled professionals consulting in the areas of pension, retirement, financial wellness, investment, group benefits, insurance, change management and communication and technology. Owned and operated by its active Principals, the company has earned a reputation for service continuity and high professional standards. Eckler is a founding member of Abelica Global – an international alliance of independent actuarial and consulting firms operating in over 20 countries.




At Eckler, we value diversity of all types. Our organization is made up of smart, collaborative, and thoughtful people with a wide range of backgrounds, skills, and experiences. We are committed to an inclusive, diverse, and accessible workplace and encourage all interested applicants to submit a cover letter and resume for consideration. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process or those needing job postings in an alternative format may e-mail a request to careers@eckler.ca.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for the short list will be contacted.

Title: 26-61 Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (10 months)
Description:
The Opportunity

Supports the Leader in the strategy and operation of Technical Safety BC’s business intelligence program supporting driving operational efficiencies and measurement of organizational strategy implementation. Provides an advanced level of expertise in business intelligence to develop and deliver data and information products for internal and external customers and stakeholders. Independently carries out complex needs assessment, identifies opportunities to optimize use of data and information extracted from internal and external sources, and determines optimal methods to deliver resulting products to meet business needs. Provides day-to-day technical guidance to the Business Intelligence Analyst.

Status: Casual, Full-Time, Union

Number of Positions: 1

Pay Grade: (Grade 18) $61.87/hr

Location: Vancouver or open to any of our BC regional offices

Reports to: Leader, Business Intelligence

As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, you will:


Applies an advanced level of expertise in the strategy and operation of Technical Safety BC’s business intelligence program. Provides input to development of corporate strategies to influence change through data, information and knowledge, and participates in implementation and delivery.
Identifies information needs, including situations where clients cannot clearly articulate the need, available solutions fall short, and data is of lower quality. Designs, develops, and delivers complex data and information products that are scalable and accessible to internal and external customers through standard or unique reports and self-serve methods.
Leads and participates in data initiatives that are strictly speaking outside of Business Intelligence, including data definition, data modelling, data quality, information management, and records management.
Applies an advanced level of expertise in experimental design, applying creativity and exploring innovative solutions to address client-specific needs. Tests information products, evaluates findings, and redesigns as necessary to deliver required outcomes. Educates end users at senior levels of the organization on the proper use of BI products.
Supports the Leader in developing a framework of processes, practices and standards to ensure all product development and information sharing is executed with cost-effective, timely, and operationally efficient results. Develops ethical standards on the use of information within the organization. Fosters transparency and ready-access to information, while also establishing the necessary controls to mitigate risks.
Collaborates with the Information Technology and Data Management departments in identifying optimal solutions and delivering information services throughout the organization. Negotiates solutions and scheduling with IT/DM departments while maintaining excellent relationships with the IT/DM departments.
Collaborates with leaders to assess and advise on business intelligence needs, and determines optimal methods and products to support achievement of business objectives. Manages internal expectations and takes action to find common ground for differing agendas and conflicting objectives. Assesses and prioritizes day-to-day requests, applying judgement in the context of organization-wide requirements.
Collaborates with the Leader in providing communication and advice that encourages client behavioural change through use of data and information products. Title: Financial Operation Analyst, Revenue & Commissions
Description:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Reports To: Finance Operation Manager

Location: Vancouver, BC (Hybrid)

Primary Purpose

The Financial Operation Analyst, Revenue & Commissions is responsible for supporting the University's Accounts Receivable, Student Refunds, and Agent Commission operations by ensuring the accurate, timely, and efficient processing of financial transactions, reconciliations, reporting, and operational analysis. The role serves as the primary operational support to the Commissions and Accounts Receivable function, coordinating day-to-day activities across revenue operations and helping ensure service standards, internal controls, and operational objectives are consistently achieved.

The Financial Operation Analyst partners closely with Business Development, Registrar, Admissions, Student Services, Academic Operations, and external recruitment agents to resolve operational issues, improve business processes, and enhance the student and agent experience. The role contributes to financial integrity through reconciliations, reporting, compliance, and data analysis while identifying opportunities for automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement across Accounts Receivable, Student Refunds, and Agent Commission operations.

Specific Responsibilities

Reconciliation, Reporting & Analysis:


Perform monthly reconciliations between student information system, ERP, payment platforms and banking records. Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial records.
Preform commission accrual calculations and reconciliations. Prepare month-end supporting schedules and working papers.
Prepare commission, accounts receivable, collection, and revenue performance reports.
Analyze trends related to revenue, scholarship, commissions, refunds, bad debt, and student payment activity
Forecast commissions, refunds and collections
Develop and maintain recurring financial reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Power BI, Python and other reporting tools.
Identify risks, exceptions, and operational issues and recommend corrective actions.


Revenue Operations


Manage daily accounts receivable activities, including the processing, recording, and reconciliation of student payments received through various payment channels, ensuring accuracy and timely posting within financial and student information systems.
Monitor student account balances, aging reports, unapplied payments, chargebacks, and outstanding receivables, proactively identifying issues and supporting collection efforts to optimize cash flow and minimize bad debt.
Administer student financial transactions, including deposits, tuition payments, refunds, credits, installment plans, scholarship, fee adjustments, and collection agency transactions, ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve the student and agent experience through efficient financial operations.


Agent Commission Operation


Calculate agent commissions in accordance with contractual agreements, institutional policies, and established timelines.
Review commission invoices, supporting documentation, and payment eligibility requirements to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Validate commission calculations and investigate discrepancies, exceptions, and payment variances.
Reconcile commission payments against contracts, student records, and financial systems.
Maintain agent contract databases, commission records, and supporting documentation to ensure completeness and audit readiness.
Support agent inquiries related to commission payments, calculations, and contract terms.


Student Refund Operation


Coordinate the end-to-end student refund process, ensuring refund requests are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with university policies and service standards.
Review refund requests for completeness and eligibility, validating supporting documentation, tuition adjustments, administrative charges, and payment requirements.
Prepare and process refund transactions through banking platforms, Flywire, and other payment channels while maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
Maintain refund tracking logs and monitor refund aging to ensure timely resolution of outstanding and pending cases.
Reconcile refund transactions between the Student Information System, ERP, banking records, and payment platforms, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
Prepare refund reports, reconciliations, and operational metrics to support management reporting and continuous process improvement.
Identify process improvement opportunities that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and student experience of refund operations.


System Accuracy And Process Improvement


Support implementation, testing, and enhancement of financial systems and related integrations.
Identify and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
Participate in automation initiatives and workflow optimization projects.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and process documentation.
Support data validation, system reconciliations, and operational process reviews.


Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls


Maintain organized supporting documentation to ensure compliance with audit requirements and internal policies.
Assist with internal and external audit requests and information gathering.
Support the execution of internal control procedures across commission and accounts receivable processes.
Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, financial policies, and established procedures.
Participate in fraud prevention, exception monitoring, and risk mitigation activities.
Support continuous improvement of financial controls and operational governance.


Position Requirements

Competencies


Experience with Python is strongly preferred
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reconciliation models, pivot tables, and complex formulas.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and reconciliation skills.
Strong understanding of internal controls, audit requirements, fraud prevention, and financial governance.
Ability to analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, measure KPIs, and provide actionable business insights.
Experience with workflow automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, revenue recognition, and month-end close processes related to revenue operations.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage competing priorities and meet tight deadlines.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial operations, and controls
Ability to analyze financial data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights
Customer-service orientation with the ability to work effectively with internal and external partners.
Demonstrated initiative and a continuous improvement mindset.
High level of accountability, ownership, and initiative, consistently delivering high-quality work with minimal supervision.
Demonstrated leadership potential through mentoring colleagues, coordinating operational activities, and contributing to team success without direct supervisory authority.
Results-oriented with a focus on achieving operational KPIs, service standards, and continuous improvement objectives.


Education and Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
Additional certifications in financial systems, data analytics, or process improvement are an asset
Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in finance operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, or commission-based environments
Experience working with large datasets and multiple integrated systems.
Exposure to audit support, internal controls, compliance, or process improvement initiatives is desirable.
Experience working in a fast-paced, customer-focused, and highly collaborative environment.

Build On Your Education And Career Experience As You


Coordinate work activities related to the production of major reports and documents, identify reporting needs, analyze current procedures, explore opportunities, reduce redundancies and ensure data gathering and reporting processes support corporate strategies and business objectives related to contract management, service utilization reviews, health intervention/technology assessments and cost-effective analyses in collaboration with business units and stakeholders.

Supporting the Vision, Values, Purpose and Commitments of Fraser Health including service delivery that is centered around patients/clients/residents and families:

Communicates with all levels of staff and management across FH to facilitate consensus, consultation and the sharing of information; liaises with consultants, vendors, and other health care entities and other external agencies.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Health Economics, Computer Science and/or related field, plus five (5) to seven (7) years' recent related experience in contract management, business analysis and/or health care management, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Professional/Technical Capabilities


Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of the health care system
Demonstrated ability to analyze and visualize clinical, contract, administrative and financial data
Demonstrated understanding of relational and multidimensional database concepts
Knowledge of other health care disciplines and their role within healthcare
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment and independently
Ability to plan, organize and prioritize work and deadlines
Working knowledge of Agile, SDLC, Lean, Scrum, Six Sigma and other flow process improvement concepts
Working knowledge of change management practices, such as PROSCI
Working knowledge of contract management lifecycle, strategic sourcing and public procurement.
Ability to quickly understand and operate applicable software applications
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position

Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region.

Title: Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights
Description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Specialist, Product Management – Attributes & Insights

Our Purpose

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en-us/vision/who-we-are/diversity-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

About The Team

Mastercard Identity, within the Security Solutions organization, leads the development of products and services that enable global commerce, powers financial inclusion, prevents crime and makes some of the most seamless experiences possible.

As part of Mastercard Identity, the Attributes & Insights team drives the development and management of products, programs, and services focused on deterministic attribute verification. The team delivers significant value across the ecosystem, helping to combat new fraud and address regulatory requirements. Our vision is to deliver a single, rail-agnostic platform and a real-time suite of solutions.

Job Description

Role Overview

The Senior Specialist will support Account Status Inquiry (ASI) as a data-driven product manager focused on understanding customer usage, evaluating product performance, and translating insights into product actions. This role will analyze ASI adoption across regions, customers, segments, and use cases to identify growth opportunities, product improvements, and customer value drivers. The specialist will partner with regional, sales, engineering, and customer success teams to strengthen ASI reporting, support adoption, develop product documentation, and contribute to data-backed business cases for future enhancements. This role will help improve visibility into ASI utilization, identify underpenetrated customer and regional opportunities, and support roadmap decisions that drive adoption, customer value, and product growth.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong product knowledge of Account Status Inquiry and the broader Attribute & Insights suite of products, including customer use cases, product rules, transaction flows, and value drivers

Analyze ASI usage, transaction trends, customer behavior, regional performance, and segment-level adoption to identify growth opportunities, product improvement areas, and customer value drivers

Build and maintain KPI reporting and performance summaries that clearly communicate ASI usage, adoption, revenue opportunities, customer impact, and product performance trends

Translate data insights into product requirements, enhancement recommendations, business cases, best-practice use cases, and customer-facing value narratives

Support customer, regional, partner, and internal product/sales inquiries by using product knowledge and data analysis to diagnose trends, answer questions, and recommend next steps

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support successful product launches, enhancement delivery, reporting improvements, and operational readiness

Create and maintain product documentation, best practices, sales materials, operational processes, and customer enablement content

Required Skills And Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have experience in product management, payments, financial services, analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, and usage data to inform product strategy. The candidate should possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable product insights.

Experience analyzing transaction-level, customer, or usage data to identify trends, anomalies, growth opportunities, and product improvement areas

Proficiency with SQL, advanced Excel, and dashboarding or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms

Ability to define product KPIs, build performance reporting, and communicate insights that inform product decisions and stakeholder discussions

Familiarity with statistical analysis or data science techniques, including trend analysis, segmentation, hypothesis testing, and data-driven decision making

Product management mindset with the ability to connect customer needs, product capabilities, usage trends, and business outcomes

Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data and product topics for business and technical audiences

Knowledge of transaction processing, card-not-present payments, authorization flows, or network products is a plus

Work Conditions: Some travel required

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.



In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This posting reflects one or more current openings on our team.

Pay Ranges

Toronto, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Vancouver, Canada: $94,000 - $138,000 CAD

Title: Actuarial Analyst II
Description:
Why BCAA?

Feel proud of what you do and help shape the future of BC at a BC Top Employer. We’re driven by purpose – delivering peace of mind to one in three BC households with insurance, roadside assistance, auto repair, Evo Car Share and Evolve E-Bike Share. With a long history of keeping roads safe and giving back in ways that build stronger communities, we offer a wide variety of meaningful, rewarding careers that move BC forward.

We are currently hiring an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II) based in our Head Office in Burnaby.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based out of our Burnaby, BC office. Applicants who are not located within commuting distance of our Head Office or are not looking to relocate to the Greater Vancouver/Lower Mainland/Fraser Valley region will not be considered.

As an Actuarial Analyst (Level I OR II), you’ll play a key role in supporting pricing sophistication, underwriting capability, and product development for BCAA’s Property & Casualty insurance products. This role blends actuarial analysis with hands-on problem solving to deliver insights that enhance rating methodologies, support P&C portfolio performance, and strengthen decision-making across our insurance business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone progressing through CAS actuarial exams who wants to grow in a collaborative, corporate environment. You’ll work closely with senior actuarial team members, contribute to research and predictive modeling projects, and gain valuable exposure to property and casualty insurance analysis, product design, and risk assessment.

Who you are:


You are analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong foundation in actuarial methods and insurance concepts.
You thrive on problem-solving and enjoy using data to uncover insights and develop practical solutions.
You are highly organized, capable of managing competing priorities with accuracy and focus.
You work well independently but also collaborate effectively in a team environment.
You’re motivated to continue writing CAS actuarial exams and building your actuarial career.
You communicate technical findings clearly, tailoring your message to both technical and non-technical audiences.



What you’ll do:


Contribute to the development of rating models and actuarial analyses to support product pricing and underwriting strategies.
Assist in preparing and reviewing actuarial studies, including loss ratio analysis, trend analysis, reinsurance governance, etc.
Work with senior team members to scope projects and establish appropriate actuarial or statistical approaches.

Title: Senior Associate, New Verticals - Canada Strategy & Operations
Description:
About the Team

New Verticals launched in 2020 to take the DoorDash marketplace beyond restaurants: it now spans 100,000+ grocery, convenience, alcohol, retail, and DashMart stores across the US and Canada. This team focuses on building our Canadian marketplace to ensure we are able to deliver exactly what consumers are looking for when they want it, with speed and quality.

About the Role

We are hiring a few Senior Associates on our Canada New Verticals Strategy & Operations. One role will focus on improving how we partner with our Dashers and driving efficiencies to how they operate. The second role will focus on driving quality improvements to our platform that enhances the shopping experience resulting in higher consumer spend. Both roles will require you to understand marketplace data and constraints to strategize actionable plans to improve efficiency levers impacting things like in-store navigation, in-app experience, dasher pay, pricing & promotions and so much more! These roles require you to understand our three-sided marketplace and the unit economics that impact our financial success all while balancing growth, cost and quality. You'll need to weigh both sides of that tradeoff in every lever you pull.

These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect this person to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

You will report into a Manager on our New Verticals Strategy & Operations team and be an individual contributor position. We operate in a hybrid model and spend a few days a month in person together. We have two positions so throughout the interview process, we will consider you for two roles and align on role fit throughout the interview process!

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Strategize. From first principles, you'll develop the optimal strategy for best serving all sides of the marketplace - dashers, merchants and consumers.
Operate. Own tracking dashboards and manage week over week metrics to drive high quality operations.
Experiment. Design, launch, and share out operational experiments and product features that impact things like dynamic delivery windows, order batching, predictive ordering, in-app merchandising, etc.
Analyze. Build models using Excel and SQL to evaluate the economic, operational and strategic costs and benefits of various programs and experiments — and increasingly, use AI to accelerate and deepen that analysis.
Build with AI. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day-to-day work, and share what you learn with the team.
Lead, collaborate and Influence. You'll partner with and influence cross-functional teams including growth, quality, finance, product, analytics and engineering to launch initiatives to the finish line.
Own. You will manage core metrics across Dashers or Consumers and be the DRI for the success of metrics ranging from acceptance rates, batch rates, subtotals, basket size and so many others!
Partner. Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and our US Logistics counterparts to share learnings and scale what works.


We're excited about you because…


You solve problems from first principles. You resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.
You're entrepreneurial. You have a bias for action and are able to build things from the ground up.
You are an operator. You solve problems by actually understanding the problem.
You like data, and you let it win arguments. You're comfortable building complex SQL queries across multiple data sources and have experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools.
You're energized by AI tools — and you actively experiment with them. You don't wait to be told how to use a new tool; you're already exploring tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini and more. You bring a builder's mindset to AI: using it to automate the repetitive, accelerate the analytical, and unlock work that would otherwise require a larger team. You're comfortable with a role whose scope will continue to shift as AI becomes more capable, and you see that as an opportunity rather than a threat.
You're unafraid of uncharted territory. This role is still taking shape, and you're excited to help define it rather than inherit a fixed playbook.
You have 2-4+ years of experience. You've succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience).
You have a completed Bachelor's Degree.


Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That's why we offer a comprehensive benefits package for all regular employees, that includes paid time off, paid parental leave, wellness benefit and several paid holidays.

Additionally, for full-time employees, DoorDash offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, disability and basic life insurance, an RRSP including an employer match, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

The base pay for this position ranges from our lowest geographical market up to our highest geographical market within British Columbia.

$97,000—$121,000 CAD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Description:
Requirements

Description & Requirements

who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

As a member of the product team, the Global Planning team is responsible for ensuring the efficient management of inventory for the company. They work closely with the regional teams to understand new product trends, regional needs, size trends, and logistics. The team monitors inventory levels on a weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual basis, assessing changes in trends and adjusting strategies to optimize inventory management and mitigate risks. The priority is to understand and protect the guest experience, followed by maintaining effective inventory control and supporting profitable sales growth.

Reporting to the Global Inventory & Operations Planning Manager, the Global Associate Planner plays a key role in supporting global inventory planning and visibility across the business. This role is responsible for developing forward-looking inventory projections, assessing inventory health, and translating data into insights that support planning and operational decisions. You will work closely with Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional partners to understand inventory flow, identify risks and opportunities, and support both short- and long-term business priorities.


Inventory Health & Insights: Analyze inventory performance and develop inventory composition and aged inventory projections across global and market levels. Assess the health, balance, and aging of inventory, identifying emerging risks and opportunities and providing actionable insights to support inventory decisions and leadership discussions.
Inventory Flow & Projections: Manage and analyze on-orders, receipts, and inventory flow to maintain visibility to future inventory positions. Partner closely with DC Operations to develop inbound and outbound projections that support capacity planning, operational readiness, and changing business needs.
Business Performance & Reporting: Monitor key inventory and planning KPIs against plan and prior year. Analyze trends and underlying drivers to identify areas of opportunity or risk and provide clear insights into business performance.
Leadership Insights & Presentations: Support the development of monthly and quarterly business reviews, bringing together inventory and performance data into clear, concise presentations. Highlight key trends, business drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for leadership.
Cross-Functional Planning: Build strong partnerships across Global Planning, DC Operations, and other cross-functional teams to align inventory projections, communicate changes, and ensure teams have the visibility needed to make informed decisions.
Tools & Process Improvement: Own and maintain key planning tools, dashboards, and reporting while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate processes. Support the evolution of scalable reporting and tools that improve data accuracy, visibility, and overall team efficiency.

Detail orientated

Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life.

Title: Lead Product Analyst, Content Supply & Understanding
Description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

The team. Data & Analytics at Scribd brings together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Product Analytics to turn fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted foundations, and to build AI-assisted tools that bring reliable intelligence into how teams make decisions.

The role. This role supports Content Supply & Understanding, the team that owns Scribd’s library of more than 400 million documents, which reaches over 250 million monthly active users. The team’s remit covers who contributes the content, how well we understand it, and how it reaches users. You will report to the Senior Manager, Data Analytics, and work embedded alongside Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering partners. The role is open at the Senior and Lead levels, and we will level based on the experience you bring. At the Senior level you own analytical workstreams within a defined area. At the Lead level you also set the measurement strategy for the area, take on the most open-ended problems, and raise the bar for the analysts around you.

Mandate. Make it possible to say with confidence what is in the corpus, where it falls short of what users look for, and whether enrichment is making content easier to find and use, with numbers that stay comparable as content sources, models, and pipelines change.

Core philosophy. A metric definition is a shared artifact. We care about documentation, versioning, and data quality as much as the readout on top, because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

About You


You are at your best when the question is not yet well formed. You look at an incomplete picture, work out what matters, and produce an answer a product team can act on, with the limits of the evidence stated plainly.
You are equally comfortable as the strategist and the analyst. You can size an opportunity, model its return, write the SQL behind the metric, and defend the number in a room full of product and executive leaders.
You are skeptical by default. When a metric moves sharply, your instinct is to find the field or pipeline that changed before you write the narrative.
You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and metric documentation are part of the deliverable.


You will


Build measurement for content understanding. Define how we measure classification and metadata coverage, accuracy, and the effect of enrichment on discovery and engagement.
Own analytics for content supply and generate insights on where the corpus falls short: size the gap between user demand and the corpus, estimate the value of closing it, and help prioritize where to invest, using the same market sizing, segmentation, and ROI methods applied in go-to-market analysis.
Partner with Product Managers on strategy and roadmap. Translate product bets into success and guardrail metrics, size opportunities, and make trade-offs explicit.
Design and read experiments (A/B tests and other methods) for content-related product changes, from hypothesis through analysis and readout.
Define and maintain the KPIs, metric definitions, and dashboards for the content domain, and work with Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering on instrumentation and data quality so that metrics stay consistent over time.
Investigate discontinuities and anomalies in content data, and separate real changes in user behavior from pipeline, definition, or instrumentation changes.
Use AI-assisted workflows to speed up analysis and reporting, document how results are validated, and keep AI tools grounded as definitions change.
Present findings and recommendations to product, engineering, and executive audiences, including in regular metrics reviews.
At the Lead level: set analytical standards for the area and mentor other analysts.


You have


4+ years of experience in product analytics or a closely related role for Senior, or 7+ years for Lead, with a record of influencing product or business decisions.
Experience turning ambiguous, loosely defined questions into analysis that changed a decision, in areas where data is sparse or metrics did not yet exist.
Experience with opportunity sizing, segmentation, or business and go-to-market analysis, such as market sizing, pipeline prioritization, or ROI modeling.
Advanced SQL, and experience with Python or R for analysis and statistical work.
Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Databricks, and with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau.
Experience building AI into analytics workflows, such as LLM-assisted querying, analysis, or reporting, to move faster while checking answers against certified metrics or known results. You use AI where it creates measurable value.
Working knowledge of experimentation: A/B test design, hypothesis testing, and statistical analysis.
A record of defining a metric, defending it under scrutiny, and revising it when its inputs change.
Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineers on strategy, roadmap, and measurement.
Strong written and verbal communication, for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.


Nice to have


Experience with content-heavy platforms such as marketplaces, catalogs, publishing, or user-generated content, including supply or content quality analytics.
Experience with classification, taxonomy, or metadata systems, or with search and recommendation, including evaluating ML or LLM outputs against labeled data.
Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig.
For Lead candidates: experience mentoring analysts and setting measurement standards for a product area.

Title: Pipe Integrity Analyst
Description:
About DarkVision Technologies Inc.

DarkVision is a Vancouver-based tech company that has been disrupting the industrial imaging market since 2013. We have created the world’s most advanced acoustic-based imaging platform, revolutionizing how our clients quantify and visualize the integrity of their critical assets.

Backed by Blackstone, one of the world’s largest private equity firms, DarkVision’s team of Software, Mechanical, and Machine Learning Engineers and Data Analysts is rapidly expanding to meet the demand for the company’s current and upcoming products.

Our employees work on cutting-edge technologies that blend science with real-world applications. We invite you to join our team for the exciting journey ahead as we become the global leader in industrial imaging.

Your Job

DarkVision is seeking a Pipe Integrity Analyst to join our Well Integrity Data Analysis Team in North Vancouver, BC. In this role, you will analyze high-resolution ultrasound scans of oil and gas wells and transform the results into actionable reports, 3D images, detailed models, and quantifiable insights that help clients make informed decisions about the safe and efficient operation of their multi-million-dollar assets.

This position requires 100% on-site work at our North Vancouver (day shifts) and Downtown Vancouver (night shifts) offices. A willingness to work nights is necessary to be considered for this role.

Please note that this role does not offer work permit or permanent residency sponsorship.

Scheduling

Below is a general outline of what your schedule will look like:


Training Period: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
